job.title: Casual Grassroots Scouts (U12-U16) - London & Kent
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a number of Casual Grassroots Scouts to join us on a casual basis and operate in North, West, East or South London/Kent, to identify players for our Academy with potential to develop in the Youth Development Phase (12-16).

You'll diligently attend football matches and record the necessary information on potential players in our Academy's online club database and you'll passionately attend weekly meetings lead by Phase Coordinators to feedback your insight and findings.

We're looking for Grassroots Scouts in multiple regions, please indicate which region you'd like to be considered for in your application below.


 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.


Your day-to-day

  • Operate as a key member of our Academy talent ID network - you'll proactively identify and report on the most talented young players with the potential to join our Academy

  • Develop and maintain knowledge of our players - you will passionately report on players monitored on our database and build and cultivate your knowledge of players in the selected phase at our club and beyond

  • Act as a proud ambassador for our club - you'll take pride in protecting our image and upholding our reputation in the public domain and work within the PL/EFL Youth Development rules

  • Attend relevant events - you will attend CPD events relevant to Talent ID held at our Academy

  • Stay available to attend matches - you'll ensure you're flexible and available to attend grassroots matches selected by our Phase Coordinator

  • Abide by critical policies - you will keep important policies related to Safeguarding, Equality and Health and Safety front of mind at all times

What we are looking for

  • Credible expertise - you hold an FA Talent ID Level 2 and an FA Safeguarding Certificate

  • Empathetic and supportive approach - you're naturally sensitive to the needs of young players, parents/guardians and grassroots clubs

  • Competent IT skills - you're confident writing detailed reports and keeping databases up to date

  • Valid driving licence - you can get yourself to fixtures, events and meetings with ease

  • Collaborative team player - you're a personable and enthusiastic individual with a competitive work ethic and you work efficiently as part of a team

  • Flexible mindset - you have a willingness to work weekends, along with some evenings in the week

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

job.title: Pre-Academy Scouts (Casual Role)
job.location: Hale End, Woodford Green, IG8 9LL, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for Pre-Academy Scouts on a casual, part-time basis - who will be on the frontline in identifying talented young players with the potential to develop within our Pre-Academy age groups.

The development of young talent and giving young players a chance has long been at the centre of our philosophy, so our Academy is a vital part of our club and exists to develop Strong Young Gunners for the future and you will be at the forefront of this mission to uncover the most promising young players. 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).


Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.


Your day-to-day

  • Be a key part of our Academy Talent Identification network - you'll play a vital role in identifying talented players for the future success of our club

  • Identify the most exciting talent - you will relish the opportunity to take responsibility for identifying and reporting on the most talented young players in your designated catchment area

  • Keep abreast of the wider player landscape - you'll diligently report on and monitor players on our database, whilst ensuring a good knowledge of players at other clubs

  • Build impactful relationships on all fronts - you will passionately establish and maintain effective relationships with players, parents/guardians and grassroots clubs

  • Develop a network of important contacts - you'll cultivate a valuable network of contacts in youth football 

  • Uphold our high standards - you will take pride in ensuring our best-in-class standards are always adhered to and work within the rules of youth football development

What we are looking for

  • Credible expertise - you've completed one of the following courses/accreditations: National Talent Identification and Scouting in Football, Advanced Principles of Talent Identification and Development in Football, Leadership of Talent Identification and Development in Football or a Technical Director course

  • Solid knowledge of youth football - you're proud of your extensive understanding of grassroots football and your knowledge of local junior football clubs

  • Certification in Safeguarding - you hold an up to date FA Safeguarding Children Certificate 

  • Excellent communication skills - you're able to build and maintain impactful relationships with parents/guardians, coaches and players of varying ages, tailoring your approach as necessary

  • Best-in-class attention to detail - you're well versed in producing insightful written reports and delivering verbal feedback with the utmost clarity

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

Please note: this role will require you to hold a valid driving license


Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - Monday 24th August 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Good luck!

job.title: Pre-Academy Coaches (Casual Role)
job.location: Hale End, Woodford Green, IG8 9LL, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a number of Pre-Academy Coaches on a casual, part-time basis, who will be entrusted to oversee and deliver the training and games programmes for the Under 6 to Under 8 groups at our regional centres, whilst working closely with support departments to deliver both on and off field success.

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).


Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.


Your day-to-day

  • Design and present coaching strategies - you'll passionately deliver coaching strategies for all players from our Academy coaching programme whilst ensuring the agreed approaches are implemented within agreed timescales

  • Prepare and submit appraisals - you will create player appraisals ahead of discussions with our Recruitment Coordinator, as required for the Elite Player Performance Plan 

  • Produce critical documentation - you'll diligently plan and submit session plans, match and attendance reports and reviews

  • Uphold our high standards - you will take responsibility for ensuring our Academy equipment is efficiently managed and utilised 

  • Conduct vital player reviews - you'll collaborate with our Recruitment Coordinator and undertake mid and full season meetings with players, parents/guardians and coaches

  • Contribute to important future-focused discussions - you will partner with our Recruitment team and be an active participant in defining retain and release strategies

What we are looking for

  • Credible expertise - you hold either a UEFA B Licence, Advanced Youth Award, UEFA A Licence or a UEFA Pro Licence

  • Excellent communication skills - you're able to build and maintain impactful relationships with parents/guardians, coaches and players of varying ages, tailoring your approach as necessary 

  • Best-in-class attention to detail - you're well versed in producing insightful written reports and delivering verbal feedback with the utmost clarity

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

Please note: this role will require you to hold a valid driving license 


Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - Monday 24th August 2026

job.title: Community Draw Seller (Casual)
job.html_description:
As a Community Draw ticket seller, you will play a vital role in raising funds for the Cherries Community Fund by selling Community Draw tickets at each home matchday. The Cherries Community Fund is dedicated to providing financial assistance to projects that support young people and vulnerable groups in Bournemouth, Dorset, and Hampshire. 
  • Engage with fans at the stadium prior to kick-off. 
  • Promote awareness of the AFC Bournemouth Community Draw. 
  • Proactively sell Community Draw tickets in designated areas, including outside the stadium and in corporate suites. 
  • Handle payment transactions using card machines. 
  • Collaborate with the Community Matchday Draw Supervisor for any queries or assistance.  
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.  
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 

The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

job.title: Commercial Graphic Designer
job.html_description:
The Commercial Graphic Designer is responsible for delivering creative solutions that support AFC Bournemouth's commercial objectives and drive revenue. Working closely with the Commercial Director and wider Commercial team, the role holder will create high-quality visual content across sponsorship proposals, pitch presentations, Digideck, commercial marketing materials, partner activations, stadium branding and matchday assets. 

The role requires someone with strong commercial design experience who can manage multiple projects independently, collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners, and produce creative work that enhances the club's commercial offering. 

Based at Vitality Stadium, this role reports directly to the Commercial Director and offers the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, live-event environment at the heart of a Premier League football club. 
  • Design sponsorship proposals, pitch decks and Digideck presentations.  
  • Produce creative assets for commercial campaigns, partner activations and marketing.  
  • Create mockups, visualisations and branding concepts for prospective and existing partners.  
  • Design stadium branding, signage, print collateral and matchday assets.  
  • Prepare artwork for print and digital production.  
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring work is delivered to a high standard and within deadlines.  
  • Maintain brand consistency across all commercial creative output. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Degree-level qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Communications or a related discipline (preferred).  
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Cloud skills, with experience producing high-quality commercial design work.  
  • Strong presentation design capabilities, including experience creating proposals, pitch decks and Digideck presentations.  
  • Understanding of print production and artwork preparation for both digital and physical assets.  
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.  
  • Excellent organisational, communication and stakeholder management skills.  
  • An understanding of sponsorship, partnerships and commercial marketing within sport or a similar industry is beneficial.  
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal departments and external partners.  
  • A proactive, creative mindset with a strong focus on delivering innovative and commercially effective design solutions. 
  • Commercial graphic design experience (sport, agency or in-house).  
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design and commercial projects.  
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Cloud skills.  
  • Experience creating presentations in PowerPoint or Digideck.  
  • Strong understanding of print production and artwork.  
  • Excellent organisation, communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Commercial design experience.  
  • Strong presentation design.  
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.  
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.  
  • Strong Adobe Creative Suite skills. 

  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Contribution towards eye tests and glasses.
  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme.
  • Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year).
  • Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our club social team.
  • Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year).
  • Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Academy Driver (Casual)
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
To transport Academy players to and from all Academy activity, around Bournemouth and nationally.

Academy Values: 
  • Players First: every player valued. Every decision made with care. 
  • Togetherness: working in a prosocial manner as part of a wider team – willing to contribute beyond own interests. 
  • Integrity: carrying out academy and club values in an open and honest manner. 
  • Accountability: willing to take responsibility for actions in a manner which allows learning, growth and reflection. 

  • Transport Academy Players from various pick-up points in the Bournemouth area to and from AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre. Pick up points include but are not limited to: Vitality Stadium, Bournemouth Train Station, Player Accommodation.  
  • Be available to transport Academy players to venues around the country for away fixtures at weekends. 
  • To be available to transport Academy players to other venues as and when needed. 
  • Liaise with the Academy Operations & Player Care teams around weekly schedules and bus registers.  
  • Daily & weekly vehicle checks to be undertaken prior to any journey. Any faults are to be reported in the first instance to the Academy, and maintain the cleanliness of the vehicles. 
  • Provide transport for Academy Players in a safe and lawful manner, fully compliant with the Highway Code and other regulations applying to passenger and minibus transport.  
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Valid UK Driving Licence, including D1 
  • Experience in driving 17-seater minibuses 
  • Experience in driving sports teams or young people (desirable)

job.title: Concourse Bar Staff (Casual)
job.html_description:
We are recruiting staff to serve food, confectionery, hot /cold drinks, etc.
 The shifts are approx. 4 - 6 hours home match day only (usually Saturday ko. 3.00pm.).
Staff will be expected to work at a fast pace as we only have a smalltime frame to serve the supporters.

The stadium is very busy on a match day but there is a good atmosphere within the team and you get to know the supporters.

Experience is a bonus, but not essential as full training given onsite.
  • Duties include using tills, recording information, replenishing stock, ensuring your work area is clean and tidy.
  •  You will also be expected to handle food this can include an element of cooking.
  •  You will be expected to work as part of a team as there are 22 concourse bars and kiosk around the stadium.
  • Customer care is very important to us, so you will be expected to be polite and helpful to all individual customers..
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

job.title: Bar and Waiting Staff (Casual)
job.html_description:
We are recruiting for:
  • Waiting Staff
  • Food Runners
  • Glass Collectors
  • Matchday Restaurant Supervisors (previous experience in a similar role essential)
  • Matchday Bar Supervisors (previous experience in a similar role essential)

We are looking for friendly, enthusiastic, reliable and self-motivated individuals with a hard-working positive approach, a polite manner and excellent attention to detail to work on matchdays and optional non matchday midweek shifts.
 
Previous experience within a quality, fast-paced catering environment is preferable as staff members are required to display initiative and calmness under pressure. A strong work ethic and a can-do attitude are also prerequisites.

  • A good understanding of customer service and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Be self-motivated with a proven track record of working well within a team environment. 
  • An understanding of basic food hygiene and health and safety practises.

job.title: Superstore Assistant (Casual)
job.html_description:
AFC Bournemouth is a family and community club. We strive to deliver a professional, friendly and welcoming approach in all areas of the club. We pride ourselves on hard work, passion and togetherness. 

The retail team have an exciting opportunity for multiple roles to be filled within its retail and superstore team on matchday.  You will help our customer’s/supporters find the right products to enhance their enjoyment of supporting AFC Bournemouth through the provision of exceptional customer service.

  • To personally provide excellent standards of customer service by: 
  • Displaying good listening skills to identify customer needs and meeting those needs with the right product advice. 
  • Provide relevant and comprehensive key product information to customers. 
  • Demonstrating appropriate body language - friendly, open, helpful and approachable. 
  • Confidently engaging with customers and closing sales. 
  • Looking for link selling and till add on opportunities which will increase spend per head. 
  • Understanding the importance of product presentation and general store/ retail area standards.  
  • Confident in solving customer problems quickly and effectively. 
  • Maintaining good working relationships with ‘internal stakeholders’ such as; Commercial team, Ticketing team, Accounts team, Operations Director, Chief Executive and Chairman. 
  • Providing our customers with the right products and experience so that every customer leaves inspired to enjoy supporting AFC Bournemouth. 
  • Replenish stock and maintain high standards of merchandising by ensuring that products are attractively displayed, correctly barcoded and priced with relevant Point of Sale (POS) applied. 
  • Conduct till point operations in line with guidelines. 
  • Conduct shirt printing where applicable (following training). 
  • Understanding and operation of the Touch Office EPOS system. 
  • Conduct Stock Checks as requested. 
  • Maintain vigilance in store and awareness of security issues including for example, fraudulent bank notes, credit cards, theft and suspicious behaviour; escalate security concerns to management as and when required.  
  • Demonstrating commitment to the team, supporting and helping other colleagues with tasks. 
  • Displaying a genuine and positive attitude to help team and Superstore achieve its objectives. 
  • Getting behind Retail initiatives. 
  • Carrying out additional duties as when required. 
  • Commitment to undertaking identified training requirements and putting into place learnings. 
  • Ability and willingness to acquire job related skills and knowledge through self-development and by learning from others. 
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.  
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.  
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Enjoy helping others 
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced and busy environment  
  • Experience in customer service or sales 
  • Experience in retail (not essential) 
  • Good verbal and written communication 
  • Punctual and effective time keeping

job.title: Global Partner Activation Manager
job.html_description:
The Global Partner Activation Manager is part of AFC Bournemouth’s commercial team and provides crucial support managing and growing relationships with sponsors and partners. The Manager will support the Head of Global Partner Activation and the wider team to ensure contractual sponsorship elements are fulfilled and executed efficiently for a varied list of business partners. 
 
The role holder will act as a senior point of contact within the team and help generate commercial revenue by assisting with contract renewal/refreshing, and opportunistically upselling to their assigned partners, identifying new business opportunities, improve profitability and deliver against KPI’s.  
 
This position will be based at Vitality Stadium Bournemouth and will report to the Head of Global Partner Activation.  
 
The successful candidate will be expected to attend AFC Bournemouth home, as well as non-first team home fixtures and events. This can include working evenings, weekends and public holidays as assigned. The club has various policies in place to allow for time off where this working is required. 
  • Oversee activation and ensure contractual sponsorship elements (matchday and non-matchday assets) are fulfilled/executed properly for assigned AFC Bournemouth partners.  
  • Lead on and update the activations central delivery documents which is shared with internal departments to outline contractual expectations for the season ahead. 
  • Hold meetings with other departmental managers and heads of department to ensure contracted sponsor assets are executed on time and accordingly.  
  • To activate, host and build client relationships on matchdays and non-matchdays – including The Net and club commercial events.  
  • Attend non-matchday/community events on behalf of the Club as needed to manage partner activation/involvement in those events.  
  • Serve as liaison with the Vitality Stadium operations team for all sponsorship-related topics.  
  • Be knowledgeable and trained in Salesforce.  
  • Produce monthly salesforce reports that will form part of a working group with the activations team which focuses on delivery of assets and sharing best practice. 
  • Attend contracted appearances, commercial shoots, etc. as needed at sponsor’s business, community service event and/or other specified locations.  
  • Track and report on partnership performance using metrics such as brand exposure, fan engagement and digital reach. 
  • Present inventory and data insights for assigned partner accounts at the start of the season, mid-season and end-of-season.  
  • Lead on the closed-season commercial re-branding document for the partnership programme. 
  • Drive and be responsible for developing and managing a strategic plan for all of our assigned accounts that are up for renewal/expiring.  
  • Coordinate internal creative meetings with other departments to develop innovative assets and ideas for your assigned sponsors.  
  • Bring new and compelling ideas to current partners whenever possible (i.e. - upsell opportunities). 
  • Develop and maintain excellent relationships and communication between the Partnerships department and other departments such as Brand & Design, Community Sports Trust, Marketing, Media, Operations, and Ticketing.  
  • Other duties as assigned from time to time.  
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.  
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.  

  • Degree level education (preferred.  
  • At least three years’ experience in a similar role. 
  • Business-to-business sales and account management experience  
  • Leadership and people management capability. 
  • Exceptional communication, both on the phone and face-to-face.  
  • The ability to work as a member of a dynamic team but also able to work effectively on own initiative. 

  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme.

job.plain_text_description:
The Global Partner Activation Manager is part of AFC Bournemouth’s commercial team and provides crucial support managing and growing relationships with sponsors and partners. The Manager will support the Head of Global Partner Activation and the wider team to ensure contractual sponsorship elements are fulfilled and executed efficiently for a varied list of business partners.
The role holder will act as a senior point of contact within the team and help generate commercial revenue by assisting with contract renewal/refreshing, and opportunistically upselling to their assigned partners, identifying new business opportunities, improve profitability and deliver against KPI’s.
This position will be based at Vitality Stadium Bournemouth and will report to the Head of Global Partner Activation.
The successful candidate will be expected to attend AFC Bournemouth home, as well as non-first team home fixtures and events. This can include working evenings, weekends and public holidays as assigned. The club has various policies in place to allow for time off where this working is required.
- Oversee activation and ensure contractual sponsorship elements (matchday and non-matchday assets) are fulfilled/executed properly for assigned AFC Bournemouth partners. - Lead on and update the activations central delivery documents which is shared with internal departments to outline contractual expectations for the season ahead. - Hold meetings with other departmental managers and heads of department to ensure contracted sponsor assets are executed on time and accordingly. - To activate, host and build client relationships on matchdays and non-matchdays – including The Net and club commercial events. - Attend non-matchday/community events on behalf of the Club as needed to manage partner activation/involvement in those events. - Serve as liaison with the Vitality Stadium operations team for all sponsorship-related topics. - Be knowledgeable and trained in Salesforce. - Produce monthly salesforce reports that will form part of a working group with the activations team which focuses on delivery of assets and sharing best practice. - Attend contracted appearances, commercial shoots, etc. as needed at sponsor’s business, community service event and/or other specified locations. - Track and report on partnership performance using metrics such as brand exposure, fan engagement and digital reach. - Present inventory and data insights for assigned partner accounts at the start of the season, mid-season and end-of-season. - Lead on the closed-season commercial re-branding document for the partnership programme. - Drive and be responsible for developing and managing a strategic plan for all of our assigned accounts that are up for renewal/expiring. - Coordinate internal creative meetings with other departments to develop innovative assets and ideas for your assigned sponsors. - Bring new and compelling ideas to current partners whenever possible (i.e. - upsell opportunities). - Develop and maintain excellent relationships and communication between the Partnerships department and other departments such as Brand & Design, Community Sports Trust, Marketing, Media, Operations, and Ticketing. - Other duties as assigned from time to time. - As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. - As a member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. - Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. - As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.
- Degree level education (preferred. - At least three years’ experience in a similar role. - Business-to-business sales and account management experience - Leadership and people management capability. - Exceptional communication, both on the phone and face-to-face. - The ability to work as a member of a dynamic team but also able to work effectively on own initiative.
- Free onsite parking. - Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to availability). - Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day. - Discounts at the club Superstore. - Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth. - Employee Assistance Programme - Contribution towards eye tests and glasses. - Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses. - Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme. - Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year). - Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our club social team. - Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year). - Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Graphic Designer - CLTFC
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE:                                      Graphic Designer
DEPARTMENT/GROUP:              Creative Content / Marketing
REPORTING RELATIONSHIP:    Reports to Senior Graphic Designer
STATUS:                                          Full-Time (Exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
POSITION SUMMARY:
Charlotte Football Club is seeking a talented Graphic Designer with experience producing graphics for digital and printing publications. The ideal candidate should have a strong design-forward skill set to innovative design, branding and content creation. This position will have an impact across the business with a focus on supporting marketing and brand initiatives. Graphic Designers are at the entry level and work closely with the Lead Graphic Designer on a day-to-day basis, reporting to the Creative Director.
 
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Assist the development of the visual brand identity of Charlotte Football Club and Crown Legacy Football Club, maintaining brand standards to create designs that reinforce brand style and voice across various visual touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with marketing, sponsorship, digital, ticketing, community, partnerships, stadium ops, premium services, content, technical staff, human resources, executive leadership and other departments within the organization to consistently produce requested deliverables in a timely and effective manner.
  • Work directly with the creative team on brainstorming, developing, and executing design work for the organization. These include but are not limited to marketing materials, logos, signage, environmental, installations, promotional items, advertisements, brochures, flyers, digital/social content, etc.
  • Deliver real-time content on matchdays and assist in the development of content as needed
  • Constantly develop skills and explore new creative techniques.
  • Communicate creative ideas within a collaborative environment.
  • Assist with organizing and adding to a brand asset management system.
  • Other duties as assigned.
 
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:
  • 1-2 years of experience creating various types of media including digital and print
  • Must be experienced with using Adobe’s Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of layout (i.e. typography, balance, scale) and other fundamental design techniques
  • Must be able to design projects from concept to completion and use project management software to track workflow
  • Experience in taking creative ideas and translating them to visual presentations
  • Prior knowledge of creating print ready materials for marketing and ticketing purposes.
  • Must be technically knowledgeable and savvy in a digital and Apple environment
 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Knowledge of photo editing using Lightroom or Photoshop/Camera RAW
  • Knowledge of motion design techniques using After Effects.
 
SKILLS FOR SUCCESS: 
  • Strong work ethic and attention to detail
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Works well within a collaborative, team-driven, and goal-based environment
  • Works well under pressure while maintaining a positive attitude
  • Must be a team player, reliable, and dependable with a can-do attitude
  • Must maintain complete confidentiality of privileged, and/or sensitive information
  • Must, at all times, display the character and values of the Tepper Sports & Entertainment brand
  • The ability to prioritize workload to manage time and tasks
  • Be willing to accept or be open to feedback and critique related to design projects
 
WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Must be able to work in Charlotte FC matches
  • Ability to sit at a desk and work on a computer for extended periods (up to 8 hours per day).
  • Manual dexterity to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other digital tools.
  • Occasional lifting and carrying equipment or printed materials (up to 20 pounds).
  • Visual acuity to accurately review design work, including color accuracy and detail.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors, and endure weather conditions, including rain, wind, high and low temperatures, etc.
  • Must be able to work in non-traditional settings, and work non-traditional hours including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Brand Ambassadors - Marketing CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                   Brand Ambassador - CLTFC
Department:                             Marketing
Reporting Relationship:          Reports to Marketing Activation Coordinator
Status:                                       Part-Time (Non-exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
The Crown Crew serves as brand ambassadors for Charlotte FC at events around the Carolinas including community festivals, internal club events, and more. Additionally, throughout the MLS season, the Crown Crew will play a pivotal role in enriching the matchday experience for Charlotte FC. This position is within Charlotte FC’s Marketing Department where the team will be tasked with empowering and connecting with avid, casual, and new fans.  
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Promote Charlotte FC at various events throughout the year, including fairs, festivals, sporting events, parades, and more.
  • Assist in the execution of matchday and non-matchday internal events.
  • Interact with avid, casual, and new fans to educate/inform the community of important Charlotte FC messages (specific promotions, ticket updates/offers, team information, etc.)
  • Responsible for setup and breakdown of events.
  • Create a fun, loud, and positive atmosphere at events by interacting with fans, distributing giveaways, and encouraging fans to support the team.
  • On-site support for execution of community and grassroots activations and Charlotte FC-led events.
  • Additional related duties as assigned.
 
Experience & Required Skills
  • Applicants must currently reside in the Carolinas, preferably near major metro areas or be willing to commute.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Outgoing and engaging personality
  • Knowledge of Major League Soccer, specifically Charlotte FC
  • Punctual, professional and mature demeanor
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Must be a team player
  • Spanish-speaking skills are a plus but not required
 
Work Environment and Physical Requirements
This position operates in a professional office environment and outside in a stadium facility.  Local travel to events may be required.  This position works no more than 30 hours per week. 
  • Must be able and willing to work in all Charlotte FC home matches.
  • Must be able and willing to work a minimum of one Crown Crew shift per month, including Charlotte FC home matches, grassroots activations and Charlotte FC-led events.
  • Must be able and willing to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Must be able to lift and carry at least 50 lbs.
  • Ability to remain standing/walking for 8 to 10 hours.
  • Ability to climb stairs.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors, and endure weather conditions, including rain, wind, high and low temperatures, etc.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Intern-Editorial Content
job.html_description:
Position:                                 Intern-Editorial Content CLTFC
Department:                         Digital Media
Reporting Relationship:    Reports to the Senior Director of Content/Head of Content
Status:                                     Intern/Full-Time
Duration:                                Temporary – 12 months
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.

Position Summary
Charlotte FC is actively seeking a creative and detail-oriented Editorial Content Intern to help enhance the team’s offerings from a written content standpoint. The Editorial Content Intern will report to the Senior Director of Content/Head of Content and will be responsible for providing comprehensive written coverage of both the first team and the academy throughout the season. This includes, but is not limited to, match previews, post-match reports, press conference articles and any live coverage required. This position will work closely with other departments, including Marketing, Partnerships and Communications. The position is based in Charlotte, NC.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Provide comprehensive written coverage of the first team, including all matchday coverage. 
  • Provide additional coverage for the academy team.
  • Write a minimum of four articles per week. 
  • Cover press conferences and other team-led events.
  • Create engaging editorial content that increases website views and click rate. 
  • Pitch and develop engaging story ideas.
  • Collaborate with marketing team on how to best produce content for site and app.
  • Website & app assistance with the Digital Platforms team, including but not limited to titling and posting of videos, photo albums, articles, SEO optimization, page building, etc.
  • Collaborate with social media team on how to best package articles for social distribution.
  • Collaborate with partnerships and communications leaders in meeting any sponsored obligations and shaping and bringing to life the Charlotte FC brand narrative.
  • Create and manage editorial content calendar.
  • Additional related duties as assigned.
 
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism or related field required.
  • At least 1 year experience writing or editing for a publication/website/etc.
  • Base level knowledge of the game of soccer/MLS.
  • Excellent writing skills and copywriting skills.
  • Some experience working in a CMS.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet strategic deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience ideating and pitching story ideas.
  • Experience conducting interviews. 
  • Must have a valid U.S. Driver’s license 
  • Must be flexible and available to work evenings and/or weekends, nights, and holidays.
  • Must pass pre-employment screens.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working in the sports and/or entertainment industry.
  • Experience covering a sports team in any capacity. 
  • Strong knowledge of the game of soccer/MLS. 
  • Working knowledge within website content management systems – WordPress, Drupal, pocket, custom-coded CMS, etc.
 
Skills for Success
  • Strong work ethic and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve desired outcome.
  • Ability to communicate effectively using a variety of platforms with diverse audiences.
  • Must maintain complete confidentiality of privileged, and/or sensitive information.
  • The ability to prioritize workload to manage time and tasks.
 
Physical Requirements
  • Must be able to attend all home matches.
  • Sitting at desk and computer for long periods of time.
  • Standing for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at a time.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Coordinator - Marketing Activation & Events
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE:                                      Coordinator - Marketing Activation & Events CLTFC
DEPARTMENT:                              Marketing
REPORTING RELATIONSHIP:    Reports to Manager-Marketing Activation
STATUS:                                          Full-Time (Exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
The Marketing Activation & Events Coordinator will play a critical part in the planning and execution of non-matchday events to engage our fan base at large across the Carolinas, along with delivering the best-in-class atmosphere on matchdays. This role will serve as a project management lead who helps drive a variety of projects and events from ideation to execution, ensuring efficient processes along the way via cross-functional collaboration. The Marketing Activation & Events Coordinator will also play an active role in developing the event and influencer marketing strategies for the Club. Charlotte Football Club is seeking a highly motivated, hyper-organized, innovative individual who has experience in the fan engagement/event management field.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Lead the planning and execution of assigned club-owned events and fan development activations to build fan-centric experiences that drive engagement, optimize lead generation, integrate partners, promote ticket sales, build fan loyalty, and expand the Club’s reach.
  • Support the planning and execution of large-scale, club-owned brand events.
  • Assist in the management of the club-wide event calendar.
  • Lead the planning and execution of viewing parties, in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team.
  • Lead assigned matchday fan experience marketing initiatives and provide support for others, including pre-match/post-match activations and events, and gate giveaway planning and distribution.
  • Compile, compose and circulate event and matchday schedules and recaps.
  • Collaborate with the Partnerships Marketing team to execute the official Bar Network program.
  •  Support the Grassroots Marketing & Fan Engagement team to drive influencer campaigns and activations around our events and matches.
  • Assist with management of interns and their daily roles and responsibilities.
  • Assist Grassroots Marketing team with the execution of grassroots activations and initiatives designed to drive brand awareness and grow the fan base.
  • Work alongside Marketing team to support marketing efforts and assist with collaborating on social campaigns, email marketing messaging, ticket sales promotions, and building the gameday experience.
  • Assist with day-to-day planning and project management of all programs and events.
  • Work across multiple internal departments to help execute initiatives and events.
  • Responsible for building and maintaining cross-departmental relationships.
  • Work with internal clients to drive campaign performance from ideation to execution.
  • Create and manage project plans and timelines to deliver marketing campaigns on time.
  • Track and record metrics throughout all campaigns.
  • Grow fan affinity & fan sentiment; Deliver talked about events & experiences across the enterprise both on gameday / match day and year-round.
  • Evolve existing and create new products, services & benefits that fans value.
  • Grow the brand regionally, nationally, and globally & ultimately become one of the most loved brands in sports.
  • Additional related duties as assigned.
 
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, sport management, events, or a related field required.
  • 2-3 years of marketing or events experience.
  • Must have a valid US Driver’s license.
  • Must pass pre-employment screens.
  • Account management, event management and client-facing experience preferred.
  • Soccer knowledge preferred.
 
Skills for Success
  • Strong work ethic and attention to detail.
  • Strong project management skills with analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Works well within in a collaborative, team-driven, and goal-based environment.
  • Works well under pressure while maintaining a positive attitude.
  • Must be a team player, reliable, and dependable with a can-do attitude.
  • Must maintain complete confidentiality of privileged, and/or sensitive information.
  • Ability to prioritize workload to manage time and tasks while ensuring on-time delivery.
  • Willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that requires flexibility and agility.
  • Must possess strong customer service skills.
  • Must, at all times, display the character and values of the Tepper Sports & Entertainment brand.
 
Work Environment and Physical Requirements
  • This position operates in a professional office environment and outside in a stadium
  • facility. 
  • This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, etc. 
  • Local travel to events may be required. 
  • This position typically works a minimum of 40 hours per week.
  • Must be able to work all Charlotte FC home matches.
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 30 lbs.
  • Ability to remain sitting for up to 8 hours at a desk and computer.
  • Ability to remain standing/walking for up to 8 hours.
  • Ability to climb stairs.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors, and endure weather conditions, including rain, wind, high and low temperatures, etc.
  • Must be able to work in non-traditional settings, and work non-traditional hours including nights, weekends, and holidays.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Director - Creative
job.html_description:
Position:                                           Director-Creative CLTFC
Department:                                  Creative 
Reporting Relationship:             Reports to the Head of Creative, TSE
Status:                                              Full-time (Exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
The Creative Director role is responsible for establishing and executing the Club’s creative vision through innovative and compelling storytelling that grows the fanbase and standard marketing and ticketing campaigns that drive revenue. The work consists of generating a seasonal strategy that sets the creative direction for all departments as well as making creative assets that elicit a feeling of connectivity to the club or a call to action to support the team. This person has a knack for leading brainstorming sessions for cross-departmental initiatives and objectives and providing a strong POV to ensure that the result is aligned with the standard of excellence that the brand demands and fanbase expects. Is a master of organization and calendarization and holds teammates accountable for the process that helps the department function efficiently. In the role, this leader’s understanding of the “why” behind the brand is unmatched and has a keen ability to generate ideas that helps the brand resonate and draws the attention of the sports world.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Lead creative strategy, development, and execution for all Charlotte FC brands (Charlotte FC, Crown Legacy FC, Charlotte FC Academy).
  • Manage the creation of marketing, digital, community, media, sales, promotional, editorial, and retail materials, graphic design and layout, direction and production of collateral and publication materials for team business and sporting departments.
  • Work directly with all internal teams on creative needs to make sure they are aligned to brand standards.
  • Align closely with the marketing team to develop brand campaigns and strategies to enhance the club’s digital presence.
  • Determine production requirements by reviewing internal requests and considering creative team scheduling factors.
  • Allocate resources and personnel appropriately and manage production timelines and project management of the creative team to ensure on-time delivery and a clear workflow.
  • Oversee team of creatives including all team graphic designers and team photographers.
  • Work closely with the Strategy and Analytics teams to ensure campaigns are data driven and built to yield measurable insights.
  • Work with all external vendors in the production of any brand materials
  • Work directly with the social and content teams to make sure all content is aligned to brand guidelines and narrative to ensure consistent quality and storytelling.
  • Improve quality results by studying, evaluating, and re-designing processes and recommending changes to design, photography, and other creative choices across the brand.
  • Stay on the pulse of new market trends, concepts and creative strategies to assess how our club brand can continue to be ambitious in the marketplace.
  • Actively contributes to the content team's overall production output and strategy in graphic design.
  • Collaborate with and empower creative team to execute creative requests and develop additional campaigns and creative concepts, maximizing productivity and quality of work.
  • Oversee creation of visual identities for Club campaigns, events, and programs and assists as a hands-on-contributor.
  • Provide art direction and feedback for contracted designers, photographers, agencies, and vendors; using personal internal network to provide freelancers in all graphic and photo spaces.
  • Occasional hands on photography support of tentpole moments, key matches, etc. 
  • Creatively help solve business problems for a variety of stakeholders and adapt quickly as business needs constantly evolve.
  • Work directly with players and ensure that they are perceived in the best light from a graphics and photography perspective.
  • Other duties assigned as necessary.
 
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
  • 5+ years of experience with creating content with emphasis on digital media.
  • 3+ years of experience managing a team of content creators
  • Must have a strong understanding of the latest digital, social media, and video production trends shaping professional sports including the cross-section of sports, pop culture, music, fashion, art, and entertainment.
  • Must be able to take projects from concept to completion while collaborating with key stake holders.
  • Technically knowledgeable and savvy in a digital environment
  • Must be flexible and available to work evenings and/or weekends, nights, and holidays.
  • Must pass pre-employment screens.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experienced in graphic design, motion graphics, Photoshop, and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bilingual in English & Spanish
  • Experience working in the soccer, sports, and/or entertainment industry.
 
Skills for Success
  • Accustomed to working in a fast-paced environment with ability to multi-task and collaborate.
  • Must be able to take design project from concept to completion.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must exhibit professionalism when interacting with staff, members of the media, and players/coaches.
  • Must organize personal workflows so projects are easily shared between teammates.
  • Must exhibit professionalism as it relates to budget management and meeting deadlines.
  • Must adapt, with minimal advance notice, to changes in how business is conducted, and work is accomplished.
  • Must be able to handle confidential, privileged, and/or sensitive information with carefully and with sensitivity.
  • Must possess excellent organizational skills.
 
Physical Requirements
  • Standing
  • Sitting and working at desk on a computer
  • Walking throughout the stadium
  • Lift at least 25 pounds
 
Work Environment
This job operates in a professional office environment (mostly office environment, outside in a stadium facility at times which may include inclement weather conditions) and remotely as assigned by management and based on current business needs.  This position may require travel at times.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Coordinator - Digital Platforms CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                   Digital Platforms Coordinator – CLTFC 
Department:                           Marketing
Reporting Relationship:      Reports to Senior Manager, Digital Platforms 
Status:                                       Full-Time (Exempt)    

About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.

Position Summary
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. Owned by David Tepper, Charlotte FC is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, including Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers.
Charlotte FC is looking for an experienced Digital Platforms Coordinator to manage key components of two of the Club's digital platforms, the website and mobile app. This role will collaborate closely with both the marketing & digital content teams and report to the Senior Manager of Digital Platforms. The primary goals of this role are to enhance user experiences on the web and app and support in improving key performance indicators (KPIs). The coordinator will focus on creating personalized journeys for fans to deepen their engagement with the brand, as well as contribute to developing, innovating, and optimizing fan experiences on these platforms.
 
Primary Responsibilities
·         Day-to-day support on Charlotte FC digital platforms – first team websites & app – including but not limited to posting videos, photo albums, articles, SEO optimization, page building, etc.
·         Work with the larger marketing team to ideate and integrate new platforms and products to enhance the user experience, increase fans’ overall knowledge, and open new revenue streams
·         Create lead generation forms and campaign landing pages with relevant tracking tags for source attribution
·         Support and execute sponsored activations and digital experiences for fan engagement across platforms
·         Provide detailed analytics and KPI reports on site performance, with recommended actions for several stakeholders for precise responses and improvement
·         Collaborate with partnerships to create sponsored and engaging features that enhance the brand to generate leads, and use the digital platforms to create custom user journeys for fans to become more engaged with the brand
·         Matchday web and app content management
·         Other duties as assigned by manager
 
Minimum Qualifications
·         BA/BS degree in marketing, business, or communications 
·         1-3 years’ experience running large-scale websites or apps for a professional organization (previous sports team experience is a plus, but not mandatory)  
·         Experience creating compelling digital experiences - on websites and mobile apps 
·         Knowledge of website back-end content management systems
·         Full understanding of the MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) 
·         Experience with page building and UI/UX best practices  
·         Must pass pre-employment screens
 
Preferred Qualifications
·         Proven experience using data-driven insights to understand what is working and what needs improvement within the digital space
·         Complete working knowledge within website content management systems – WordPress, Drupal, pocket, custom-coded CMS, Forge, etc.
·         Editorial or long-form exposure experience
·         Familiarity with the overall mobile app ecosystem and can optimize user experience on mobile app platforms
·         Experience within a fast-paced industry
 
Essential Functions
·         Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve the desired outcome
·         Self-starter with a hands-on approach, good instincts for prioritization, and the ability to work under a high-pressure, fast-paced environment
·         Strong analytical, project management, and communication skills
·         Agile and able to respond effectively to the rapidly changing needs of a fast-paced / high-growth organization
·         Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment
·         Must be able to handle confidential, privileged, and/or sensitive information with carefully and with sensitivity.
 
Physical Requirements
·         Ability to sit, walk, and stand for extended periods of time throughout the day.
·         Ability to focus on projects for periods of time.
·         Role routinely uses standard office equipment 
 
Work Environment
This job operates in a professional office environment (mostly office environment, outside in a stadium facility at times, which may include inclement weather conditions) and remotely as assigned by management and based on current business needs.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.
