job.title: Manager-Marketing Activation & Events CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                 Manager-Marketing Activation & Events, CLTFC
Department:                         Marketing
Reporting Relationship:    Reports to Head of Marketing, CLTFC
Status:                                     Full-Time (Exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
The Manager, Marketing Activation & Events, is a lead marketing role for Charlotte FC and a key member of the Club’s leadership team. The role oversees events, experiential marketing, influencer, and other targeted tactics designed to grow CLTFC awareness and fandom. Priorities include developing and executing comprehensive marketing activation strategies to strengthen the brand; fueling fandom and engagement through compelling campaigns; and capturing new potential fans through marketing tactics designed to meet potential fans where they are. This person thrives on building and maintaining strong working alliances with other leaders, internally and externally. The role requires constant communication with teammates in ticketing, partnerships, facility operations, community engagement, communications, and soccer operations, along with external vendors and partners to host and execute marketing activations and events. The Manager, Marketing Activation & Events, is naturally curious about what will take the CLTFC brand to the next level and is an expert collaborator with a history of breakthrough activations.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Lead the development of large-scale, club-owned brand events.
  • Work with the Ticketing team to execute Season Ticket Member appreciation programs and support the planning and delivery of other departmental events to ensure consistent brand representation. 
  • Manage the club-wide event calendar, including management of promotional items to support key dates and events.
  • Lead the strategy and planning for viewing parties, in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team.
  • Lead matchday fan experience marketing initiatives including pre-match/post-match activations and events, and gate giveaway planning and distribution in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team. 
  • Lead influencer campaigns and activations around our events and matches.
  • Serve as the central point of contact for the club-wide apparel ordering program.
  • Lead and manage a team of one coordinator and one intern to support department efforts.
  • Grow fan affinity & fan sentiment; Deliver talked about events & experiences across the enterprise both on gameday / match day and year-round. 
  • Evolve existing and create new products, services & benefits that fans value. 
  • Grow the brand regionally, nationally, and globally & ultimately become one of the most loved brands in sports. 
  • Work with internal clients to drive campaign performance from ideation to execution. 
  • Work alongside Head of Marketing and other Marketing leaders to develop comprehensive annual marketing strategies, including promotional calendars and media strategies with the ticket sales team that support campaigns, tell the brand story, and focus on call to action. 
  • Build experiential lead generation campaigns that drive ticket sales.
  • Establish and monitor staff performance, development goals and department priorities 
  • Partner with Community Outreach team to develop collaborative events and live engagement strategies. 
  • Other duties assigned as necessary. 

Qualifications, Skills and Education Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, sports, business management, communications, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in marketing activation, experiential marketing, events, or related fields.
  • 1 - 2 years+ direct managerial experience
  • Knowledge of soccer, professional soccer leagues, and MLS
  • Native Spanish language speaker (bilingual English + Spanish) strongly preferred
  • Sports & entertainment, property, or agency experience.
  • Collaborative Business Partner
 
Leadership, Work Ethic, and Culture
  • Strong leadership skills and business acumen.
  • Exhibits a team-oriented approach, always prioritizing team above self.
  • High energy leader with a strong work ethic and a desire to enhance the culture of the organization.
  • Demonstrates commitment to the organization’s vision, mission, and core values.
  • Projects a positive image as well as inspiring trust and credibility with stakeholders.
  • Embraces the start-up nature of the early brand stage of the organization.
  • Demonstrates ability to adapt and adjust to changing needs of the business while demonstrating a positive attitude.
 
Judgment, Decision-Making and Sense of Urgency
  • Demonstrates exceptional judgment in carrying out duties.
  • Demonstrates strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Able to clearly define complex issues; identifies and discusses potential solutions with key stakeholders; shapes opinions and works to build consensus as appropriate; uses broad knowledge and common sense.
  • Acts with purpose and urgency in making timely recommendations and decisions.
 
Communication
  • Communicates clearly and effectively; possesses excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Keeps leadership informed of important issues/aspects of the marketing performance.
  • Uses effective communication tactics regarding the manner of communication, tone, and channel in all circumstances.
  • Embraces an inclusive style of communication; actively listens and acknowledges conflicting points of view and treats all points of view with respect.
 
Work Environment
This job operates mostly in an office environment and outside in a stadium facility at times which may include inclement weather conditions.  This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.  Some travel may be required to away games or for other business purposes. 
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Intern - Marketing
job.html_description:
Position:                                  Intern -Marketing CLTFC 
Department:                          Marketing
Reporting Relationship:     Reports to Marketing Manager
Status:                                     Intern (Non-exempt)
Duration:                               Temporary - Runs through the end of the 2026 Charlotte FC season, to include potential playoffs.
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
Charlotte Football Club is actively seeking a Marketing Intern to support the marketing and promotion of the Charlotte FC brand, including single game tickets and season tickets, through ideation and execution of marketing campaigns, matchday activations, grassroots activations, tentpole events, and fan engagement opportunities.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Work across multiple internal departments to help execute marketing initiatives and events.
  • Assist with day-to-day planning and project management of all marketing programs and events.
  • Assist in execution of experiential fan engagement events & opportunities on both matchday and non-matchdays including but not limited to vendor management, setup and breakdown, part-time staff management, guest acquisition, ideation and research.
  • Assist in providing a specialized level of customer service to clients, members and vendors, including day-to-day operations, written correspondence, phone calls, account maintenance, appointment scheduling, follow-up, and inquiries, etc.
  • Assist in daily operations of the Marketing Department, including administrative and clerical support, filing, data entry, storage, deliveries, storage inventory management, etc.
  • Assist with gate giveaway planning and distribution.
  • Assist in building brand awareness across the Carolinas and beyond.
  • Additional related duties as assigned.
 
Minimum Qualifications
  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Must have a valid US Driver’s license.
  • Must pass pre-employment screens.
  • Must be proficient in Excel, Word and Outlook, including the ability to merge documents and manage multi-page spreadsheets.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bilingual or multi-lingual skills is a plus.
  • Experience working in the soccer, sports, and/or entertainment industry.
 
Skills for Success
  • Strong work ethic and attention to detail.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Works well within in a collaborative, team-driven, and goal-based environment.
  • Works well under pressure while maintaining a positive attitude.
  • Must be a team player, reliable, and dependable with a can-do attitude.
  • Must maintain complete confidentiality of privileged, and/or sensitive information.
  • Must, at all times, display the character and values of the Tepper Sports & Entertainment brand.
  • The ability to prioritize workload to manage time and tasks.
 
Work Environment and Physical Requirements
This position operates in a professional office environment and outside in a stadium facility. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, etc. Local travel to events may be required.  This position typically works approximately 40 hours per week. 
  • Must be able to work in all Charlotte FC home matches.
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to remain sitting for up to 8 hours at a desk and computer.
  • Ability to remain standing/walking for up to 8 hours.
  • Ability to climb stairs.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors, and endure weather conditions, including rain, wind, high and low temperatures, etc.
  • Must be able to work in non-traditional settings, and work non-traditional hours including nights, weekends, and holidays.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Intern Ticket Operations & Services
job.html_description:
Position:                             Ticket Operations & Services Intern
Department:                     Ticket Operations
Status:                                 Intern (Non-Exempt)
Duration:                            Temporary - Runs through the end of the 2026 Charlotte FC season, to include potential playoffs.
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
This position will support the Ticket Operations and Ticket Services departments with day-to-day tasks, including administrative duties such as filing, answering phones, interacting with other departments, and overall contributing to the organization’s function.  The position will comprehensively overview all Ticket Operations/Services areas.
 
Primary Responsibilities: 
Ticket Operations Responsibilities:
  • Gain familiarity and utilize the Ticketmaster system including Archtics, TM1 and Account Manager
  • Assist in the processing and establishment of season, group, and single match accounts. This is done through new sales, transfers, exchanges, and upgrades of tickets.
  • Provide support in the areas of ticket resolution, customer service, and walk-up sales on Match Days in the box office for Charlotte FC and Crown Legacy FC. 
 
Ticket & Premium Services Responsibilities:
  • Responsible for assisting fans with inbound inquiries by phone, email, and other communication platforms.
  • Assist with current season ticket member accounts by being the liaison between the club and the fan.
  • Execute initiatives outside of the office on both game days and at non-gameday events.
  • Assist Premium Services team in execution of match day duties, Suite and Suite Club member events, concierge staff duties and specialized member amenity programs.
  • Assist in various logistics required for stadium events, including but not limited to:
  • General Setup (ex - roster cards, suite inspections)
  • Prepare Platinum Access Lobby staff folders.
  • Suite Visits
  • Identifying any event maintenance needs
 
Sales Responsibilities:
  • Reaching out to group contacts to sell Theme Nights and Group Initiatives with Charlotte FC and Crown Legacy FC.
  • Assisting the Groups sales team on Group Initiatives on both gamedays and events held outside of gameday for Charlotte FC and Crown Legacy FC.
  • Attending all sales and service training sessions.
  • Assist in Charlotte FC Sales events for Season Tickets, Group Tickets, and Service events. 
 
Additional Responsibilities:
  • Administrative duties include filing, answering phones, and providing overall support to the Ticketing Department.
  • Manual labor is sometimes required (in-suite/ gift or supply delivery, event implementation, etc.)
  • Assist with all aspects of Tepper Sports and Entertainment including Bank of America Stadium events, Crown Legacy FC and Carolina Panthers games as needed. 
 
Minimum Qualifications:
  • A college degree or actively pursuing a college degree.
  • Must be flexible to work evenings and/or weekends and all Charlotte Football Club. and Stadium events, including events held on weekends, nights, and holidays.
  • Must pass Pre-Employment Screenings.
 
Essential Functions:
  • Strength in teamwork, professionalism, and time management.
  • Must possess excellent oral, written, organizational and proofreading skills.
  • Positive and mature attitude, team player, self-motivated and responsible.
  • Detail Oriented. Must be able to multi-task without frustration.
 
Physical Requirements
  • Standing for extended periods of time
  • Sitting and working at a desk on a computer
  • Walking throughout the stadium, which may include stairs.
  • Lift at least 30 pounds
 
Work Environment:
This job responsibility description is a broad overview of the position. This does not limit expected contributions to the organization. The Charlotte Football Club organization is based upon a teamwork type atmosphere.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

Position:                                    Ticket Operations Coordinator
Department:                             Ticket Operations
Reporting Relationship:        Reports to the Ticket Operations Manager
Status:                                         Full-Time (Exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.

Summary
The Ticket Operations Coordinator position is primarily responsible for assisting in the management of the Charlotte FC ticketing system and assisting with the oversight of the box office on a daily and event day basis.  The ideal candidate has proven experience in ticket operations and a strong desire to provide the very best customer service.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Assist in creating manifests, events, plans and price codes for all Bank of America Stadium events.
  • Provides support to the Ticket Sales Department by maintaining accurate seat inventory, accurate pricing information and ensuring that the completion of new season ticket sales is done in a timely manner.
  • Ensures that all seasons, individual event, and group tickets are paid in full and fulfilled accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Serves as lead in the recruitment of all Ticket Operations game day staff.
  • Assist with all functions of the Ticket Office including, but not limited to, ticket sales, phone calls, written correspondence and programs, etc.
  • Serve as liaison for special event promoters for the Ticket Operations Department.
  • Become familiar with the Ticketmaster system including customer service to season ticket accounts, as well as selling single game tickets.
  • Administrative duties including filing, answering phones, and providing support to the Ticketing department.
  • Other duties as assigned by the Director and/or Manager of Ticket Operations.
 
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • At least 2 years of ticket operations experience
  • Experience in building events, plans and price codes on Ticketmaster
  • Must be flexible to work evenings and/or weekends and all Charlotte FC and Stadium events, including events held on weekends, nights, and holidays
  • Must pass pre-employment screens
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Preferred experience with Archtics, TM Host ticketing systems, TM Painter, as well as the TMone online portal.
 
Essential Functions
  • Strength in teamwork, professionalism, and time management
  • Must possess excellent oral, written, organizational and proofreading skills
  • Must, at all times, display the character and values of the Tepper Sports and Entertainment brand
  • Must be detail-oriented and must be able to multi-task while managing time successfully
  • Works well under pressure and flexible when necessary
  • Must be able to handle confidential, privileged, and/or sensitive information with carefully and with sensitivity
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve desired outcome
  • Self-starter with a hands-on approach, good instincts for prioritization and the ability to work under a high-pressure, fast-paced environment
 
Physical Requirements
  • Standing for extended periods of time
  • Sitting and working at desk on a computer
  • Walking throughout the stadium which may include stairs
  • Lift at least 30 pounds
 
Work Environment
  • This job operates mostly in an office environment and outside in a stadium facility at times which may include inclement weather conditions.

job.title: Coordinator, League Operations
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club seeks a Coordinator, League Operations, to join our team. Reporting to the Director of League Operations, this individual will play a key role in delivering a best-in-class experience for players, coaches and club partners while ensuring the successful execution of league operations. The ideal candidate is highly organized and customer focused. By providing exceptional service, supporting day-to-day league administration, and building strong relationships with participants and stakeholders, this role will help drive the continued growth, quality, and operational excellence of Chicagoland Indoor Soccer League. 

Job Responsibilities:  
  • Support league operations, including scheduling, registration, communication, and game-day management on site during the weekends (December-March). 
  • Organize registration and administrative requirements to ensure a seamless participant experience for league of over 1000 teams and 14,000 participants.
  • Collaborate with director of league operations to ensure league and tournaments are appropriately staffed and operationally supported.  
  • Ensure all programs operate within club risk management standards while maintaining strong relationships with clubs, league partners, and external organizations.
  • Manage new and existing partnerships with key youth and community soccer stakeholders. 
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications: 
  • 2+ years of relevant youth soccer work experience. 
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. 
  • Superior organizational skills.  
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams. 
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including weekends from late November through mid-March.

Preferred Qualifications:  
  • Bachelor’s degree in sports, recreation or similar field of study. 
  • Knowledge of the U.S. youth soccer landscape, particularly in Chicagoland.
  • Knowledge of youth sports registration software (LeagueApps). 

Compensation: 
  • This role offers an hourly range rate of $20.00- $22.00.
  • This role is classified as Part-time, non-exempt.
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience.

Please note: 
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.  
 
MLS Privacy Policy:  
  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.title: Ticket Operations Manager (SeatGeek)
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview:
This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of ticket operations at Chicago Fire FC. As the club transitions to SeatGeek Unify and prepares to open McDonald's Park in Summer 2028, the Ticket Operations Manager will serve as the Senior Director of Ticket Operations' right hand in executing one of the most significant ticketing transformations in professional sports. This role will serve as the club's primary SeatGeek Unify specialist, leading event builds, inventory management, reporting, ticketing integrations, and system optimization while supporting Ticketmaster Archtics during the club's remaining events at Soldier Field and SeatGeek Stadium. Along the way, you'll gain broad experience across the industry's two leading ticketing platforms, helping build a well-rounded ticket operations skill set that will serve you throughout your career.

Working cross-functionally with Ticket Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance, Stadium Operations, and Box Office teams, this individual will help deliver a seamless ticketing experience for fans while developing scalable operational processes that support the club's next era. The role will also oversee matchday ticket operations, including the management of box office staff and temporary event personnel, ensuring exceptional execution and customer service across every event.

Job Responsibilities: 
  • Partner with the Senior Director of Ticket Operations and Revenue teams to support the phased sales campaign for McDonald's Park, optimizing inventory strategy, pricing configurations, and system readiness to deliver a best-in-class purchasing experience for fans and maximize revenue opportunities.
  • Build and develop a strong working relationship with SeatGeek Client Support Staff as Chicago Fire FC makes the transition to SeatGeek Unify at McDonald’s Park.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Ticketmaster Client Support staff regarding software management, troubleshooting system issues, event creation, event marketing and financial reporting as Chicago Fire FC continues to play at Soldier Field and SeatGeek Stadium.
  • Build and maintain a positive working relationship with all promoters for special events at McDonald’s Park.
  • Develop, automate and maintain operational, financial and business intelligence reports that support Ticket Sales, Service, Finance, Stadium Operations and MLS reporting requirements.Facilitate a complex network of payment plans, investigate and respond to any chargebacks related to ticket payments and work closely with the Ticket Services department to ensure account compliance.
  • Assist with the building of price codes, plans, promo codes, and other programming needs in SeatGeek Unify and Ticketmaster Archtics.
  • Assist in the set-up, trouble shooting and maintaining of events in SeatGeek Unify and Ticketmaster Archtics.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all 3rd party ticket relationships, including but not limited to Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, various parking operators, Fevo, Vet Tix and more.
  • Oversee the implementation of new 3rd party ticketing integrations and maximizing the potential of all new sales campaigns.
  • Serve as a resource for all departments as it relates to SeatGeek and Ticketmaster products.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows through automation, system enhancements and cross-functional process improvements.
  • Help maintain a culture that’s focused on a high standard of speed, efficiency and customer service.
  •  Maintain a positive, high-performance culture in the Ticket Operations department, while building a positive rapport with all other departments on a daily basis.
  • Act as a higher point of contact for all elevated customer service occurrences on match day.
  • Schedule and coordinate all event day box office staff with the local ticketing union.
  • Completion of other duties as assigned with a team-player mindset.  

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 4+ years of professional ticket operations experience, with demonstrated expertise in SeatGeek Unify strongly preferred.Advanced proficiency of Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
  •  Experience with high level, time sensitive reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build strong cross-functional relationships across multiple departments and external partners.Must have the ability to work independently without supervision, be self-directed and demonstrate initiative.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and meeting critical deadlines.
  • Strong leadership skills, specifically working with sales teams, promoters and box office staff.
  • Experience working with promotors and special events.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.

Compensation: 
  • This role offers a salary range of $60,000 - $70,000 
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt.
  • This role is commission and bonus eligible based on individual and club-wide goals. 
  • Additional benefits and perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers. 

Please note: 
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.  
 
MLS Privacy Policy:  
  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you. 
 
Position Overview: 
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a dedicated First Team Administrator to join our team full time, fixed-term position beginning on August 2026 and ending on December 2026. You will be responsible for all aspects of team operations including but not limited to staff and player communication, budgeting, player registration, & trip planning. We are searching for someone with the ability to work independently and in a team/collaborative work environment as required along with strong organizational, interpersonal, analytical, and planning skills. The First Team Administrator will report to the General Manager.
 
Job Responsibilities:
  • Organize & coordinate all aspects of home game operations for the First Team (meals, credentials, match coordination meetings, locker room countdowns, etc) and communicate accordingly
  • Budget for, organize, & coordinate all aspects of MLS and all other relevant competitions’ (US Open Cup, Leagues Cup, etc)  away trip travel which includes organizing hotels, buses, flights, credentials, DMR, etc and communicate accordingly
  • Budget for, organize, & coordinate all aspects of First Team preseason trips
  • Manage daily / weekly / monthly communication via Teamworks with players and staff regarding training & travel schedules & important information as needed
  • Support with execution of team events and First Team family events
  • Manage player registrations for all competitions to adhere to all rules & regulations
  • Collaborate with Second Team and Academy team operations staff to organize player movement across teams
  • Collaborate with the Federations for players call-ups
  • Support management of First Team operations budget in collaboration with the General Manager
  • Completion of other duties as assigned
 
Qualifications: 
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Team Operations or a similar role 
  • Strong proven experience in Team Operations/Administration 
  • Conversational Spanish language fluency preferred
  • Must display a strong work ethic and desire to build a career in professional sports
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Travel and ability to work weekends/flexible hours required
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Strong proven experience in Team Operations/Administration
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) communication skills preferred
 
Compensation:
  • This role offers a salary range of $75,000.00 - $82,500.00 annually (prorated over the duration of employment)
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt.
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals.
  • Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers.

Position Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a dedicated First Team Administrator to join our team full time, fixed-term position beginning on August 2026 and ending on December 2026. You will be responsible for all aspects of team operations including but not limited to staff and player communication, budgeting, player registration, & trip planning. We are searching for someone with the ability to work independently and in a team/collaborative work environment as required along with strong organizational, interpersonal, analytical, and planning skills. The First Team Administrator will report to the General Manager.
Job Responsibilities:

- Minimum of 3 years of experience in Team Operations or a similar role - Strong proven experience in Team Operations/Administration - Conversational Spanish language fluency preferred - Must display a strong work ethic and desire to build a career in professional sports - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills - Ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment - Travel and ability to work weekends/flexible hours required - Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays

- Strong proven experience in Team Operations/Administration - Bilingual (English/Spanish) communication skills preferred

job.title: Manager, Accounting
job.html_description:
The Chicago Fire Football Club (Chicago Fire FC) is an American professional soccer club that competes in Major League Soccer (MLS), the top U.S. domestic league. Founded on October 8, 1997, on the 126th anniversary of the Great Chicago Fire, the Club began play in 1998 as one of the League’s first expansion franchises. The Fire have won six major domestic titles, including the 1998 MLS Cup; the 1998, 2000, 2003, and 2006 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cups; as well as the 2003 MLS Supporters’ Shield.

The Club recently announced plans to build a $750M+ privately financed downtown stadium in Chicago in 2028. The stadium will anchor Chicago’s newest neighborhood, the 78, a 62-acre development and entertainment district located along the Chicago River just south of Roosevelt Road. For more information on our bold plans, visit DearChicago.com.

Additionally, the Club recently opened the state-of-the-art $100M Endeavor Health Performance Center in March 2025 that has set the standard for North American training facilities. With tremendous growth and expansion, the Club is laying the foundation for an audacious and ambitious vision that will transform the brand and the company in the coming years.

At Chicago Fire FC, we’re on a mission to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago by delivering excellence on and off the pitch to ensure a world-class experience. As a club we let our values guide everything we do: we uphold uncompromising integrity, show respect for all at all times, never settle for less, constantly innovate, and hold ourselves relentlessly accountable.

Position Overview:
The Accounting Manager will be a key member of the Finance and Accounting team and be responsible for the execution of the accounting functions and operations for Chicago Fire Football Holdings, LLC, its various subsidiaries and related not-for-profit entities. They will take the lead in review and close procedures for monthly and annual closes, oversee the accounts payable and accounts receivable processes and be heavily involved in annual audits and tax preparation.

This role will report directly to the Controller and be responsible for managing a Staff Accountant. The right candidate is personable, diligent, and effective at finding solutions and is an outstanding communicator.
 
Job Responsibilities:
  • Lead the month end close process by efficiently assigning and reviewing work and providing hands on preparation/review of the financial statement consolidation
  • Responsible for the scheduling and supervision of day-to-day duties of a staff accountant, as well as assessing and conducting annual performance reviews, quarterly performance check-ins and providing coaching and mentoring to accounting staff as needed
  • Ensures proper revenue and expense recognition
  • Responsible for the review and approval of adjusting and general journal entries before posting to the general and subsidiary ledger accounts
  • Responsible for the analysis of balance sheet accounts and related account reconciliations
  • Work with accounting staff and department stakeholders to manage open accruals
  • Maintain and monitor policies and procedures for accounting and finance functions to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable standards and regulations
  • Evaluate, identify, and improve areas of potential exposure and internal control weakness
  • Proficient in accounting and finance research; providing updates and recommendations on necessary treatment and reporting changes as rules and regulations change
  • Support the annual audit process and assist with tax preparation activities, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion
  • This role requires being on-site 4-5 days per week
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting and/or finance or relevant experience 
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Prior managerial or staff oversight experience
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, specific to Excel and Outlook
  • Very strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to establish and maintain interdepartmental relationships
  • High level of initiative with ability to prioritize, multitask, and manage projects
  •  Experience with financial statement consolidations and not-for-profit accounting is preferred, but not required
  • NetSuite or similar cloud-based ERP software experience is a plus
  •  CPA license a plus

Compensation: 
  • This role offers a salary range of $80,000-$95,000
  • The final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club wide goals 
  • Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers 

Please note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. 
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination.   The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
    • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.    

 MLS Privacy Policy: 
  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

 Job Overview:
The Director of Special Projects serves as a strategic partner and execution lead for the Club’s executive leadership team, driving high-impact initiatives across every aspect of the business, including operations, stadium development, finance, commercial strategy, ticketing, marketing, corporate partnerships, and organizational planning. Rather than advising from the outside, this role is responsible for turning ideas into action, leading cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring the organization's most important priorities move forward. The successful candidate will have significant exposure to senior leadership and take ownership of projects that directly influence the future of Chicago Fire FC and McDonald’s Park.
 
The Club operates in a very fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and new opportunities emerge regularly. The Director must be highly adaptable, comfortable moving between strategic thinking and detailed execution, and willing to take ownership of work well beyond a traditional job description. This candidate is also highly analytical, exercises sound business judgment, has exceptional communication skills and executive presence, and has a relentless bias for execution. Additionally, it is critical that the individual respects and maintains strict confidentiality standards, as they will be getting access to the Club’s most sensitive information. This is a rare opportunity for someone looking to transition from consulting or another analytical environment into an operating role with broad impact and future leadership potential.
  
Job Responsibilities:
Enterprise Projects
  • Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution. 
  • Translate executive priorities into actionable project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability structures. 
  • Drive accountability across departments to ensure initiatives remain on schedule. 
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and key decision points while proactively removing obstacles. 
  • Develop key performance indicators and reporting mechanisms to measure progress against organizational priorities. 
  • Evaluate strategic, operational, and financial risks associated with key business decisions and provide recommendations to leadership. 
  • Identify root causes of organizational challenges and develop practical, data-driven solutions that improve business performance. 
  • Step into emerging priorities requiring immediate analysis, leadership, or execution. 
Strategic Analysis
  • Build financial models, business cases, operating plans, and executive analyses. 
  • Develop strategic recommendations that support executive decision-making. 
  • Create executive-level presentations, briefing materials, dashboards, and analytical tools. 
  • Distill complex or incomplete information into concise, actionable recommendations. 
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive benchmarks, and emerging opportunities. 
Executive Partnership
  • Partner directly with senior executives on many of the Club's highest priority initiatives. 
  • Increase the capacity of the executive leadership team by independently leading complex projects and coordinating cross-functional execution. 
  • Prepare executive presentations and briefing materials for leadership meetings, ownership updates, Board of Governors meetings, and other high-profile internal and external engagements. 
  • Build alignment across departments with differing priorities while maintaining momentum toward organizational objectives. 
  • Translate executive decisions into actionable next steps and ensure consistent follow-through. 
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner by bringing well-reasoned perspectives, thoughtful recommendations, and sound judgment to strategic discussions. 
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism while working on confidential or highly sensitive initiatives. 
Stadium & Organizational Initiatives
  • Lead initiatives supporting the development, opening, and long-term operation of McDonald's Park.
  • Assist with organizational planning, operating models, vendor evaluations, business planning, and new strategic initiatives. 
  • Support enterprise-wide initiatives that improve how the organization operates and scales. 
  • Take ownership of additional special projects as organizational priorities evolve.
 
 Qualifications:
  • 2-5 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, investment banking, project management, or another highly analytical environment. 
  • Experience at a top-tier management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, Bain, or BCG, is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to build executive-level presentations, financial models, dashboards, and analytical tools with minimal direction.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
  • Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to distill complex analyses into concise, compelling recommendations for executive leadership and ownership.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to quickly build credibility and trust with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with frequently changing priorities.
  • High degree of adaptability and comfort taking on unfamiliar or loosely defined assignments.
  • Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to take ownership well beyond a traditional job description.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain strict confidentiality while working on sensitive business matters.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  
Ideal Candidate Profile:
The Club is looking for someone who thrives in an ambitious, collaborative, and highly dynamic environment. The successful candidate is someone who:
  • Thrives in a very fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and no two days look the same. 
  • Enjoys solving ambiguous business problems that do not have obvious answers and comfortable operating without complete information.
  • Demonstrates maturity, humility, and sound judgment when working with senior leaders on confidential or high-profile initiatives. 
  • Is equally comfortable developing strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute. 
  • Can influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority. 
  • Operates with urgency while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. 
  • Is intellectually curious and eager to quickly learn unfamiliar businesses, industries, and functions. 
  • Takes initiative rather than waiting for direction and proactively identifies opportunities to improve the organization. 
  • Passion for professional sports and interest in building an operating career within the industry.
  
Compensation:
  • This role offers a salary range of $90,000 - $100,000. Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as full-time, exempt.
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals.
  • Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website.
 
 Please note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. 
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination.   The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.
As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.
Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.
Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special.
At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.
If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.
Job Overview:
The Director of Special Projects serves as a strategic partner and execution lead for the Club’s executive leadership team, driving high-impact initiatives across every aspect of the business, including operations, stadium development, finance, commercial strategy, ticketing, marketing, corporate partnerships, and organizational planning. Rather than advising from the outside, this role is responsible for turning ideas into action, leading cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring the organization's most important priorities move forward. The successful candidate will have significant exposure to senior leadership and take ownership of projects that directly influence the future of Chicago Fire FC and McDonald’s Park.
The Club operates in a very fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and new opportunities emerge regularly. The Director must be highly adaptable, comfortable moving between strategic thinking and detailed execution, and willing to take ownership of work well beyond a traditional job description. This candidate is also highly analytical, exercises sound business judgment, has exceptional communication skills and executive presence, and has a relentless bias for execution. Additionally, it is critical that the individual respects and maintains strict confidentiality standards, as they will be getting access to the Club’s most sensitive information. This is a rare opportunity for someone looking to transition from consulting or another analytical environment into an operating role with broad impact and future leadership potential.
Job Responsibilities:
Enterprise Projects
- Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution. - Translate executive priorities into actionable project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability structures. - Drive accountability across departments to ensure initiatives remain on schedule. - Identify risks, dependencies, and key decision points while proactively removing obstacles. - Develop key performance indicators and reporting mechanisms to measure progress against organizational priorities. - Evaluate strategic, operational, and financial risks associated with key business decisions and provide recommendations to leadership. - Identify root causes of organizational challenges and develop practical, data-driven solutions that improve business performance. - Step into emerging priorities requiring immediate analysis, leadership, or execution.
Strategic Analysis
- Build financial models, business cases, operating plans, and executive analyses. - Develop strategic recommendations that support executive decision-making. - Create executive-level presentations, briefing materials, dashboards, and analytical tools. - Distill complex or incomplete information into concise, actionable recommendations. - Conduct research on industry trends, competitive benchmarks, and emerging opportunities.
Executive Partnership
- Partner directly with senior executives on many of the Club's highest priority initiatives. - Increase the capacity of the executive leadership team by independently leading complex projects and coordinating cross-functional execution. - Prepare executive presentations and briefing materials for leadership meetings, ownership updates, Board of Governors meetings, and other high-profile internal and external engagements. - Build alignment across departments with differing priorities while maintaining momentum toward organizational objectives. - Translate executive decisions into actionable next steps and ensure consistent follow-through. - Serve as a trusted thought partner by bringing well-reasoned perspectives, thoughtful recommendations, and sound judgment to strategic discussions. - Exercise discretion and professionalism while working on confidential or highly sensitive initiatives.
Stadium & Organizational Initiatives
- Lead initiatives supporting the development, opening, and long-term operation of McDonald's Park. - Assist with organizational planning, operating models, vendor evaluations, business planning, and new strategic initiatives. - Support enterprise-wide initiatives that improve how the organization operates and scales. - Take ownership of additional special projects as organizational priorities evolve.
Qualifications:
- 2-5 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, investment banking, project management, or another highly analytical environment. - Experience at a top-tier management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, Bain, or BCG, is strongly preferred. - Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders. - Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. - Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to build executive-level presentations, financial models, dashboards, and analytical tools with minimal direction. - Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills. - Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with meticulous attention to detail. - Ability to distill complex analyses into concise, compelling recommendations for executive leadership and ownership. - Strong executive presence with the ability to quickly build credibility and trust with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with frequently changing priorities. - High degree of adaptability and comfort taking on unfamiliar or loosely defined assignments. - Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to take ownership well beyond a traditional job description. - Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain strict confidentiality while working on sensitive business matters. - Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Ideal Candidate Profile:
The Club is looking for someone who thrives in an ambitious, collaborative, and highly dynamic environment. The successful candidate is someone who:
- Thrives in a very fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and no two days look the same. - Enjoys solving ambiguous business problems that do not have obvious answers and comfortable operating without complete information. - Demonstrates maturity, humility, and sound judgment when working with senior leaders on confidential or high-profile initiatives. - Is equally comfortable developing strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute. - Can influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority. - Operates with urgency while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. - Is intellectually curious and eager to quickly learn unfamiliar businesses, industries, and functions. - Takes initiative rather than waiting for direction and proactively identifies opportunities to improve the organization. - Passion for professional sports and interest in building an operating career within the industry.
Compensation:
- This role offers a salary range of $90,000 - $100,000. Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as full-time, exempt. - This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals. - Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website.

- Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. - CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. job.title: Director, Ticket Operations
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

 
Position Overview
The Director of Ticket Operations will lead Chicago Fire FC’s ticketing operations, systems, inventory strategy, reporting, financial controls, box office operations, and event execution.

Reporting to the Chief Ticketing Officer, this leader will oversee the Club’s ticketing ecosystem, partner closely across Revenue and key business functions, and help build the operational foundation for McDonald’s Park.

This is a unique opportunity to lead a major ticketing transformation - delivering seamless operations today through Ticketmaster Archtics while guiding the transition to SeatGeek Unify and preparing for the Club’s new stadium in 2028.

Success in this role means delivering best-in-class ticket operations today while helping build one of the most modern and scalable ticketing operations in professional sports.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Lead the Ticket Operations Function
  • Lead the Club's Ticket Operations department, overseeing all ticketing operations, systems, policies, and event execution. 
  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Ticket Operations team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
  • Partner closely with the Chief Ticketing Officer, Vice President of Ticket Sales, Service & Operations, and Vice President of McDonald's Park Sales & Service to align operational priorities with the Club's evolving business objectives. 
 
Own the Club's Ticketing Ecosystem
  • Serve as the operational owner of the Club's ticketing platforms, leading Ticketmaster Archtics today while guiding the successful transition to SeatGeek Unify. 
  • Oversee event builds, manifests, inventory architecture, pricing configuration, payment plans, promotions, user permissions, and system governance across all events. 
  • Partner with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, and third-party technology providers to implement enhancements, integrations, and operational improvements that increase efficiency and scalability. 
 
Drive Revenue Through Operational Excellence
  • Manage ticket inventory, financial controls, operational reporting, and League reporting while partnering with Revenue leadership to maximize ticket revenue and inventory utilization. 
  • Partner with Finance on reconciliations, settlements, payment plans, taxes, and account compliance. 
  • Develop reporting and operational insights that enable informed business decisions and support organizational performance. 
 
Deliver World-Class Event Operations
  • Lead ticket operations and box office execution for all Chicago Fire matches and Club-supported events. 
  • Serve as the senior operational contact for complex ticketing issues while partnering with Stadium Operations, Guest Experience, Security, venue partners, and promoters to deliver an exceptional fan experience. 
  • Develop scalable operating procedures, staffing models, and service standards that support MLS matches, concerts, international events, and future programming. 
 
Build the Future
  • Lead the operational planning and implementation of the Club's ticketing strategy for McDonald's Park, including systems, workflows, staffing, and operational readiness. 
  • Lead cross-functional projects involving multiple business units, vendors, and technology platforms while balancing long-term strategic initiatives with flawless day-to-day execution. 
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, industry best practices, and process improvements to ensure Chicago Fire FC remains at the forefront of ticketing operations. 
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
 
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required. 
  • 6+ years of progressive ticket operations experience within professional sports, live entertainment, venue management, or a comparable industry. 
  • Demonstrated success leading a Ticket Operations department or comparable operational function in a high-volume environment. 
  • Deep expertise with Ticketmaster Archtics required; experience with SeatGeek Unify or another enterprise ticketing platform is a plus. 
  • Proven experience managing ticket inventory, event configuration, financial reconciliation, reporting, and box office operations. 
  • Experience leading complex operational initiatives such as ticketing platform implementations, venue openings, or enterprise technology projects preferred. 
  • Strong understanding of how ticket operations supports revenue strategy, premium seating, memberships, and the overall fan experience. 
  • Exceptional project management, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.  Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex priorities simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and consistently meeting critical deadlines. 
  • Proven ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and make thoughtful decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment with minimal direction. 
  • Collaborative leadership style with a proven ability to influence, build consensus, and establish trusted relationships across Revenue, Finance, Marketing, Stadium Operations, Technology, and external partners. 
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience leveraging data to drive operational and business decisions. 
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and event days.
 
Compensation:
  • This role offers a salary range of $90,000.00-125,000.00 Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals
  • Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website
 
Please note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. 
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination.   The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.  

  •  If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.
