job.title: Manager of Programming, Chicago Fire Foundation
job.html_description:
The Chicago Fire Football Club (Chicago Fire FC) is an American professional soccer club that competes in Major League Soccer (MLS), the top U.S. domestic league. Founded on October 8, 1997, on the 126th anniversary of the Great Chicago Fire, the Club began play in 1998 as one of the League’s first expansion franchises. The Fire have won six major domestic titles, including the 1998 MLS Cup; the 1998, 2000, 2003, and 2006 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cups; as well as the 2003 MLS Supporters’ Shield. 
 
The Club recently announced plans to build a $750M+ privately financed downtown stadium in Chicago in 2028. The stadium will anchor Chicago’s newest neighborhood, the 78, a 62-acre development and entertainment district located along the Chicago River just south of Roosevelt Road. For more information on our bold plans, visit DearChicago.com.  
 
Additionally, the Club recently opened the state-of-the-art $100M Endeavor Health Performance Center in March 2025 that has set the standard for North American training facilities. With tremendous growth and expansion, the Club is laying the foundation for an audacious and ambitious vision that will transform the brand and the company in the coming years.  
 
At Chicago Fire FC, we’re on a mission to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago by delivering excellence on and off the pitch to ensure a world-class experience. As a club we let our values guide everything we do: we uphold uncompromising integrity, show respect for all at all times, never settle for less, constantly innovate, and hold ourselves relentlessly accountable.  
 
Position Overview:  
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a motivated and dedicated professional to oversee the Club’s charitable programs. Reporting to the Director, Development and Foundation Programs, the Manager of Programming will oversee the planning, implementation and evaluation of the Club’s proprietary P.L.A.Y.S. Program and leading immense growth over the coming years. 
 
Job Responsibilities: 
  • Manage day-to-day operations of the P.L.A.Y.S. Program in its entirety  
  • Develop program schedules, calendars, and implementation plans  
  • Collaborate with research team and assist with evaluation of all program measurements and data collection 
  • Support curriculum implementation and continuous improvement initiatives 
  • Serve as the primary liaison with school administrators, teachers, and community partners  
  • Cultivate and maintain positive relationships with school staff and stakeholders  
  • Coordinate logistics with partner schools, including scheduling, communication, and site support 
  • Ensure program compliance with organizational policies and sponsor commitments 
  • Recruit, train, supervise, and support program coordinators, coaches and volunteers 
  • Manage program budgets and resources including forecasting and expense tracking 
  • Develop communications, tools and other resources needed for programming 
  • Assist director with preparation of program reports for leadership, funders and foundation board 
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to achieve strategic club goals and assist with execution of additional Foundation programs and fundraisers  
  • Attend all CFFC home games, all Chicago Fire Foundation events, and other club events as requested 
  • Administrative tasks and other duties as assigned 
 
Required Qualifications: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred (Education, Social Work, Non-Profit Management) 
  •  3 - 5+ years of experience managing youth, school or non-profit programming 
  • Exceptional communication, both verbal & written, interpersonal skills and ability to manage programming and events 
  • Experience supervising staff or volunteers 
  • Knowledge of youth soccer development and social-emotional learning practices  
  • Highly organized with proven time management skills and experience creating efficient systems to juggle multiple projects simultaneously 
  • Possesses a spirit of flexibility, a positive outlook and the ability to move projects forward with urgency and cooperation 
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of the Chicago market and community 
  • Passion for community impact and alignment with the values and mission of Chicago Fire   
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays 
 
Preferred Qualifications: 
  • Spanish language fluency 
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field (Education, Social Work, Non-profit Management) 
  • Deep understanding of the Chicago philanthropic and community landscape. 
  • Experience working in a fast paced or start up environment  
 
Compensation: 
  • This role offers a salary range of $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt 
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals 
  • Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website 
 
 
Please note: 
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.title: Coordinator, Ticket Operations
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview:  
The Coordinator, Ticket Operations supports the day-to-day execution of ticket operations for Chicago Fire FC, including ticketing systems, ticket inventory, reporting, payment processing, and matchday operations. 
 
This position serves as a key liaison between the Ticket Sales and Service team, Stadium, and Box Office, while helping ensure a high level of service for internal and external customers. The Coordinator will support the Club's current Ticketmaster Archtics environment while gaining exposure to SeatGeek Unify as Chicago Fire FC prepares for the opening of McDonald's Park in 2028. 
 
This role will report to the Director, Ticket Operations and will support matchday staff and temporary ticketing personnel as needed. 
 
Job Responsibilities: 
  • Process group and plan orders, print and pay all ticket orders as requested by Chicago Fire FC front office staff 
  • Build, maintain and develop a positive working relationship with all Ticketmaster and SeatGeek client support teams 
  • Work hand-in-hand with all Ticketmaster and SeatGeek client support staff regarding software management, troubleshooting system issues, event creation, event marketing and financial reporting 
  • Formulate and update existing daily, weekly, monthly and match day reports in a timely manner as assigned by the Director of Ticket Operations and MLS League Office 
  • Facilitate a complex network of payment plans, investigate and respond to any chargebacks related to ticket payments and work closely with the Ticket Services department to ensure account compliance 
  • Assist with the building of price codes, plans, promo codes, and other TM/Archtics and SeakGeek/Unify programming needs 
  • Assist in the set-up, trouble shooting and maintaining of events in Archtics and Host, and overtime, SeatGeek Unify  
  • Serve as a resource for all departments as it relates to Ticketmaster Advanced Products 
  • Help maintain a culture that’s focused on a high standard of customer service for both internal and external customers  
  • Maintain a positive, high performance culture in the Ticket Operations department, while building a positive rapport with all other departments on a daily basis 
  • Act as a higher point of contact for all elevated customer service occurrences on match day 
  • Assist with Will Call responsibilities and ticket troubleshooting needs on match day 
 
Required Qualifications: 
  • 2+ years of ticket operations experience  
  • Working knowledge of Ticketmaster Archtics preferred, and experience with SeatGeek Unify or another enterprise ticketing platform is a plus  
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel 
  • Experience with high level, time sensitive reporting 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with internal staff, venue personnel, and customers. 
  • Must have the ability to work independently without supervision, be self-directed and demonstrate initiative 
  • Ability to manage daily and weekly responsibilities with limited oversight 
  • Experience handling cash and balancing deposits is a plus 
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays  
 
Preferred Qualifications: 
  • Bachelor’s degree   
  • Experience working in professional sports, live entertainment, or venue operations  
  • Fluent in Spanish 
 
Compensation: 
  • This role offers a hourly range of $20.00 - $21.00, and is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Part-time, non-exempt 
  • Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website 

Please note: 
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at Peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.  
 
MLS Privacy Policy:  
  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.title: Casual Laundry Operative
job.html_description:
Join Manchester City on a casual basis as a Laundry Operative, supporting the day-to-day delivery of laundry services across the Club. Based in Manchester, this flexible casual opportunity is ideal for someone who takes pride in maintaining high standards, works well as part of a team, and can adapt to the demands of a football environment.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is an English Premier League club whose roots began in East Manchester. From its first incarnation as St Mark’s West Gorton in 1880, the club became Manchester City FC in 1894. Behind each title lies emotion, moments and memories that resonate with millions of supporters around the world. Manchester City fans are known for their commitment and togetherness, as a Club that fights to the end.

Our operations team plays an important role in supporting players, staff and the wider Club. By delivering reliable and high-quality services behind the scenes, the team helps create an environment where everyone can perform at their best.

 

The Role

 

As a Casual Laundry Operative, you will help ensure laundry services are delivered efficiently, safely and to a consistently high standard. You will support daily operations, helping to maintain the quality and presentation expected across the Club.

Working collaboratively with colleagues, you will contribute to the smooth running of the laundry function, adapting to operational requirements and covering shifts as needed. You will also support the upkeep of equipment and help maintain a safe and organised working environment.

This role requires a proactive approach, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively around established schedules and deadlines.

 

What You'll Bring

 

⚽ Experience working within a laundry environment
⚽ Good time management and organisational skills
⚽ Ability to work effectively around fixed deadlines
⚽ Clear and professional communication skills
⚽ A collaborative approach and commitment to teamwork
⚽ Adaptability within a football-focused environment


How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Monday 28th August.  We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.


We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodations to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact Hiring@cityfootball.com . Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Facilities Supervisor (Etihad Stadium)
job.html_description:
Based at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, this 12-month fixed term contract Facilities Supervisor role plays a key part in keeping the site safe, welcoming and operating to a high standard for colleagues, partners and visitors. Working on a 5 days over 7 pattern with regular evenings and weekends, you will help deliver excellent facilities support across a busy multi-use environment. This is an exciting opportunity that will include the delivery of Premier League, UEFA fixtures and concerts at the Etihad Stadium.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Facilities Management team helps keep the Etihad Stadium and wider site ready for the many different demands of each day and each season. From maintaining safe, clean and welcoming spaces to supporting matchday preparation, contractor coordination and guest standards, the team plays an important part in creating a professional environment that works for everyone who uses it.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of day-to-day site operations, helping to make sure facilities services are delivered to a high standard and that the building environment supports colleagues, partners and customers. You will help maintain the quality, safety and consistency of the site, bringing a practical and thoughtful approach to the work that keeps everything running smoothly.

 

Your focus will include daily checks and operational support across cleaning, health and safety, building maintenance, grounds, security and energy management. You will also help coordinate planning and day-to-day use of the site, support accommodation standards, contribute to audits and inspections, and work alongside others to make sure facilities meet the needs of a varied and busy environment.

 

You will work closely with colleagues, partners and contractors, helping to build positive relationships and support continuous improvement across the site. The role also involves supporting the wider Facilities Management team on meetings, events, infrastructure projects and matchday or safety-related activity when required, so flexibility, good judgement and clear communication are important throughout.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in facilities management or a similar supervisory role within a multi-faceted building or operational environment.

⚽ Ability to supervise and support cleaning, security or other site service teams to maintain high standards.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the confidence to influence colleagues, contractors and stakeholders.

⚽ Good computer literacy, with the ability to maintain records, complete administration and produce reports accurately.

⚽ Ability to manage day-to-day operations, follow procedures and contribute to continuous improvement.

⚽ A good standard of education or relevant qualifications, with the flexibility to work a 5 days over 7 pattern including regular evenings and weekends.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

The selection process is expected to include TA screening and CV review, an initial informal introductory call, and a second-stage task-based assessment and face-to-face interview. If required, a final validation interview may also take place. First-stage interviews are planned online in the week commencing 24 August 2026, with second-stage interviews face to face in the week commencing 31 August 2026.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: MCWFC Academy Therapist
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this full-time permanent role offers the chance to deliver best-practice physiotherapy support across the Manchester City Women Academy. You will work across all phases of the pathway, helping young players stay healthy, recover well and progress in a high-performance environment that values collaboration, detail and long-term development.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

Within the Manchester City Women Academy, our medical and sports science team works closely together to give players the best possible support across every phase of the pathway. We aim to create an environment where evidence-based care, clear communication and long-term development sit side by side.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the centre of the MCWFC Academy medical offer, helping to deliver best-practice physiotherapy across the pathway. You will play an important part in assessing, diagnosing and supporting rehabilitation plans, while contributing to the wider performance and wellbeing of players across the Academy.

 

A key focus of the role is helping shape and deliver evidence-based injury prevention and physiotherapy protocols, with particular attention to growth-related complaints and the changing needs of young female athletes. You will also stay close to current research and professional regulation, while maintaining accurate records and working in line with relevant legislation, policies and departmental procedures.

 

Working closely with the Head of Physiotherapy, coaches, parents and wider club stakeholders, you will bring a calm, adaptable and collaborative approach to the role. The position requires flexibility to support all phases of the Academy as needed, including evenings and weekends, and at home and away fixtures.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ BSc (Hons) Physiotherapy, with HCPC registration & Membership to the Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP) - OR

⚽  BSc (Hons) Sports Therapy or equivalent qualification with associated accreditation.

⚽ Experience delivering physiotherapy within injury prevention, assessment and rehabilitation programmes.

⚽ Excellent understanding of paediatric and adolescent growth-related injuries and the principles of managing them.

⚽ Evidence of ongoing CPD, with postgraduate learning across relevant clinical skills such as manual therapy, soft tissue mobilisation or acute injury management.

⚽ Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary environment, communicate clearly with coaches and parents, and adapt to evening, weekend, home and away fixture demands.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted about the next stage of the process.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

You will work across all phases of the pathway, helping young players stay healthy, recover well and progress in a high-performance environment that values collaboration, detail and long-term development.
Who We Are
Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

We aim to create an environment where evidence-based care, clear communication and long-term development sit side by side.
The Role
This role sits at the centre of the MCWFC Academy medical offer, helping to deliver best-practice physiotherapy across the pathway. You will play an important part in assessing, diagnosing and supporting rehabilitation plans, while contributing to the wider performance and wellbeing of players across the Academy.
A key focus of the role is helping shape and deliver evidence-based injury prevention and physiotherapy protocols, with particular attention to growth-related complaints and the changing needs of young female athletes. You will also stay close to current research and professional regulation, while maintaining accurate records and working in line with relevant legislation, policies and departmental procedures.

job.title: Medical Coordinator
job.html_description:
This part-time, 30 hours per week role offers the chance to shape and assure medical provision across our Manchester campus, covering Etihad Stadium, Joie Stadium and Co-op Live Arena. You will help make sure every football match, concert and major event is supported by proportionate, compliant and well-planned medical arrangements, with occasional attendance at live events to review delivery and keep standards working in practice.

 

Who We Are

 

City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

This role sits at the centre of a busy, multi-venue environment, working closely with safety, event operations, medical suppliers and colleagues across City Football Group and Oak View Group. It is a chance to help keep people safe across a wide range of events while supporting a culture of consistency, assurance and continuous improvement.

 

The Role

 

You will lead the planning and coordination of medical provision across the campus, bringing together venue needs, supplier capability and regulatory requirements to make sure arrangements are appropriate for each event. The focus is on proportionate advice, clear governance and practical assurance, rather than a one-size-fits-all model.

 

A key part of the role is maintaining the Medical Needs Assessment, shaping event medical plans and chairing the Medical Coordination Group so that risks, actions and responsibilities are clear. You will also help ensure facilities, equipment, training and operating procedures remain fit for purpose across both event days and quieter periods, supporting consistency across the wider campus.

 

Working closely with suppliers, safety teams, emergency services and internal stakeholders, you will support procurement, deployment, audits, exercises and post-event reviews. The role includes occasional attendance at live events to review arrangements on the ground and keep medical response standards consistent across the campus.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Significant experience in pre-hospital emergency care or a senior clinical role, ideally with experience of event or mass-gathering environments.
⚽ Current professional registration as a paramedic or equivalent registered healthcare professional, plus a full UK driving licence.
⚽ Experience advising on, planning or reviewing medical provision, with a sound understanding of the Green Guide, event safety and multi-agency working.

⚽ Ability to assess risk, maintain accurate records and use information to support compliant planning and assurance.

⚽ Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working across suppliers, venue teams and emergency services.

⚽ Experience chairing or contributing to governance groups, exercises, audits or incident reviews in a busy operational setting.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site before the 16th August 2026.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodations to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact Hiring@cityfootball.com.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Customer Enablement Manager
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this full-time permanent role will shape how we use AI-enabled service capability to improve customer experience, strengthen automation and reduce avoidable contact. You will play a central part in making sure our customer journeys are well governed, continuously improved and designed to deliver clear, consistent support.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Customer Experience and Service Support teams, we focus on making every interaction clearer, quicker and more joined up. This role will help shape how AI-supported service journeys work day to day, partnering with colleagues across Technology and Knowledge Management to improve quality, consistency and the experience people have when they contact us.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the centre of how we use AI to improve customer service. You will own the day-to-day performance of AI-enabled customer journeys, making sure they deliver accurate, helpful and consistent support while creating a better experience for customers and reducing avoidable contact.

 

You will monitor service and automation performance, identify patterns in customer conversations and turn insight into practical improvements. That includes refining prompts, workflows and knowledge content, supporting quality assurance, and helping prioritise new use cases and integrations that increase automated resolution and reduce manual effort.

 

Working closely with colleagues across Service Support, Technology and Knowledge Management, you will help ensure AI capability is introduced responsibly and adopted well by operational teams. Your work will connect governance, service design and reporting so that we continue to evolve our customer experience in a way that is effective, measurable and aligned to wider business priorities.

 

What You'll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in customer experience, service operations or digital service improvement, with an understanding of AI-enabled or automated service tools.

⚽ Ability to analyse service data, AI Agent and feature performance, customer conversations and feedback, then turn insight into practical, prioritised improvements to automated journeys and AI-powered tools.

⚽ Experience working with knowledge content, service journeys or process governance to maintain quality and consistency.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the confidence to work across Technology, Service Support and Knowledge Management teams.

⚽ Ability to manage priorities, quality and risk in a changing environment while keeping customer outcomes in view.

⚽ Comfortable supporting the adoption of new ways of working and helping colleagues adapt to process or technology change.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days' annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to the next stage of the process.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Communications Coordinator
job.html_description:
Communications Coordinator

This Communications Coordinator role is an opportunity to help tell the story of City in the Community through engaging digital content. Working closely with the Communications Officer and wider marketing team, you will source, create and schedule multimedia content that showcases our impact, strengthens our reach and helps bring our work to life for audiences across Manchester.

 

Who We Are

Established in 1986, City in the Community is Manchester City’s official charity. We support people across Manchester by empowering healthier lives through football. Our programmes place physical and mental wellbeing at their core, whilst also creating healthy futures and healthy communities.

Our Communications and Engagement team plays a key role in sharing the charity’s story, connecting people to our purpose and helping ensure our work is visible, relevant and impactful. Through creative content, digital campaigns and collaboration across the charity, we help celebrate the difference City in the Community makes every day.

 

The Role

You will play an important part in the delivery of City in the Community’s communications and digital content, with a particular focus on videography and editorial. Day to day, you will source compelling stories and case studies, create engaging content for our digital channels and help ensure our social media and website reflect the breadth and impact of our work.

Working closely with the Communications Officer, you will maintain content planning systems, support monthly reporting and help shape a strategic, youth-led approach to digital communications. You will also be expected to respond positively to emerging priorities and use your own initiative where suitable to spot opportunities, apply creative thinking, keep content moving and support the wider communications strategy.

Alongside digital content creation, you will use Adobe templates to produce graphic design assets for social media and printed materials, support the internal charity newsletter and collaborate with the Marketing team to maximise the reach of content across Manchester City platforms. This is a varied role that requires creativity, organisation and a confident, proactive approach.

You will also help ensure that City in the Community and CFG policies and procedures are followed, with safeguarding embedded to the highest standard across the team. The role includes working across Greater Manchester, so a full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle are required.

 

What You'll Bring

⚽ A degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant field such as videography, media or journalism.

⚽ Experience working in communications, marketing or media, with a focus on creating digital content.

⚽ Confident video creation and editing skills, with experience of Adobe Premiere Pro, Illustrator and Photoshop.

⚽ Up-to-date knowledge of digital technologies, social media platforms and emerging trends.

⚽ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your tone and content for different audiences.

⚽ Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

⚽ A positive, proactive approach, with the ability to work well as part of a team, use your own initiative where suitable, and manage a deadline-driven workload.

⚽ A full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle for travel across Greater Manchester.

 

Why Choose Us

Guided by our values of being caring, inclusive, transformative and youth-led, we are committed to creating an environment where our team feel supported, valued and able to make a meaningful difference through the work they do every day.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 31st August 2026.

 

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodation to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact citcjobs@cityfootball.com.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

job.title: Performance Lifestyle and Player Support Manager
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent full-time role leads the delivery of a comprehensive player support programme for Academy players aged U9 to U21. You will work closely with players, families and Academy colleagues to help ensure every player is supported to develop, thrive and perform on and off the pitch.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy Operations division, our Performance Lifestyle and Player Support team works alongside players, families and colleagues across the Academy pathway to create an environment where young people feel supported, informed and able to reach their potential. We combine high standards of care with close collaboration, helping to build positive experiences on and off the pitch.

 

The Role

 

In this role, you will lead the delivery of a player support programme that places the wellbeing, personal development and day-to-day experience of Academy players at the centre of everything we do. You will help ensure players are supported in a way that is practical, thoughtful and tailored to their stage of development, while keeping their wider needs in view.

 

You will coordinate and deliver lifeskills and personal development sessions, work with players who need additional support, and provide mentoring and one-to-one guidance where it is needed. You will also help shape and deliver parent and player voice activity, making sure feedback is gathered, understood and used to improve the Academy experience.

 

Alongside this, you will build trusted relationships with players, families and stakeholders across the Academy, maintain accurate records and communicate clearly across the team. The role also includes line management of the Performance Lifestyle and Player Support Executive, so you will provide supervision and guidance through regular feedback and mentoring.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience of managing, supporting and developing team members in a care, wellbeing, education, youth development or player support setting
  • Experience of working within an elite sporting, youth development or other high-performance environment
  • Ability to design, coordinate and deliver engaging presentations, workshops or development sessions for different audiences
  • Experience of building trusted relationships with young people, families and multidisciplinary stakeholders
  • Ability to manage sensitive situations with discretion, empathy and sound judgement
  • Comfort working flexibly outside normal office hours, including evenings and weekends, to meet the needs of the role

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 19 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Football Coach UAE - Manchester City Football Education
job.html_description:
Closing Date: 25 August 2026
Assessment Date: 29 August or 5 September 2026

Assessment Location: City Football Academy, Manchester

 

Based in the United Arab Emirates, this full-time opportunity offers coaches the chance to take their career onto a global stage with Manchester City. You will help deliver high-quality coaching programmes while developing your own coaching identity within a diverse and fast-growing football environment. It is an opportunity to learn, grow and contribute to a world-class football organisation, gaining international experience while making a meaningful impact on player development.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Football Education team delivers programmes around the world, bringing Manchester City’s coaching philosophy to life across a range of environments. In the UAE, our programmes continue to grow, offering coaches the chance to work in a dynamic, multicultural setting while supporting the development of players of all abilities.

 

The Role

 

You will join a collaborative coaching team delivering programmes that reflect Manchester City’s coaching philosophy, standards and approach. Working across a range of age groups and abilities, you will help create engaging, high-quality sessions that support both player development and enjoyment of the game.

 

Alongside delivery, you will contribute to the ongoing development of programmes by supporting session planning, reviews and continuous improvement. You will work closely with colleagues to ensure consistency in delivery, while also adapting your approach to meet the needs of different players and environments.

 

You will also play an important role in representing Manchester City both on and off the pitch, building positive relationships with players, families and local stakeholders, and contributing to wider programme activations across the region.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ FA Level 2 or UEFA C coaching qualification (minimum)
⚽ Membership of a recognised FA or international equivalent
⚽ Experience delivering coaching sessions within a football environment
⚽ Ability to communicate clearly and build positive relationships with players and colleagues
⚽ Experience working with players from a range of backgrounds and abilities
⚽ Commitment to learning, development and continuous improvement

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

This role offers a comprehensive international relocation package, including housing, medical cover, transport allowance, flights and visa sponsorship, alongside the opportunity to gain valuable global coaching experience.

 

Find out more about our UAE programs

 

  • Abu Dhabi Cup 2025
    https://www.mancity.com/city-football-schools/abu-dhabi-cup/venue
  • Abu Dhabi League 2024
    https://www.mancity.com/city-football-schools/abu-dhabi-league
  • Manchester City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.mancity.com/learn-football/football-school-united-arab-emirates

 

Follow us

 

  • Man City Abu Dhabi League
    https://www.instagram.com/cityabudhabileague/profilecard/?igsh=Z3UzcjlwbzBid21p
  • City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.instagram.com/cityfootballschools/profilecard/?igsh=MTZ2bDlwZHplM3Y2
  • Man City Abu Dhabi Cup
    https://www.instagram.com/abudhabicup

 

How to Apply

 

If you’re ready to take the next step in your coaching career and explore an international opportunity with Manchester City, we’d love to hear from you. Please click Apply and submit your CV by 25 August.

 

The assessment day will take place on Saturday 29 August 2026 or Saturday 5 September 2026 at the City Football Academy, Manchester.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Foundation Phase Coach
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent full-time role supports the delivery of high-quality training sessions and game day coaching within Manchester City’s elite Category 1 academy environment. Working closely with the lead age group coach, you will help players develop as individuals and as part of a team, while contributing to the Club’s long-term player pathway and style of play.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy, we create a high-performance learning environment that supports young players at every stage of their journey. Our coaching teams work collaboratively to develop talent, uphold standards and help players grow on and off the pitch.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of the Academy’s day-to-day coaching delivery. You will support the lead age group coach in helping players grow within Manchester City’s style of play, with a focus on individual development, positive habits and consistent standards across training and match day.

 

You will help create individual learning plans, track progress and support players through the technical, tactical, physical and psychological demands of their stage of development. The role also includes contributing to transition planning, maintaining high behavioural standards and adapting coaching to suit individual needs.

 

Working collaboratively with academy staff, scouting and recruitment colleagues, and parents or guardians, you will help build a joined-up environment around each player. You will also support the wider academy as needed and work in line with EPPP principles and the Club’s footballing philosophy.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • UEFA B Licence and FA Youth Award.
  • Experience coaching players aged U6 to U11 within an academy structure, in a lead or assistant capacity.
  • Understanding of academy football pathways and EPPP principles.
  • Ability to identify, develop and support football talent.
  • Clear and effective communication skills when working with players, colleagues and parents or guardians.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team and solve problems in a competitive environment.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 19 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Partnership Marketing Manager, Americas
job.html_description:
Based in New York City, this full-time, permanent role will help drive the activation and growth of Manchester City’s partnership portfolio across the Americas. You will connect global partners to the Club’s rights and assets, shape integrated campaigns that create value for fans and partners, and support the development of scalable marketing platforms that can be used across the region.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Partnership Marketing and Operations team, we work across regions to bring Manchester City’s partnerships to life in ways that feel authentic, commercially effective and memorable for fans. We collaborate closely with colleagues across City Football Group to build scalable marketing platforms, create high-quality partner experiences and grow the impact of our partnership portfolio in the Americas.

 

The Role

 

This role is central to how Manchester City activates and grows its partnership portfolio across the Americas. You will help ensure partners clearly understand the value of their rights, while creating opportunities that bring those rights to life through thoughtful, integrated marketing activity.

 

Working closely with partners, agencies and regional offices, you will build trusted relationships and support the delivery of campaigns that reflect each partner’s brand and business goals. From educating partners on their rights to identifying new activation ideas, you will help turn strategy into practical, high-impact delivery.

 

You will also work across City Football Group to shape scalable platforms, align stakeholders and monitor performance so that partner activity continues to improve over time. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys collaboration, takes ownership of delivery and can move confidently between planning, activation and evaluation. Domestic and international travel may be required.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in partnership marketing, sponsorship, brand marketing or a related agency or commercial environment.

⚽ Proven ability to build and manage partner, brand or agency relationships with a clear understanding of business objectives.

⚽ Experience developing integrated marketing campaigns or activations across multiple touchpoints.

⚽ Ability to work collaboratively across global teams and balance input from a range of stakeholders.

⚽ Comfortable managing projects from concept through delivery with a proactive, practical approach to problem-solving.

⚽ Experience using performance insight or reporting to evaluate activity and inform future improvements.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will have access to a choice of medical plans, alongside dental and vision coverage. We also provide employer-funded life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, as well as short-term and long-term disability coverage. Employees can also choose additional accident and critical illness insurance.

 

You can save for your future through our Fidelity 401(k) plan, with employer contributions matching 100% of the first 3% of salary you contribute and 50% of the next 2%. Depending on the benefit options you select, you may also have access to a Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account, helping you set aside pre-tax dollars for eligible healthcare and dependent care expenses.

 

Compensation

 

This exempt position offers an estimated annual base salary range of $75,000 to $85,000.

  

Final compensation offers are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including demonstrated skill set, depth of relevant experience and other role-specific considerations. We welcome open and transparent conversations about compensation during our initial discussions.

 

How To Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Wednesday August 19. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any resumes submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the U.S.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Phase Operations Executive - Academy
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent full-time role plays a central part in supporting the operations and administration of the Academy. You will help keep fixtures, travel, player information and wider phase activity running smoothly, enabling the team to deliver a high-quality experience for players, staff and families.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy Operations and Development team, we help create the conditions for players and staff to focus on football development. Our work brings together planning, organisation and service, supporting the smooth delivery of the Academy every day.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of the Academy phase operation, keeping the day-to-day detail organised so players, coaches and families experience clear communication and dependable support. You will help ensure the phase runs smoothly behind the scenes, with high-quality administration, planning and coordination that support operational excellence and excellent service.

 

Your work will cover fixture preparation, travel and accommodation, tournament administration, meeting actions, calendar management and player records on Teamworks. You will also support reporting and presentation materials, helping the phase operations managers turn information into clear, useful updates, while contributing to Academy events and content such as the Men’s First Team Player Appearance Day.

 

Just as importantly, you will build trusted relationships across the Academy, working closely with staff, players and parents in a flexible and responsive way. This is a role for someone who enjoys varied operational work, takes pride in detail, and can adapt to changing priorities while helping the wider Academy achieve its goals.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in a football academy or high-performance sport environment, with an understanding of the demands of working with young performers

⚽ Understanding of academy football, including relevant guidelines such as the Elite Player Performance Plan

⚽ Experience coordinating operational, logistical or administrative activity for fixtures, travel, events or a similar programme

⚽ Experience using Teamworks or a similar communication and operations platform to manage player and schedule information

⚽ Ability to build trusted working relationships with staff, players and parents and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team

⚽ Ability to work flexibly, including irregular hours and domestic or international travel when required

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 21 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.
