job.title: Lead Coach - Women's Football Dubai
job.html_description:
Closing Date: 25 August 2026
Assessment Date: 29 August or 5 September 2026

Assessment Location: City Football Academy, Manchester

 

Based in Dubai, UAE, this full time opportunity offers you the chance to take your career onto a global stage with Manchester City. You will help lead the planning and delivery of the Women's Football Dubai programme for City Football Middle East and help grow participation, support programme quality and guide a coaching team to create a positive experience for players, partners and other key stakeholders.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Football Education team delivers programmes around the world, bringing Manchester City’s coaching philosophy to life across a range of environments. In the UAE, our programmes continue to grow, offering coaches the chance to work in a dynamic, multicultural setting while supporting the development of players of all abilities.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of the Women's Football Dubai programme and combines coaching leadership with programme delivery. You will plan and manage the day-to-day running of the programme, ensuring sessions are well organised, participants are supported and the overall programme is delivered to a high standard.

 

A major part of the role is coordinating the moving pieces that keep the programme running smoothly. That includes working with venue teams, suppliers and internal colleagues, managing registrations and waivers, overseeing facilities and equipment, and making sure everything is in place for a reliable and positive participant experience.

 

You will also help grow the programme by supporting promotional activity and working closely with the marketing team to build awareness and participation. Alongside that, you will lead and support coaches, keep key stakeholders aligned and act as the safeguarding lead on site, ensuring concerns are handled appropriately and the programme remains a safe environment for everyone involved.

 

The role requires someone who can balance detail with pace, maintain strong relationships and make practical decisions on the ground. It is a hands-on position with real influence over the quality, consistency and reputation of the Women's Football Dubai programme.

 

What You'll Bring

 

⚽ UEFA B, or working towards, in coaching, teaching, sport or a related area.

⚽ Level 3 safeguarding training, or a clear commitment to complete it at the earliest opportunity.

⚽ Experience in football and school environments, with exposure to local and international settings.

⚽ Proven ability to plan, deliver and review football programmes, events or similar projects.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills when working with players, coaches, parents and partner stakeholders.

⚽ Ability to organise priorities, lead people and adapt confidently when plans or demands change.

 

Why Choose Us 

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

This role offers a comprehensive international relocation package, including housing, medical cover, transport allowance, flights and visa sponsorship, alongside the opportunity to gain valuable global coaching experience.

 

Find out more about our UAE programs

  • Abu Dhabi Cup 2025
    https://www.mancity.com/city-football-schools/abu-dhabi-cup/venue
  • Abu Dhabi League 2024
    https://www.mancity.com/city-football-schools/abu-dhabi-league
  • Manchester City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.mancity.com/learn-football/football-school-united-arab-emirates

 

Follow us

  • Man City Abu Dhabi League
    https://www.instagram.com/cityabudhabileague/profilecard/?igsh=Z3UzcjlwbzBid21p
  • City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.instagram.com/cityfootballschools/profilecard/?igsh=MTZ2bDlwZHplM3Y2
  • Man City Abu Dhabi Cup
    https://www.instagram.com/abudhabicup

 

How to Apply

 

If you’re ready to take the next step in your coaching career and explore an international opportunity with Manchester City, we’d love to hear from you. Please click Apply and submit your CV by 25 August.

 

The assessment day will take place on Saturday 29 August 2026 or Saturday 5 September 2026 at the City Football Academy, Manchester.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the relevant location.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all roles will be subject to the relevant safeguarding checks and background screening depending on the location and responsibilities of the job.

job.title: Receptionist
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this predominantly full-time permanent role is an important part of our front-of-house and facilities operation. You will help create a welcoming, professional and well-organised experience for colleagues and visitors, while keeping the day-to-day running of the site safe, efficient and customer-focused. Alongside the permanent opportunity, we are also considering applications from people who may be interested in a casual contract, helping us strengthen the casual pool.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Operations team, the Facilities Management function helps keep our sites welcoming, safe and well-organised for colleagues, visitors and matchday activity. The team takes pride in reliable service, clear communication and practical support that helps the wider Club deliver a positive experience every day.

 

The Role

 

As Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for our Manchester site, delivering a polished front-of-house service that reflects the standards of the Club. Your work will help shape first impressions, support the flow of visitors and calls, and make sure the site runs smoothly for everyone who uses it.

 

You will manage a varied mix of reception and administrative tasks, including greeting visitors, answering enquiries, relaying messages, maintaining office systems, logging jobs, booking internal spaces, handling post and deliveries, and supporting stock control and office records. You will also help with wider facilities administration, such as diary management, preparing documents and supporting subcontractor processes when required.

 

The role also contributes to matchday and event operations, where you will help maintain security, follow visitor sign-in and sign-out procedures, and support the smooth running of activities across the site. Working closely with the Head Receptionist, Facilities Management and wider site teams, you will help maintain high standards, act with care and professionalism, and play a valued part in the everyday experience of colleagues and visitors alike.

 

What You’ll Bring

⚽ Experience in a front-of-house, reception, customer service or administrative role in a busy environment.
⚽ Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
⚽ Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with a good standard of English.
⚽ Well-developed organisational skills, with the ability to manage time well, keep accurate records and work safely and methodically.
⚽ Comfortable handling calls, visitors, enquiries and day-to-day administrative tasks with professionalism and care.
⚽ Enthusiasm, flexibility and a proactive approach to supporting matchday and event operations when needed.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

job.title: Area Coordinator
job.html_description:
Based in Greater Manchester, this permanent part-time role (18 hours per week) supports the Club's Junior Academy talent identification work across the designated region of Cheshire. You will coordinate scouting activity, help maintain high reporting standards, and build trusted relationships that support the identification of high-potential players.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Junior Academy, we are focused on creating the best possible environment for identifying and supporting young players with potential. Our scouting and recruitment work is built on collaboration, consistency and a clear understanding of the Club's development philosophy, helping every area of coverage contribute to long-term success.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of the Club's talent identification activity across a defined geographical area. You will coordinate a team of scouts, help ensure coverage is planned effectively, and support the consistent identification of players who fit the Club's recruitment philosophy.

 

Day to day, you will monitor reporting quality, provide feedback and development support, and keep area operations running smoothly through clear scheduling, communication and compliance. The role also involves regular attendance at matches and events, with a strong focus on safeguarding and accurate record keeping.

 

You will build trusted relationships with local clubs, coaches, parents and other stakeholders, representing the Club professionally in every interaction. Working closely with the Senior Local Recruitment Manager and wider recruitment colleagues, you will help strengthen the area network and contribute to the long-term success of the Junior Academy.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Availability to scout Saturday and Sunday fixtures, with some mid-week evenings as required.

⚽ Experience working with young players, parents and other football stakeholders within a football environment.

⚽ Ability to coordinate a team, schedules and multiple priorities effectively.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with confidence providing feedback and support to colleagues.

⚽ Ability to build positive relationships with clubs, coaches, families and local stakeholders.

⚽ Understanding of safeguarding responsibilities, compliance requirements and the importance of accurate reporting.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 31 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

job.title: Director of Performance - Manchester City Women FC
job.html_description:
Lead the Player Health and Performance function for Manchester City Women in a permanent, full-time role based at the City Football Academy in Manchester. This is a high-impact leadership appointment for a practitioner who brings deep expertise and experience leading multidisciplinary teams in elite sport. You will enable practitioners to integrate health and performance practice, so we develop physically and psychologically robust players, maximise availability, and enable excellent on-pitch performance.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

The Player Health and Performance function plays a central role in that ambition. Working across the Women’s First Team and Women’s Academy, this team helps create conditions for players to stay healthy, develop and perform at their best. The role sits within the wider Women’s Leadership Team, making it an important bridge between performance delivery and football leadership.

 

The Role

 

You will guide the delivery of player health and performance strategy across the women’s pathway, bringing calm and clear leadership to the multidisciplinary environment. Your focus will be on evolving our integrated approach developing physically and psychologically robust players, maximizing availability, enabling excellent on-pitch performance, and returning injured players to sustained high performance.

 

You will also play a wider leadership role across the women’s game at Manchester City. The position requires someone who can work confidently within a matrix structure, partner effectively with coaching and performance colleagues, adapt their approach to different styles and philosophies, and help develop talent within the function so the team around you can grow and thrive.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience leading multidisciplinary teams in an elite sport environment, ideally football, coupled with deep expertise as a practitioner.

⚽ HCPC or equivalent industry accreditation in a medical or performance discipline, and a post-graduate qualification in a related field

⚽ Proven capability to lead multidisciplinary teams to understand the physical and psychological demands of game models and; adapt training, workload management, and injury-risk mitigation to develop robust players capable of consistently meeting these demands with confidence.

⚽ Ability to operate effectively in a matrix structure and build positive partnerships with coaches, performance colleagues and leadership stakeholders

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the capability to flex across different leadership and coaching styles while helping others develop

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 28 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Applications will be reviewed through the advertised process, with in-person interviews taking place between September 10th and 11th  

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Casual Programme Coordinator - City Select
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this casual role supports the organisation and delivery of the U9-U16 City Select programme. Working closely with the Senior Player Pathway Manager, you will help keep weekly operations running smoothly, support clear communication, and ensure players, parents and staff have a consistent, well-organised experience.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy, the Junior Academy and Local Recruitment team supports young players through a structured pathway, working closely with coaches, families and programme staff to create a positive, well-organised and development-focused environment. We place real value on accurate information, clear communication and high standards in everything we deliver.

 

The Role

 

This role plays an important part in making sure the City Select programme runs smoothly from week to week. You will help coordinate the detail behind the programme so that players and staff can focus on the football, with reliable support across planning, communication and administration.

 

Day to day, you will coordinate weekly schedules, staffing, pitches, fixtures and programme logistics across the U9-U16 age groups. You will also support the preparation and distribution of Weekly Coaching Plans, matchday information, player updates and programme communications, while keeping player registers, attendance information, forms, reporting and records accurate and up to date.

 

Alongside this, you will act as a key point of contact for parents, coaches and programme staff, helping to keep communication professional, timely and clear. You will review coaching, fixture and Talent Identification submissions, follow up any missing information, and support player review and Talent Identification activity by organising coaching and scouting intelligence and agreed actions. You will also contribute to training, fixtures, briefings, inductions and programme meetings as needed.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience working with young players, parents and staff in a football or player-development environment.
⚽ Ability to coordinate schedules, staffing, fixtures and programme logistics accurately.
⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with confidence liaising professionally with a range of stakeholders.
⚽ Careful attention to detail and confidence using digital tools to manage reporting and information.
⚽ Understanding of safeguarding, player welfare and compliance requirements in a youth sport setting.
⚽ Ability to review information carefully, follow up missing detail and support player-review or talent-identification processes.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 31 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

job.title: Performance Data Scientist - Manchester City Men's First Team
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent full-time role plays a central part in expanding the use of advanced analytics, machine learning and AI across Manchester City's First Team Performance environment. You will help turn complex data into practical insight, building tools and models that support player availability, optimise performance and strengthen evidence-informed decision making.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our First Team Performance department, we bring together expertise across sports medicine, physical performance, football intelligence and technology to support player readiness and performance. The team works collaboratively to turn evidence into practical support for practitioners and to continually improve how we understand and apply performance information.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the intersection of performance science, machine learning and practical football decision making. You will help shape how the First Team uses data to better understand player health, availability, physical performance and injury risk.

 

You will lead the development and validation of predictive models and data products, working with complex longitudinal datasets to test ideas, refine approaches and turn findings into useful outputs for practitioners.

 

A key part of the role is translating advanced analysis into tools people can use with confidence. That may include explainable AI outputs, dashboards and web-based applications, alongside sensible monitoring so solutions remain robust and relevant over time.

 

You will work closely with colleagues across Sports Medicine, Physical Performance, Football Intelligence and Technology to move prototypes into production, define analytical requirements and contribute to wider Performance AI work across the Club and Group.

 

What You'll Bring

 

  • MSc, PhD or equivalent industry experience in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence or a similar quantitative discipline.
  • Experience designing, training and validating machine learning or deep learning models.
  • Experience working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams in performance, sport, healthcare or a comparable high-performance environment.
  • Highly proficient in Python and SQL, with experience working with complex datasets.
  • Experience developing end-to-end machine learning workflows from research through deployment, including model validation, explainability, calibration and monitoring.
  • Ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, practical recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days' annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 31 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

job.title: Licensing Executive
job.html_description:
Based in London and working a hybrid pattern of three days a week in the office, this permanent full-time role plays an important part in supporting Manchester City’s global licensing programme and wider retail operation. You will help deliver day-to-day licensing activity across physical and digital products, working closely with internal teams and external partners to keep projects moving, products approved and opportunities growing. Some occasional travel will be required.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Retail and Licensing team, we support the club’s global physical and digital licensing programme and wider retail activity. The team works across a diverse portfolio of licensees, product categories and internal stakeholders to protect the brand, grow commercial value and bring official products to fans around the world.

 

The Role

 

As Licensing Executive, you will support the Licensing Manager and Head of Licensing and New Business across the day-to-day delivery of the programme. This is a broad, hands-on role where organisation, accuracy and initiative will help you make a real difference from the outset.

 

You will help manage product approvals, track licensee reports, maintain commercial records and support contract and finance administration so that licensing activity is delivered smoothly and on time. You will also contribute to market research, licensee workshops and the coordination of product opportunities, helping the team identify new categories and strengthen the club’s official range.

 

The role also brings regular contact with colleagues across Digital, Marketing, Fan Membership, Legal and Finance, as well as with external licensees and retail partners. From supporting key commercial moments to keeping documentation and systems up to date, you will be part of a small, collaborative team where your contribution is visible and valued.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Interest in sports merchandise, brands and marketing, with a genuine enthusiasm for how licensing supports fans and commercial growth.
⚽ Ability to organise and prioritise multiple tasks and live projects, while keeping track of detail and deadlines.
⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with confidence building positive relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.
⚽ Experience using Microsoft Office and maintaining accurate records, trackers or shared systems.
⚽ Ability to work collaboratively, take initiative and find practical solutions in a busy team environment.
⚽ A proactive approach to learning, with an eye for detail and a willingness to develop within licensing and retail.

 

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site before the 26th August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We will review applications, shortlist candidates and invite successful applicants to interview with the hiring team. We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

job.title: Casual Academy Driver
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this casual role supports the Academy transport programme by safely moving players and, where required, staff between their homes, schools, training venues, match locations and other approved destinations. Working hours vary with the Academy training and fixture schedule, including evenings, weekends and early-morning or daytime shifts, so the role suits someone who can bring reliability, flexibility and a calm professional approach.

 

Weekend and evening availability is an essential requirement.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy transport team, we play an important part in helping young players travel safely and reliably as they move between home, school, training and fixtures. The department works closely with colleagues across the Academy to create a dependable, well-run service that supports both the daily routine and the wider development environment.

 

The Role

 

This role is central to the smooth running of Academy transport. You will help ensure players, staff and other authorised passengers travel safely, on time and in line with the standards expected across Manchester City, making sure every journey is delivered with care, professionalism and respect.

 

Your day-to-day work will include following approved routes and transport instructions, carrying out vehicle checks, keeping the vehicle clean and presentable, using satellite navigation and journey-planning systems, and completing the administrative tasks that help keep operations organised. The work is varied and can include early starts, evenings, weekends and matchday travel depending on the Academy schedule.

 

You will also work closely with colleagues, families, players and visitors, sharing updates clearly, reporting delays or incidents promptly and following safeguarding, health and safety and transport procedures at all times. In doing so, you will help create a reliable service that supports the Academy environment and the young people who rely on it.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • A valid UK driving licence and the ability to meet the role’s licence-check and insurer requirements
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, early mornings and other variable shifts in line with Academy needs.
  • Clear and effective communication skills when working with young people, families, colleagues and visitors.
  • Confidence using satellite navigation, journey-planning tools and basic Microsoft Office or administrative systems.
  • A professional, safeguarding-aware approach, with attention to detail in vehicle checks, cleanliness and records.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Casual Football Coach - Perth, MCFC Football Education Australia
job.html_description:
Based in Perth, Australia, this casual role gives you the chance to deliver engaging football education sessions for children across the Manchester City Perth Football Education Program. You will help create a positive, inclusive and development-focused environment where young players can enjoy the game, build confidence and learn through high-quality coaching.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within the Manchester City Perth Football Education Program, we deliver football experiences that are welcoming, well-structured and enjoyable for children and families across Western Australia. Our coaches play an important part in bringing the Club's philosophy to life through sessions that support confidence, learning and a love of the game.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of the Perth program and is focused on delivering high-quality football education sessions for children in a way that feels inclusive, fun and purposeful. You will help young players develop their skills, enjoy their football and feel supported in an environment that reflects Manchester City's coaching values.

 

You will plan and deliver age-appropriate sessions aligned to the Manchester City coaching philosophy and curriculum, working across multiple venues in Perth as required. Day to day, you will keep sessions organised, safe and engaging, while also supporting player progress through simple reporting, reflection and feedback.

 

You will work closely with the Head Coach and wider programme team to maintain consistent standards and a positive experience for children, parents and carers. This role also involves communicating clearly with families, contributing to programme improvement and taking part in ongoing learning and development as the programme grows.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ A recognised coaching qualification, with a minimum UEFA C or AFC C Licence.

⚽ Experience coaching children or young players in a grassroots, community or football education setting.

⚽ Ability to plan and deliver inclusive, engaging sessions that support enjoyment, learning and confidence.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills when working with children, parents, carers and colleagues.

⚽ Ability to work flexibly across afternoons, evenings and weekends, and to travel between Perth venues as required.

⚽ A valid Western Australian Working With Children Check, or willingness to obtain one, together with the ability to work exclusively for Manchester City in Western Australia and not with other football or coaching organisations while in this role.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our Perth Football Education Program, you will have the opportunity to coach within a global football environment that values player development, inclusion and quality delivery. You will be supported to bring the Manchester City coaching philosophy to life for children and families across Western Australia.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Please note that successful applicants will be expected to work exclusively for Manchester City in Western Australia and not provide coaching services for other football or coaching organisations while engaged in this role.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in Australia.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all Perth-based CFG roles will be subject to any relevant safeguarding or working-with-children checks required for the job role and responsibilities.
job.plain_text_description:
Based in Perth, Australia, this casual role gives you the chance to deliver engaging football education sessions for children across the Manchester City Perth Football Education Program. You will help create a positive, inclusive and development-focused environment where young players can enjoy the game, build confidence and learn through high-quality coaching.
Who We Are
Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.
Within the Manchester City Perth Football Education Program, we deliver football experiences that are welcoming, well-structured and enjoyable for children and families across Western Australia. Our coaches play an important part in bringing the Club's philosophy to life through sessions that support confidence, learning and a love of the game.
The Role
This role sits at the heart of the Perth program and is focused on delivering high-quality football education sessions for children in a way that feels inclusive, fun and purposeful. You will help young players develop their skills, enjoy their football and feel supported in an environment that reflects Manchester City's coaching values.
You will plan and deliver age-appropriate sessions aligned to the Manchester City coaching philosophy and curriculum, working across multiple venues in Perth as required. Day to day, you will keep sessions organised, safe and engaging, while also supporting player progress through simple reporting, reflection and feedback.
You will work closely with the Head Coach and wider programme team to maintain consistent standards and a positive experience for children, parents and carers. This role also involves communicating clearly with families, contributing to programme improvement and taking part in ongoing learning and development as the programme grows.
What You’ll Bring
⚽ A recognised coaching qualification, with a minimum UEFA C or AFC C Licence.
⚽ Experience coaching children or young players in a grassroots, community or football education setting.
⚽ Ability to plan and deliver inclusive, engaging sessions that support enjoyment, learning and confidence.
⚽ Clear and effective communication skills when working with children, parents, carers and colleagues.
⚽ Ability to work flexibly across afternoons, evenings and weekends, and to travel between Perth venues as required.
⚽ A valid Western Australian Working With Children Check, or willingness to obtain one, together with the ability to work exclusively for Manchester City in Western Australia and not with other football or coaching organisations while in this role.
Why Choose Us
Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.
As part of our Perth Football Education Program, you will have the opportunity to coach within a global football environment that values player development, inclusion and quality delivery. You will be supported to bring the Manchester City coaching philosophy to life for children and families across Western Australia.
How to Apply
If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.
Please note that successful applicants will be expected to work exclusively for Manchester City in Western Australia and not provide coaching services for other football or coaching organisations while engaged in this role.
Equal Opportunities
City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.
We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.
All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in Australia.
Due to our safeguarding promise, all Perth-based CFG roles will be subject to any relevant safeguarding or working-with-children checks required for the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning Engineer
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role plays an important part in keeping our campus facilities running safely, reliably and to a high standard. You will help maintain and support the mechanical and HVAC systems that underpin day-to-day operations, contributing to a well-managed environment for colleagues and visitors across City Football Group. This role includes occasional weekend and evening work to support football fixtures and events.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Within our maintenance team, we look after the systems and spaces that help the site operate smoothly every day. We work with care, pace and accountability, bringing together practical expertise and collaboration to support a safe, reliable and high-quality environment across the campus.

 

The Role

 

At City Football Group, the maintenance team plays a vital part in keeping our buildings and plant in excellent working order. As Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning Engineer, you will help deliver the maintenance services that support safe, efficient operations across the campus, with a clear focus on standards, safety and reliability.

 

Your work will cover planned preventive maintenance, reactive maintenance and day-to-day inspection of heating, ventilation and air conditioning assets. You will respond promptly to breakdowns, fault-find carefully and support minor installation, upgrade and adaptation works where needed.

 

Working closely with other trades and Maintenance Managers, you will contribute to planned maintenance and life cycle schedules for the buildings on site. This is a hands-on role where good judgement, teamwork and a consistent approach all help keep the campus operating at its best.

 

What You’ll Bring

 NVQ Level 3 in HVAC, Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification

 Valid F-Gas Category 1 certification

 NVQ Level 2 or Level 3 in Refrigeration and Air Conditioning, or an equivalent qualification

 Experience maintaining commercial air conditioning and refrigeration systems

 Experience carrying out planned preventive maintenance and reactive maintenance

 Ability to diagnose faults and respond safely to breakdowns, with a sound understanding of HVAC controls and building services

 

We are also keen to hear from applicants who have the following skills;

  • BMS Knowledge
  • IPAF Licence.
  • PASMA Certification.
  • Experience using CAFM systems.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 1 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We will review applications after the closing date and contact shortlisted candidates about the next stage of the process.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: 2025 Marketing Matchday Activation Intern
job.html_description:
Columbus Crew Job Opportunity



Description

Do you have a passion for marketing, promotions, and fan development? The Columbus Crew is looking for outgoing and engaging college students to serve as Marketing Matchday Activation interns for the 2025 MLS season. This position provides a variety of sports-marketing related learning experiences, specifically in event production and fan experience.

 

Opportunities & Responsibilities
  • Execute matchday activations including coordinating with on-site vendors, placing banners, setting up tents, tables, and running supporter engagement stations
  • Demonstrate and maintain Crew brand standards while serving as an ambassador of the brand
  • Assist in executing in-match experiences, halftime contests and pre/post-match activations
  • Provide a fun, entertaining and positive experience by interacting and engaging with Lower.com Field guests
  • Promote the Crew by creating a positive and exciting atmosphere while interacting with guests, sponsors, and supporters
  • Assist guests with various Matchday elements
  • Assist with additional Crew grassroots and marketing events as needed

 

Required skills, experience & abilities
  • Available for the entire 2025 MLS Season
  • Max of 20 hours per match week paid hourly
  • Must be a minimum of 18 years of age and an active student or recent graduate of a college or university program
  • Ability to attend ALL regular and post-season Crew home matches, including evening and weekend assignments
  • Must be able to lift and maneuver a minimum of 50 pounds
  • Must be able to climb ladders, carry, walk, sit, push, pull and move continuously during work hours
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse population, including strong verbal communication skills. Customer service experience a plus
  • Able to work independently and with a team
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays

job.title: Assistant Groundskeeper
job.html_description:
Want to learn and have fun in a high-end sports environment? The Columbus Crew is looking for a
motivated candidate with a strong work ethic and attention to detail, to join the staff as an Assistant
Groundskeeper. Based at the Ohio Health Performance Center, this role will assist in maintaining the 3.5
natural grass and 3 synthetic fields on property as well as assist at Scotts Miracle-Gro Field as needed.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
• Assist in grounds operations at Ohio Health Performance Center, Historic Crew Stadium, and Scotts Miracle-Gro Field
• Assist in day-to-day operations for first team, Crew 2, and academy trainings
• Assist in hosting matches and events at Historic Crew Stadium and Lower.com Field
• Assist in training part-time staff in maintenance practices and equipment use

Desired Experience
• Degree in Turf related field or comparable experience preferred
• Previous experience or working knowledge of professional sports turf standards
• Previous use of turf maintenance equipment/machinery
• Ride-on sprayer usage

Preferred Knowledge or Willingness to Learn
• In-ground irrigation
• Turf stress and disease Identification
• General knowledge of fertilizers
• Basic equipment maintenance

This position will have the opportunity:
• To learn turf growing techniques in unique environments
• To learn and use inground field heating, Subair, and grow lighting
• For overtime
• For membership, registration, and attendance at local and national turf conferences
• To obtain Ohio Department of Agriculture pesticide applicator license
• To pursue other desired career development of interest

job.title: Groundskeeping Intern
job.html_description:
Overview
The Columbus Crew is pursuing to hire an enthusiastic seasonal grounds member for the 2026 MLS season to provide hands-on experience in a diverse professional sporting environment. The grounds department is responsible for all grounds management at Scott’sMiracle-Gro Field, Historic Crew Stadium, and the Ohio Health Performance Center. 

This position requires working hours during Crew home matches and stadium events. You will have the opportunity for additional hours depending on event and team training schedules.

Opportunities & Responsibilities
  • Aid in all aspects of field maintenance at all three field sites
  • Exposure to agronomic practices, planning, and implementation
  • Exposure and education on synthetic turf, grow lighting, glycol field heating, and Subair
  • Assist in grounds operations for Crew home matches
  • Assist in grounds operations for special events including concerts

Required skills, experience & abilities
  • Active college students or recent graduates preferably in turf related field (Preferred)
  • Must be able to lift and maneuver a minimum of 50 pounds
  • Must be able to climb ladders, carry, walk, sit, push, pull, and move continuously during work hours
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varied weather conditions
  • Able to work independently and take initiative
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends and holidays

job.title: Manager, Performance & Player Development - Crew 2 & Academy
job.html_description:
Overview
Columbus Crew is searching for an energetic and passionate individual for a Manager of Performance, Player Development full time role. This exciting opportunity embeds the individual into the day-to-day programming of our player development pathway. The Crew is invested in the individual development of each athlete within our player pathway. This role will be vital in ensuring the maximization of their potential through the physical performance aspect of their profile. This individual should be motivated by the development of young players and be driven to contribute to their athletic journey.

Responsibilities:
  • Player Development & Leadership:
    • Lead the performance space within three main areas: emerging talents, second team and academy teams.
    • Implement and deliver plans for physical development of youth players within the club.
    • Manage the appropriate execution of the physical component of player development plans across all levels of the club.
    • Create and deliver reports on the physical component of player development across all levels of the club.
    • Establish age specific and science-based physical benchmarks to drive programs.
    • Create and maintain performance testing battery and schedule.
  • Coaches & Meetings:
    • Attend meetings with medical and performance staffs across all levels of the club.
    • Attend meetings with Crew2/Academy coaching staffs as needed.
    • Create and maintain regular meeting schedule to discuss progress of emerging talents throughout all levels of the club.
    • Act as the Performance Lead in the Emerging Talents Workgroup. 
  • On Field Coaching:
    • On field priority focus will be in attending the IDP and IDP+ sessions.
    • Establish cadence for attending first team, Crew 2, and Academy training sessions and/or matches.
    • Provide cross coverage of Crew 2 and Academy teams as needed (i.e. run warm up, RTP, or gym sessions).
  • Load Management & Injury Prevention:
    • Lead development of periodization and programming for emerging talents.
    • Work closely with Crew 2/Academy performance staff in load management and injury prevention.
    • Ensure all information is aligned within One Club philosophy.
  • Administrative:
    • Maintain appropriate reports that detail plans and progressions for player development.
    • Establish cadence for reporting on emerging talents progress physical development.
  • Return to Play Programming:
    • Ensure Crew 2/Academy performance staff have built appropriate RTP.
  • Leadership:
    • Provide leadership to Crew 2/Academy performance staff.
    • Provide support for Crew 2/Academy performance staff in day to day operations.
  • Pre-Season & Away Games:
    • Work closely with Crew 2/Academy performance staff to establish appropriate preseason physical periodization.
    • Attend preseason trips with Crew 2 as necessary and required.
    • Create a travel schedule for Crew 2/Academy away games and tournaments that fosters leadership, evaluation and support of Crew 2/performance staff.
  • Technology Platforms:
    • Use club's technology platforms to analyze physical development of emerging talents across all levels of the club.
    • Prepare individual physical development programs with second team and academy performance staff for players based off of data collected on these platforms.
  • Community:
    • Interact with local soccer community.
    • Making public appearances and participating in promotional and sponsorship activities on behalf of the Team (and its sponsors) as are reasonable in Employee's position as Manager, Performance (Player Development) without additional compensation.
    • Involve players with the community outreach activities.
  • Other Duties:
    • Performing such other duties reasonably consistent with Employee's employment as Fitness Coach that may from time to time be reasonably determined by the Director of Sports Science and/or club leadership.

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited College/University in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physical Education, or related field (required).
  • Master's degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physical Education or related field (preferred).
  • Minimum of three (3) years' experience in working with and developing elite level youth athletes (required).
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) by the NSCA, UKSCA, or ASCA or equivalent internationally recognized Strength and Conditioning certification (required).
  • Certified Performance and Sports Scientist (CPSS) by NSCA (preferred).
  • First Aid and CPR certified.
  • Previous experience working as a part of a multi-disciplinary team.
  • Experience in utilizing sports science technologies and athlete management systems such as: STATSports, Vald Performance, Kitman Labs, etc.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to quickly build trust and relationships with players and staff.
  • Fluency in multiple languages would be considered an asset.
  • Extensive computer knowledge, including MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Zoom.
  • An ongoing awareness and responsiveness to client satisfaction.
  • A high level of accuracy, attention to detail and confidentiality, 
  • Proven ability to listen, understand and communicate effectively. 
  • Proven to perform well under pressure, manage multiple priorities simultaneously within a highly dynamic environment.
  • Accepting direction while also displaying a high level of initiative.
  • Ability to grasp new concepts quickly and comfortable and capable in meeting deadlines.
  • On call availability and flexibility and willingness to work evenings, weekends and holidays with ability to travel when necessary.
  • A positive, winning attitude, incorporating integrity and discretion.
  • A strong understanding of growth and maturation & pediatric exercise

job.title: Scoreboard Operations Intern
job.html_description:
Description
The Columbus Crew are looking for a qualified, highly motivated intern to join the Scoreboard Operations staff for the 2026-2027 MLS seasons. This position will assist with motion graphic animation, video editing, system engineering and event production. Candidates must be organized, quick-learners, self-starters and able to work under strict deadlines.

Opportunities & Responsibilities
• Video editing
• Motion graphic animation
• Logging video footage
• Daktronics content loading
• Support day-to-day needs of production team
• Stadium event production
• Administrative duties
• Work cross functionally, collaborating with the Marketing Department among others

Desired Skills, Experience & Abilities
• Knowledge of video editing principles (Adobe Premiere Pro).
• Knowledge of Adobe After Effects and Adobe Photoshop.
• Experience with motion graphics, design, and 2D/3D animation.
• Exceptional time management and organizational skills, with the ability to multi-task.
• Outstanding communication skills.
• Ability and willingness to work non-traditional hours (including nights, weekends and holidays).
• Ability to attend all Crew home matches, including evening and weekend assignments.
• Able to work independently and take initiative.
• Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse population, including strong verbal communication skills.
• Sports and entertainment industry experience a plus.

job.title: Director, Guest Experience
job.html_description:
Description
Columbus Crew is seeking a Director, Guest Experience that will be responsible for all guests and team members receiving world class experience when visiting all venues operated by the Columbus Crew. Under the direction of the Vice President, Operations, the Director oversees the day-to-day and event operations of the Guest Experience department ensuring the safety and comfort for all through strong training programs, policies, and procedures.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Guest Experience
    • Responsible for all Guest Experience operations across all Club facilities and events; including but not limited to Columbus Crew matches, future Columbus NWSL matches, concerts, third-party events, etc.
    • Lead an informed, motivated, and energetic staff and maintain a consistent focus on curating a best-in-class experience throughout every Club and third-party event.
    • Maintain cross-departmental connection to ensure the Guest Experience staff and general processes are supporting and enhancing broader club focuses and initiatives
    • Monitor all channels of guest communication (email, telephone, in-person, guest survey, and social media). Provide reports, identify trends and institute operational improvements. 
    • Ensure that guest information channels always have the appropriate information (Stadium Maps, Know Before You Go, Columbus Crew social media accounts and Columbus Crew website).
    • Collaborate with Safety and Security leadership to maintain emergency preparedness and have a working knowledge of all applicable safety regulations and security procedures for Columbus Crew Venues
  • Recruitment and Training
    • Develop department training and staffing plan based on service strategy, event budget and staffing matrix in collaboration with Vice President, Operations. Identify appropriate staffing levels, recruitment processes, and desired target areas to maintain the highest level of retention and service. 
    • Develop and conduct an effective and efficient recruiting, interviewing and onboarding program
    • Develop, maintain, and facilitate (as appropriate) department new hire and veteran training programs, create specialty training programs for supervisors, specialty positions and team member development opportunities. Maintain a strong presence with the service department management and frontline team members. 
  • Team Member Management
    • Create and consistently emphasize a service strategy to empower team members to provide world class service and meet organizational goals. 
    • Foster a fun and fulfilling work environment for team members.
    • Oversee scheduling and payroll on a weekly basis.
    • Create and implement staff incentive programs.
  • Effectively communicate with frontline team members to establish policies, procedures, standards, expectations, goals, and objectives.
  • Ensure fair, consistent, and timely enforcement of policies and procedures (including tracking call-offs, no-shows and overall attendance)
  • Conduct ongoing performance coaching and evaluation, identifying growth opportunities.
 
Required Skills and Experience
  • Minimum of 3 -5 years leadership experience managing teams of PT frontline event staff. Preferably, in a public assembly facility.
  • Minimum four-year college degree or equivalent experience.
  • Exceptional customer service and leadership skills, including but not limited to de-escalation, service recovery, coaching, people management, recruitment, training, and the ability to motivate a diverse workforce. 
  • Must possess strong problem solving, analysis and communication skills, both written and oral. 
  • Extremely organized, detail-orientated and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Must be able to create and deliver informative and engaging presentations to large groups of people.
  • Ability to read, interpret, update, and create training programs utilizing documents such as strategy documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance guides, application instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Familiarity with payroll and scheduling systems 
  • Clear understanding and implementation of all department and company policies and procedures
  • Must be available on varied schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays. 
  • Ability to walk, stand, and climb stairs and ramps during entire shift (8 – 12 hours)
  • Ability and willingness to work outdoors in elements for entire shift (8 – 12 hours)
  • Ability to lift, carry, and transport large boxes and items in excess of 25 lbs.
  • Ability to work long and irregular hours including nights, weekends, holidays, events including but not limited to soccer, football, concerts and private events.

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)


Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.
