job.title: Host City Volunteer Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Host City Volunteer Manager will be responsible for the delivery of the FIFA Volunteer Programme in-line with the FIFA Volunteer Framework and FIFA’s service excellence standards supported by the local operational concept. This will include full alignment with the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich on the programme strategy, mission, and vision, safeguarding the FIFA Volunteer brand and its reputation across all the host cities and assigned venues.

Reporting to the Volunteer Management Central Team – FIFA27 and working in close collaboration with the Lead of the project on the city level, the Host City Volunteer Manager will be the face of the FIFA Volunteer Programme for their respective Host City. The role will be responsible for supporting the delivery of the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform and overseeing volunteer operations within their assigned Host City.

The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following points will apply to all host cities and venues where the competition takes place.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Programme Delivery and Coordination at the Host City level
  • Collaborate with the Volunteer Management Central Team (FIFA27) and FIFA Zurich to support the delivery of the Volunteer Programme and reporting on the project status.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between FIFA27 Volunteer Management Central Team and Host City counterparts on all volunteer related matters, ensuring clear two-way coordination and information flow.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Host City queries and requests related to volunteer communications and engagement activities and projects, including volunteer-focused events.
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with Functional Area managers who engage volunteers or support volunteer management operations.
  • Act as a Point of contact for volunteer related topics with Venue Management when necessary.
  • Work closely with Host City counterparts for pre implementation of promotion and recruitment initiatives within local communities to tournament delivery including but not exclusive to training and uniform distribution
  • Support the promotion initiatives and events of the Volunteer team by:
    - Identifying volunteer profiles for media and/or social media features.
    - Maintaining an archive of photos and videos of Host City volunteers for use at the discretion of the central volunteer management team. Oversee the organization of volunteer-focused events led by the Host City.
    - Ensuring the Host City adheres to brand and communications guidelines at all times.
  • Actively represent the FIFA Volunteer Programme in public settings, including speaking at community events, hosting volunteer information sessions, and supporting recruitment activations.
  • Implement a coordinated approach with all stakeholders across all phases of the volunteer journey, including promotion, recruitment, role offers, training, and the tournament period.
  • Attend daily HQ meetings, Venue meetings and reporting on the status of the Volunteer Programme.
  • Participate in site visits to inspect potential pre-tournament and tournament-time required spaces.
  • Oversee the set-up and daily operations - act as a venue manager - dismantling and handover of the Volunteer Centres and spaces.
  • Align and coordinate with Host City and venue teams on logistics, storage, inventory, and distribution of volunteer recognition items as part of the Recognition Programme. Ensure venues adhere to the gift distribution calendar outlined in the Recognition Plan
  • Communicate with candidates and volunteers via Volunteer Support Channel and the FIFA Volunteer Platform.
Volunteer Management
  •  Recruit, train, manage, and lead Volunteer Coordinators within the assigned Host City, ensuring alignment, clear communication, and effective team collaboration.
  • Manage volunteers’ day-to-day to ensure efficient deployment and the well-being of volunteers on-site during each volunteer journey phase.
  • Ensure the volunteer services and recognition are provided as planned and liaise with local authorities when necessary.
  • Lead the recruitment, training and oversee the operation of the journey volunteers
  • Support with planning and delivery for the Official Draw, Playoffs and other FWWC27 official events, as required.
Volunteer Platform
  • Work extensively on the Volunteer Platform to manage all stages of the volunteer journey in the host city, including but not limited to interview scheduling, role assignment, uploading shifts, shift allocation, trainings, communication, Tournament-time operations and overall communications.
  • Identify and report system-related issues and diligently follow up to ensure their resolution or escalate as necessary to mitigate potential impacts.
Reporting and Feedback
  • Raise risks and concern to the Volunteer Management Central team in a timely manner
  • Prepare and submit daily reports during tournament time
  • Support the knowledge transfer programme to ensure planning and operational learnings are carried to the future events
  • Prepare and deliver the post-tournament report for the assigned Host City.
Education
  • Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
Experience
  • Experience with events, and strong understanding of volunteer management
  • Proven experience in leading and managing volunteer programmes supporting the volunteer journey, including fit for purpose attraction, promotion, recruitment, training, engagement, and tournament operations.
  • Knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience in Volunteer Management System is an advantage. (Rosterfy knowledge is preferrable)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, as well as with local networks within the Host City, especially among the football community.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and remain solution oriented.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Strong public speaking and presentation skills
  • Enthusiasm, and the ability to inspire and motivate volunteers
  • Ability to facilitate workshops, information sessions, and volunteer briefings
  • Community outreach and recruitment engagement skills.
  • Knowledge of the local landscape, community networks, and key stakeholders within the respective Host City is an advantage.
 Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Intermediate English (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently

    Expected start date: June 2, 2026
job.plain_text_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Host City Volunteer Manager will be responsible for the delivery of the FIFA Volunteer Programme in-line with the FIFA Volunteer Framework and FIFA’s service excellence standards supported by the local operational concept. This will include full alignment with the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich on the programme strategy, mission, and vision, safeguarding the FIFA Volunteer brand and its reputation across all the host cities and assigned venues.
Reporting to the Volunteer Management Central Team – FIFA27 and working in close collaboration with the Lead of the project on the city level, the Host City Volunteer Manager will be the face of the FIFA Volunteer Programme for their respective Host City. The role will be responsible for supporting the delivery of the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform and overseeing volunteer operations within their assigned Host City.
The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
The following points will apply to all host cities and venues where the competition takes place. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Programme Delivery and Coordination at the Host City level
- Collaborate with the Volunteer Management Central Team (FIFA27) and FIFA Zurich to support the delivery of the Volunteer Programme and reporting on the project status. - Act as the primary point of contact between FIFA27 Volunteer Management Central Team and Host City counterparts on all volunteer related matters, ensuring clear two-way coordination and information flow. - Act as the primary point of contact for Host City queries and requests related to volunteer communications and engagement activities and projects, including volunteer-focused events. - Establish and maintain strong working relationships with Functional Area managers who engage volunteers or support volunteer management operations. - Act as a Point of contact for volunteer related topics with Venue Management when necessary. - Work closely with Host City counterparts for pre implementation of promotion and recruitment initiatives within local communities to tournament delivery including but not exclusive to training and uniform distribution - Support the promotion initiatives and events of the Volunteer team by: - Identifying volunteer profiles for media and/or social media features. - Maintaining an archive of photos and videos of Host City volunteers for use at the discretion of the central volunteer management team. Oversee the organization of volunteer-focused events led by the Host City. - Ensuring the Host City adheres to brand and communications guidelines at all times. - Actively represent the FIFA Volunteer Programme in public settings, including speaking at community events, hosting volunteer information sessions, and supporting recruitment activations. - Implement a coordinated approach with all stakeholders across all phases of the volunteer journey, including promotion, recruitment, role offers, training, and the tournament period. - Attend daily HQ meetings, Venue meetings and reporting on the status of the Volunteer Programme. - Participate in site visits to inspect potential pre-tournament and tournament-time required spaces. - Oversee the set-up and daily operations - act as a venue manager - dismantling and handover of the Volunteer Centres and spaces. - Align and coordinate with Host City and venue teams on logistics, storage, inventory, and distribution of volunteer recognition items as part of the Recognition Programme. Ensure venues adhere to the gift distribution calendar outlined in the Recognition Plan - Communicate with candidates and volunteers via Volunteer Support Channel and the FIFA Volunteer Platform.
Volunteer Management
- Recruit, train, manage, and lead Volunteer Coordinators within the assigned Host City, ensuring alignment, clear communication, and effective team collaboration. - Manage volunteers’ day-to-day to ensure efficient deployment and the well-being of volunteers on-site during each volunteer journey phase. - Ensure the volunteer services and recognition are provided as planned and liaise with local authorities when necessary. - Lead the recruitment, training and oversee the operation of the journey volunteers - Support with planning and delivery for the Official Draw, Playoffs and other FWWC27 official events, as required.
Volunteer Platform
- Work extensively on the Volunteer Platform to manage all stages of the volunteer journey in the host city, including but not limited to interview scheduling, role assignment, uploading shifts, shift allocation, trainings, communication, Tournament-time operations and overall communications. - Identify and report system-related issues and diligently follow up to ensure their resolution or escalate as necessary to mitigate potential impacts.
Reporting and Feedback
- Raise risks and concern to the Volunteer Management Central team in a timely manner - Prepare and submit daily reports during tournament time - Support the knowledge transfer programme to ensure planning and operational learnings are carried to the future events - Prepare and deliver the post-tournament report for the assigned Host City.
Education
- Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
Experience
- Experience with events, and strong understanding of volunteer management - Proven experience in leading and managing volunteer programmes supporting the volunteer journey, including fit for purpose attraction, promotion, recruitment, training, engagement, and tournament operations. - Knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously. - High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). - Experience in Volunteer Management System is an advantage. (Rosterfy knowledge is preferrable) - Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, as well as with local networks within the Host City, especially among the football community. - Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and remain solution oriented. - A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment. - Strong public speaking and presentation skills - Enthusiasm, and the ability to inspire and motivate volunteers - Ability to facilitate workshops, information sessions, and volunteer briefings - Community outreach and recruitment engagement skills. - Knowledge of the local landscape, community networks, and key stakeholders within the respective Host City is an advantage.
Requirements
- Right to work in Brazil - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Intermediate English (spoken and written) - Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independentlyExpected start date: June 2, 2026

job.title: Training & Readiness Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Manager, Training & Readiness (Safety & Security) is responsible for designing, implementing and overseeing the tournament-wide capability-building, training and readiness programme for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role ensures that all safety and security personnel — including direct hires and supplier staff — meet defined competence, licensing and readiness standards prior to deployment.

The position establishes structured training frameworks, certification processes and exercise programmes to ensure operational preparedness across stadiums and non-competition sites. The role supports the creation of a sustainable safety and security legacy in Brazil through structured upskilling and professionalisation of the workforce.

• Conduct a comprehensive market capability and capacity analysis to identify gaps and risks related to the provision of staffed safety and security services
• Identify applicable qualification, certification and licensing criteria within Brazil and its federal states relevant to guarding, stewarding, close protection and related disciplines
• Design and implement a bespoke capability-building strategy for internal staff and external security suppliers
• Design and deliver security training programmes tailored to specific roles (e.g. security guards, stewards, supervisors, managers, TSLOs/RSLOs and direct hires)
• Develop and implement a structured training curriculum and training materials aligned with the Safety & Security Strategy and Operational Plan
• Design, develop and implement analogue and digital training solutions, including instructor-led programmes, workshops and e-learning packages, ensuring scalable, accessible and role-specific learning delivery across all safety and security personnel
• Define readiness criteria and certification processes for safety and security personnel prior to deployment
• Establish systems to track workforce competence, training completion and deployment readiness across all official tournament sites
• Coordinate and oversee joint exercises, table-top simulations, venue rehearsals and scenario-based drills to test operational response and inter-agency coordination
• Design and implement programmes to ensure compliance with statutory qualification and licensing standards on site, including the development of quality control audit processes
• Engage with safety and security suppliers to ensure that capability-building programmes are delivered effectively and that all personnel are trained before commencing work
• Coordinate with other FWWC2027 functional areas to ensure alignment on policies, procedures and response protocols
• Oversee the delivery and evaluation of drills, simulations and readiness exercises to ensure operational effectiveness
• Identify training gaps and implement corrective actions through continuous improvement processes
• Conduct on-site quality control audits to verify training completion, certification and operational competence
• Support senior management and site management in verifying training-related supplier invoices and compliance documentation

Education
• University degree in security management, education and training, public safety, risk management or a related field
• Professional training qualification or certification (e.g. instructional design, adult learning, security training accreditation) is desirable

Experience
• Experience in safety and security training, workforce readiness or operational preparedness roles
• Demonstrated experience designing and delivering structured training programmes in large-scale operational environments
• Experience coordinating exercises, simulations and multi-agency readiness activities
• Familiarity with Brazilian licensing and qualification requirements in the security sector
• Experience working with public security authorities and private security suppliers

Skills & Competencies
• Strong instructional design and training delivery capability
• Structured and analytical approach to readiness measurement and workforce tracking
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Ability to coordinate complex multi-stakeholder exercises and rehearsals
• Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement capability
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements:
• Right to work in Brazil. 
• Fluent in English (spoken and written)
• Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
• Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Event Marketing Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Team Lead, Event Marketing (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Event Marketing Coordinator will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, and will work in close collaboration with the Event Marketing in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for all marketing campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the creation and implementation of strategic, high impact, end-to-end marketing campaigns to meet and exceed the objectives of the Tournament 
  • In line with the wider FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich teams, contribute to the GTM multi-channel marketing plans (in close liaison with the digital marketing, ticketing, comms, BI, and brand teams) to support strategic goals to drive awareness, attendance, engagement and retainment 
  • Coordinate between internal and external tournament stakeholders as directed including Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners, and Official Media Partners and Licensees  
  • Support the development of cross cultural and sector tactical and long-term  
    strategical promotional partnerships with partners and third parties for mutual benefit 
  • Assist with the creation of relevant briefing, publishing plans, planning, valuation, tracking and final reporting documents related to marketing stakeholder’s needs as required 
  • Support the team to deliver launches of major brand assets, such as tournament logos, mascots, posters, and songs, as well as oversee multi-stage global and localised awareness and tournament related sales campaigns  
  • Ad-hoc support of additional workstreams in relation to event marketing needs which may include contact/planning/liaising and coordination with stakeholders with football clubs or participating member associations (PMA’s) 
  • Become an expert in FIFA event marketing milestone planning and FIFA processes and organise and maintain an updated library of marketing-related assets ensuring all files are easy to locate, properly labelled, and accessible to the team 
  • Assist in providing stakeholders with timely and accurate information on promotional and marketing events, activations and opportunities and ensure stakeholders to drive optimisation of the opportunities. 
  • Provide administrative and project support across the Event Marketing team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders as needed 
Education 
  • Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education. 
Skills & Competencies 
  • Adaptable, effective and efficient under pressure, immovable deadlines, and in stressful situations  
  • Effective at working proactively and independently whilst providing regular updates, being able to communicate clearly and effectively via different channels with key stakeholders 
  • Ability to convey ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders 
  • Willingness to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed 
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail in all tasks and deliverables 
Work Experience 
  • Experience in a marketing function favourable to hold experience with sport’s governing bodies, LOCs and, or sports and entertainment rightsholders 
  • Understanding of the dynamics of football 
  • Experience in Brand Marketing and Marketing Operations, Communications, Events 
  • A passion for football 
Technology 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools (Monday.com)  
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel Commercial Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
The Senior Counsel will be an active member of the Commercial Legal Team working in a “team first” approach to support the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global operations.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel will support as follows:
  • Reporting to the Commercial Legal team leads
  • Assist in supporting on legal matters relating to FIFA’s Innovation and Technology operations
  • Provide legal support in the following areas:
    • FIFA’s direct to consumer media offerings, (including distribution and syndication and advertising sales)
    • hardware and software procurement
    • the collection of match data
    • ensuring appropriate ownership, protection and exploitation of FIFA-proprietary technology developments and collaborations
    • website and other consumer-facing T&Cs in the digital environment
    • FIFA’s data and artificial intelligence initiatives
    • FIFA’s innovation portfolios (including VR/XR and AI related matters)
  • General commercial legal support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities
  • Support as point of contact for legal matters for FIFA’s Football, Technology and Innovation Department
  • Providing strategic liaison with FIFA’s Data Protection department to ensure seamless integration into FIFA digital products
  • Providing detailed knowledge of FIFA’s rights and obligations in connection with its digital and technology programmes, including the implementation and protection thereof; including the provision of legal and contractual input on FIFA’s existing commercial commitments and future commercial possibilities
  • Providing commercial transactional support and guidance regarding the interpretation of relevant commercial agreements, including the assessment of relevant business and strategic risks, and commercial regulatory matters
  • Developing and maintaining suitable template agreements
  • Support in the delivery of ad hoc advice on issues relating to technology related activities
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

This role would suit someone with great organisational and communication skills who is a dedicated team player and excels in being professional with excellent legal skills.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Ability to participate and be part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice
  • Excellent understanding of the digital and technology industry landscapes
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, well-organised with a strong eye for detail
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanour
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organisation and internal clients
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from a top-tier accredited law school
  • Active bar membership is required
  • Minimum of 7 years expertise "on the job" in the industry in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on relevant matters
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish) is an asset but not necessary
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Comfortable with international travel
  • Readiness for stand-by duties and special projects
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Ticketing Training Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Ticketing Training Coordinator plays a key role in the preparation of all required training programmes for the Ticketing department prior to, and during, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Reporting organizationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring tournament time Ticketing Workforce are effectively prepared to deliver in their role. 

The Ticketing Training Coordinator will be required to lead activities related to learning needs analysis, training design, training delivery, logistical planning and reporting.

Training is expected to be delivered across a variety of mediums including – e-learning, face to face, self study and additional knowledge base resources.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The key responsibilities and oversights of the Ticketing Training Coordinator include:   
  • Develop, design, and or adapt existing e-learning content using Rapid Authoring Tool(s) such as Adobe Captivate or similar. 
  • Collaborate with Ticketing Operations experts to gather information and ensure the accuracy of training modules. 
  • Support other Ticketing teams in their training planning in relation to the e-learning tool. 
  • Support Ticketing Operations teams in designing and delivering face to face training content and supporting resources. 
  • Integrate and manage e-learning content within the Learning Management System (LMS). 
  • Ensure all e-learning modules are accessible and user-friendly for a diverse audience. 
  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through assessments and feedback. 
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for e-learning modules and LMS issues.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of all training materials and development processes. 
  • Coordinate with the IT department to ensure seamless operation of e-learning platforms. 
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards and industry regulations in all training content. 
  • Conduct regular reviews and updates of e-learning content to maintain relevance and effectiveness. 
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in e-learning and instructional design. 
  • Support general ticketing operations for other FIFA events as required.
Education/ Experience 
  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education  
  • 1-3 years of professional experience 
  • Experience in training design and delivery
  • Experience in delivering e-learning as a training solution and managing LMS systems 
  • Highly accurate and detail-oriented working style, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player 
  • Native-level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued 
 Skills & Competencies 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams) and online collaboration tools 
  • Proficient in e-learning Rapid Authoring Tools
  • Knowledge and understanding of Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Able to think creatively and ‘outside of the box’ to deliver solutions in a fast-faced- environment 
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities 
  • Skilled in facilitating collaboration between various business areas 
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred
job.plain_text_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Ticketing Training Coordinator plays a key role in the preparation of all required training programmes for the Ticketing department prior to, and during, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Reporting organizationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring tournament time Ticketing Workforce are effectively prepared to deliver in their role.
The Ticketing Training Coordinator will be required to lead activities related to learning needs analysis, training design, training delivery, logistical planning and reporting.
Training is expected to be delivered across a variety of mediums including – e-learning, face to face, self study and additional knowledge base resources.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
The key responsibilities and oversights of the Ticketing Training Coordinator include:
- Develop, design, and or adapt existing e-learning content using Rapid Authoring Tool(s) such as Adobe Captivate or similar. - Collaborate with Ticketing Operations experts to gather information and ensure the accuracy of training modules. - Support other Ticketing teams in their training planning in relation to the e-learning tool. - Support Ticketing Operations teams in designing and delivering face to face training content and supporting resources. - Integrate and manage e-learning content within the Learning Management System (LMS). - Ensure all e-learning modules are accessible and user-friendly for a diverse audience. - Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through assessments and feedback. - Provide technical support and troubleshooting for e-learning modules and LMS issues. - Maintain comprehensive documentation of all training materials and development processes. - Coordinate with the IT department to ensure seamless operation of e-learning platforms. - Ensure compliance with organizational standards and industry regulations in all training content. - Conduct regular reviews and updates of e-learning content to maintain relevance and effectiveness. - Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in e-learning and instructional design. - Support general ticketing operations for other FIFA events as required.
Education/ Experience
- Bachelor degree or similar level of education - 1-3 years of professional experience - Experience in training design and delivery - Experience in delivering e-learning as a training solution and managing LMS systems - Highly accurate and detail-oriented working style, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player - Native-level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued
Skills & Competencies
- Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams) and online collaboration tools - Proficient in e-learning Rapid Authoring Tools - Knowledge and understanding of Learning Management Systems (LMS) - Able to think creatively and ‘outside of the box’ to deliver solutions in a fast-faced- environment - Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities - Skilled in facilitating collaboration between various business areas - Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones
Certifications & Requirements
- Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro - Right to work in Brazil - Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time - Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred

job.title: Licensing & Retail Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Coordinate and manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders to oversee production workflows and the end-to-end process for premium gifts and giveaways, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and FIFA brand guidelines. 
  • Assist in coordinating and managing licensing agreements with partners, ensuring compliance with contractual terms and timelines.
  • Support the production and distribution of licensed merchandise, including coordinating with suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners.
  • Analyse sales data and generate reports on merchandise performance, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to optimize sales strategies.
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to gather insights on consumer preferences, trends, and potential opportunities for licensing and retail activities.
  • Support the development and execution of marketing and promotional campaigns for licensed merchandise, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate inventory records, monitoring stock levels, and coordinating inventory replenishment as needed.
  • Provide operational support for retail partnerships, including coordinating product displays, ensuring brand compliance, and addressing partner inquiries.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective communication and alignment.
  • Manage the product approval of different Licensees across the three phases: graphic, pre-production and production.
  • Support the maintenance of licensing and retail databases and systems, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information.
  • Assist in managing licensing and retail budgets, tracking expenses, and providing financial analysis and reporting.
  • Support the coordination of licensing and retail-related events, such as trade shows, product launches, and promotional activities.  
Competencies and personality 
  • Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Knowledge about Brazilian market trends.
  • Good understanding of product development, go-to-market processes, and retail distribution models.
  • Positive attitude, patience, persistent, eager and quick lerner.
  • Good organizational and back-office skills.
Education & Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing, Business Administration, Product Management, etc.
  • Relevant work experience in licensing & event retail across Brazilian market.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Right to work in Brazil.

job.title: MA Africa, Intern/Apprentice
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:

·        Providing operational support to the Deputy Chief Member Associations Officer
·        Provide administrative support to the Paris team and conduct research
·        Prepare reports, presentations, meeting minutes, and project documentation
·        Follow up on project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
·        Coordinate logistics for Member Association delegations visiting the Paris office
·        Assist in organizing meetings, workshops, and official missions
·        Supporting the team in the organisation of workshops and seminars, including education and capacity building
·        Improve the service to the MAs with the help of external stakeholders and other departments/divisions
·        Assist in the development and implementation of specific football development projects within Africa in collaboration with other FIFA departments
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:

·        Strong organizational and communication skills
·        Proactive, reliable, and detail-oriented
·        Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
·        Team player with a collaborative mindset
·        Interest in football development and international organizations
·        Bachelor's or Master's student (Currently pursuing or recent graduate) in Sports Management, Law, Business, International Relations, or a related field
·        Strong analytical and writing skills
·        Good knowledge of project management principles
·        Interest in international development and sport
·        Previous internship or project experience is an asset
·        Experience in administration or project coordination is an asset
·        Experience in an international or multicultural environment is an asset
·        Sport organization experience is an advantage
·        Volunteer experience in sport is welcomed
·        Fluent in English
·        Proficiency in any other FIFA language (F / AR / ES) is an asset
·        Willingness to travel when/if required  
·        Availability to work from the Paris office four days per week
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Home office: Up to one day of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Media Partnerships Services Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27, the Media Partnerships Services Manager will play a key role in the planning and servicing of FIFA’s Media Partners, the Rights Holding Broadcasters for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 with all logistical and administrative issues related to Media Partners.
  • Assist in managing event-related projects in collaboration with internal FIFA stakeholders and external entities.
  • Support the planning and organisation of various workshops, milestone events and venue tours for the Media Partners. 
  • Develop strong working relationships with key internal FIFA27 functional areas to ensure effective collaboration.
  • Contribute to the seamless delivery of services to Media Partners during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence. 
  • Work hand in hand with the Media Partnerships Relations Manager to address specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities.

Education
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education.
  • Higher education in Media or Sports Event Management.
Experience
  • Strong experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry and/or Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
Skills & Competencies
  • ACCOUNTABILITY: We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • INITIATIVE: We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
  • DECISION MAKING: We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances. 
  • INNOVATION: We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
  • VISION: We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization's global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality. 
  • INCLUSIVITY: We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams. Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
Requirements
  • Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portuguese. Any other language is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools.
  • This position requires travel to participate in meetings and venue tours across Brazil.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: IPTV & CATV Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecom Manager, the CATV/IPTV Manager will be a key member of the FWWC27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the Technology teams based in Brazil and Zurich and other key individuals responsible for delivering the CATV and IPTV solutions required for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage the CATV/IPTV service planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The service includes:
    o   CATV and IPTV systems in Stadia and IBCC
    o   Streaming to various platforms
    o   VOD services 
    o   TVs in all FWWC27 Venues
  • Organize procurement of CATV/IPTV services, manage the selected supplier
  • Review Legacy and Overlay CATV/IPTV design documentation and ensure it meets FIFA requirements.
  • Actively participate in the scope and R&R definition, liaison with different stakeholders, including Host Broadcaster, Stadia, CATV/IPTV suppliers etc.
  • Lead the CATV/IPTV infrastructure design, implementation and integration, ensuring it meets FIFA Standards and requirements
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient usage of Legacy Network services. 
  • Ensure the Project scope, timelines and budget are respected by all the stakeholders. Track the progress of CATV/IPTV Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Infrastructure projects and operations, according to Technology governance and keep counterparts aligned  
  • Liaise with and / or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.  Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel

Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field
Experience
  • Strong experience in CATV/IPTV
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex CATV/IPTV Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professional
Skills & Competencies
  • Manager with experience in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events 
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in CATV/IPTV/Streaming Services, including infrastructure design, implementation, integration and connectivity. 
  • Should have broad understanding of CATV/IPTV, Streaming and Broadcast Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events and sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of following protocols/technologies: H.264/H.265 encoding, Multicast, SRT, RTMP, DVB, fiber convertors, etc.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee 
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones  
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members 
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance  
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Certifications & Requirements
  •  Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Access Management Systems & Applications Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, the Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and managing a range of tools to assist in the planning and delivery of access operations of the FWWC2027 at all stadiums and the IBCC.  Such tools will include:


•             Access Management System (AMS).


Working closely with the Access Management Senior Manager, FIFA Corporate Access Manager and IT, help develop the AMS in its functionalities, reporting systems and set up. 


The Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will manage 1 Coordinator, whose primary function will be to support the Manager. Together you will train and provide support to the venue team in each Host City as well as deal with the system provider, Fortress.   


The Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will be an active member of the Access Management (ACS) HQ team throughout the planning phases and the tournament period.

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Access Management Systems & Applications Manager for the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 include: 

•             Help develop the AMS. 
•             Setup the AMS for the Tournament 
•             Provide training and training materials on the system to ACS, ACR and SEC staff.
•             Be the central focal point for issue resolution on the AMS system. 
•             Oversee the distribution and collection of the AMS physical devices. 
•             Provide central support as part of ACS Main HQ team during the tournament.
Education:
·        Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. 
·        Qualifications or extensive experience in access management systems. 
·        If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
·        Qualifications in IT systems.
·        FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. 
·        Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
·        Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
·        Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
·        Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

 Experience:

·        Minimum experience of 4 years in the sport event industry, with access management systems, ticketing systems or similar for large scale events.
·        Experience in delivering training.  
·        Single-sport, multi-venue event experience.
·        Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. 
·        Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure

 
Skills & Competencies:
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyze one’s behavior, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
INITIATIVE: Capacity to do things on one’s own initiative and to influence the course of events, assume responsibilities, and achieve objectives with a minimum of supervision and control.

job.title: Guest Experience Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Guest Experience Manager is responsible for the development and implementation of the guest experience concept exclusively within the FIFA VIP Hotel environment, including the FIFA Club.

This role focuses on brand implementation, experiential elements, FIFA Club concept (including F&B), and curated guest touchpoints such as gifts and in-hotel experiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead the development and execution of the VIP Guest Experience concept within the FIFA VIP Hotel, including FIFA Club, brand implementation, and experiential elements (e.g. gifts, amenities, and curated guest touchpoints).
  • Define the FIFA Club concept (including F&B, design, and guest journey) and oversee its implementation.
  • Supervise the tender process, evaluation, and appointment of guest experience suppliers related to VIP Hotel and FIFA Club delivery (e.g. experiential agencies, branding, F&B concept providers).
  • Coordinate and maintain a strategic overview of all guest experience activities within the VIP Hotel environment.
  • During tournament time, act as FIFA Club Manager (or oversee FIFA Club Manager role), responsible for operational setup and delivery of the FIFA Club.
  • Collaborate with relevant functional areas to ensure alignment of VIP Hotel guest experience delivery (e.g. Accommodation, Protocol, Transport, Branding).
  • Establish clear lines of communication and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and involved parties.
  • Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for all relevant suppliers, their service staff, and volunteers, focusing on excellence and ‘wow’ customer service.
  • Attend site visits and inspections.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Management, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Marketing & Communications, or a related field. Specialization in hospitality, event management, or experience design is an advantage.
Experience:
  • Experience in developing and delivering premium VIP guest experience concepts and operations, ideally within hotel environments, hospitality settings, or large-scale events.
  • Extensive experience in concept development and implementation of guest experience elements, including branding, scenography, F&B concepts, and curated guest touchpoints.
  • Experience in designing and delivering premium hospitality environments (e.g. lounges, clubs, VIP spaces, or hotel-based experiences).
  • Proven experience in managing and coordinating external agencies and suppliers for experience delivery (e.g. production, branding, F&B, experiential agencies).
  • Hands-on experience in implementing on-site guest experience concepts, including setup, testing, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments, coordinating with hospitality, accommodation, and operational stakeholders.
Skills & Competencies:
  • Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to ensure high-quality delivery of premium guest experience standards.
  • Ability to translate conceptual ideas into operational execution, ensuring consistency between design and on-site delivery.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate, manage, and resolve complex situations in fast-paced environments.
  • Proven ability to manage and steer multiple external suppliers and agencies to deliver against defined concepts and timelines.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder management skills across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously.
  • High level of adaptability and resilience in dynamic, high-pressure event environments.
  • Solid understanding of premium hospitality environments and guest expectations.
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint; Project or similar tools is an advantage)
Certifications & Requirements:
  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Additional certifications in hospitality, event management, or experience design are considered a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager and working closely with the Ticketing Group Sales Manager, the Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will support the implementation of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers, to specifically fulfil all Group Sales ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these customers. The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations, whilst providing support to Group Sales customers with ticketing issues and enquiries. 

The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement customer care processes across all established communications channels (email, phone, and any other ticketing bespoke systems), in line with the applicable strategy. 
  •  Support regular quality assurance checks across the customer care operation, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations. 
  •  Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required. 
  •  Support and maintain relationships with Group Sales customers, resolving issues and enquiries. 
  •  Monitor ticket inventory, order status and deadlines for Group Sales bookings. 
  •  Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable. 
  •  Present ticketing information to Group Sales customers and other stakeholders, both in person and online, as required. 
  •  Follow established communication and escalation processes and support their consistent implementation across stakeholders. 
  •  Implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible. 
  •  Support the research and implementation of solutions to increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team and maximize customer information and satisfaction. 
  •  Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered. 
  •  Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks and implement processes to mitigate them. 
  •  Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc. 
  •  Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge. 
  •  Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages. 
  •  Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements. 
  •  Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience in the planning and delivery of a similar project for a major international sports event. 
  • Experience in customer care delivery for Group Sales, corporate customers and/or business stakeholders. 
  • Experience working within small, cross-functional teams, with exposure to day-to-day task coordination. 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests. 
  • Ticketing. 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for major sports events. 
  • Customer Service. 
  • Excellent communication and relationship management. 
  • Good numeracy. 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation. 
  • Accountability and Transparency. 
  • Analysis and Innovation. 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability. 
  • Perseverance and Dedication. 
  • Proactivity and Organisation. 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation.
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Fluent in Spanish, French or German, spoken and written.   
 
TECHNOLOGY 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.   
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Non-Competition Venue Dressing Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all non-competition FIFA Official Sites. 

This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.  
Non-competition venues are crucial to the successful delivery of a successful FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, the below list is a non-exhaustive list of venues that the successful candidate may be responsible for: 
  • Team Base Camp Training Sites 
  • Team Base Camp Hotels 
  • VIP Hotels 
  • Accreditation Centres 
  • Ticketing Centres 
  • Volunteer Centres 
  • Airports 
  • International Broadcast Centre (IBC) 
  • Outside Presentation Facility (OPF) 
  • Main Operations Centre (MOC) 
The successful candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the dressing and signage planning and implementation at all FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ non-competition venues Brazil. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their cluster and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their cluster, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with the wider Dressing and Signage team to maximise creativity and ensure consistency across all non-competition venues. 
There will also be a potential need to relocate to another Host City for up to three months to take the role as Venue Dressing and Signage Managers during event periods at an assigned stadium. 

Key Responsibilities 
  • Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups who require the services of non-competition venues at the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™. 
  • Overseeing the turnkey planning and delivery of non-competition venue dressing and signage across the tournament.  
  • Collaborating with the other Venue Dressing and Signage Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament official sites.  
  • Working closely with the Stadium Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximise efficiencies across the wider project.  
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all non-competition venues. 
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing and signage operations and reporting updates into the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. 
  • Providing strategic input into the non-competition venue dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.  
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.  
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimised at all stages of the project.  
  • Liaising with non-competition owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.  
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.  
  • Attending department-specific and organisation site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.  
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing and wayfinding signage strategies utilising expertise from previous events and directives from management.  
  • Acting as the non-competition venues point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project.  
  • Participating in the creative design process for the non-competition venues.  
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.  
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against.  
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.  
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.
  • Strong experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.  
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) 
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.  
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. 
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. 
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. 
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. 
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. 
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
