Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all non-competition venues. - Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing and signage operations and reporting updates into the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. - Providing strategic input into the non-competition venue dressing planning process and offering expertise when required. - Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. - Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimised at all stages of the project. - Liaising with non-competition owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. - Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. - Attending department-specific and organisation site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. - Inputting into the site-specific dressing and wayfinding signage strategies utilising expertise from previous events and directives from management. - Acting as the non-competition venues point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project. - Participating in the creative design process for the non-competition venues. - Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. - Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against. - Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. - Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.
- Strong experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. - A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) - Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. - Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. - Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. - Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. - Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. - The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. - The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. - Right to work in Brazil. - Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Assist with the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Support the coordination of workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work with the Workforce Management team to help align workforce plans with operational requirements
• Provide administrative support in maintaining workforce categories and entitlements data
• Maintain and regularly update the centralised headcount tracker, ensuring accuracy of data
• Support change management activities by tracking updates and communicating changes to relevant stakeholders
• Assist in collecting and preparing inputs for workforce budgets, timelines, and planning activities

Workforce Operations & Management
• Support the delivery of operational workforce plans during tournament time, including assisting with site operations
• Help gather and document requirements for workforce spaces, equipment, and operational needs on site
• Support the documentation and maintenance of workforce policies, procedures, and operational guidelines
• Assist in mapping and documenting workforce planning and operational processes
• Provide administrative and coordination support for workforce systems and tools
• Support the delivery of workforce training sessions, including preparation of materials and logistics
• Assist with scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including staff and volunteers
• Provide on-the-ground operational support to venue managers during event delivery
• Help communicate workforce processes and procedures to ensure consistency
• Track workforce service levels and support reporting on entitlements and delivery

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Liaise with cross-functional teams (e.g., Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to support workforce needs
• Maintain regular communication with functional areas to gather and update operational requirements
• Provide coordination support between workforce teams, HR, and other stakeholders

  • Work Experience
    • Ideally experience with exposure to workforce planning, operations, events, or a related field
    • Basic to intermediate understanding of workforce planning systems, tools, and processes
    • Experience supporting or assisting with operational teams, preferably in event or venue environments
    • General understanding of data and its use in workforce planning and decision-making
    • Ability to organise tasks, manage priorities, and work with guidance in a structured environment
    • Experience collaborating with team members and contributing to a positive team environment
    • Good communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to support problem-solving and coordination activities
    • Experience working in or interacting with multicultural and/or multinational environments is an advantage
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
    • Portuguese language skills (basic to advanced) are an advantage

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Ticketing Infrastructure Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
This role will be responsible for delivering all stadium and non-stadium ticketing facilities, including all related sub-infrastructure projects, serving millions of ticket holders.

The main responsibilities of the Ticketing Infrastructure Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ include:  

• Ensure the delivery of all stadium and non-stadium ticketing facilities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and other FIFA tournaments, in full compliance with established requirements.

• Coordinate with other departments to review and interpret facility designs and floor plans, as well as hardware and equipment scope, specifications, and requirements, to ensure accurate and timely implementation.

• Attend regular coordination meetings with the Ticketing Infrastructure team and other relevant departments.

• Establish and maintain up-to-date requirements documents, as well as policies and procedures for ticketing facilities, including physical infrastructure, overlay, FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment), signage, and IT equipment.

• Plan and oversee the delivery and installation of physical infrastructure, overlay, FF&E, signage, and IT equipment in ticketing facilities.

• Manage, plan, and oversee staff involved in supporting ticketing infrastructure delivery in the host cities.
Education

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education.

Experience

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience supporting infrastructure projects.
• Proven experience working in similar roles at international sporting events
• Experience in ticketing projects is an advantage
• Experience working in international and multicultural environments.

Skills & Competencies

• Proven knowledge of infrastructure projects (e.g., overseeing the installation of overlay, furniture, signage, equipment, etc.).
• Strong ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented, with focus on delivering high-quality projects.
• Excellent communication skills, both within and across multiple functional areas.


Certifications & Requirements

• Languages: Fluent in English and Portuguese.
• Technology: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), as well as planning software and online collaboration tools. Knowledge of Power BI will be considered a significant advantage.
• Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
• Right to work in Brazil.

job.title: Host City Volunteer Coordinator - 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
 
Support the delivery of the FIFA Volunteer Programme under the leadership ofthe Host City Volunteer Manager and the guidance of the FIFA27 Central Volunteer Management and FIFA Volunteer Management Zurich.

The role is supporting the coordination of volunteer recruitment, training, communications, and day-to-day operations within the assigned Host City.  This includes coordinating activities within the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting Stadium Volunteer Centre readiness and operations, assisting with volunteer recruitment and engagement initiatives, and helping ensure the consistent delivery of the Volunteer Programme in line with FIFA standards.

The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The following points will apply to all host cities and venues where the competition takes place. 
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
· Support the Host City Volunteer Manager in delivering the FIFA Volunteer Programme across the assigned Host City
· Support the administration and day-to-day use of the FIFA Volunteer Platform: selecting volunteers, role offers, shift management, change maanagement, communication and any other related queries
· Support the recruitment process (through application screening) and ensuring that successful candidates are appropriately matched to roles which best suit their skills and experience (assignment).
· Participate in site visits, as necessary to inspect and validate potential pre-tournament and tournament-time required spaces
· Coordinating the delivery of the Volunteer Training Programme (general and role/venue-specific training) and support Functional Areas (FAs) with Role-Specific Training plan.
· Deliver Trainings for engagement volunteers 
· Ensuring volunteers have a good experience and are deployed depending on the daily activities taking place.
· Coordinating the set-up, daily operations and readiness of the stadium volunteer centre and providing inspiration, support, and motivation to the volunteers, as well as leading the reward and recognition programme and the engagement programme during tournament time.
· Communicate with applicants and volunteers via FIFA Communications tools 
· Leading the volunteers’ day-to-day activities and supporting them while on shift.
· Supporting the HC Volunteer Manager in coordination with FAs at the venue for shift planning, change management process and volunteer deployment.
· Monitoring volunteer attendance and escalating if any issue arises.
· Undertaking the day-to-day management of volunteers to ensure the well-being of volunteers on-site.
· Ensuring that shifts are fully covered, and FAs daily requirements are fulfilled.
· Collaborate closely with the Central volunteer management team and relevant on-site Functional Area (FA) teams, to ensure the timely delivery of engagement items and gifts. 
· Coordinate the execution of engagement initiatives and gift distribution, ensuring accurate inventory control, asset tracking, and efficient management of all items and equipment.
· Support with the planning and delivery of Volunteer Thank-You event
· Contribute to the development of volunteer communications, operational guidelines, and information materials across all phases of the volunteer journey.
· Provide support to applicants and volunteers through ServiceNow, responding to enquiries promptly and escalating complex issues where required
· Depending on your assign city: support the planning and delivery of FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ events, including the Final Draw, Team Workshop, Play-Off Tournament, Volunteer Thank-You events, and other official tournament activities, as required.


  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese (local language), basic level of English is an added advantage
  • Education:  Undergraduate Degree in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience of working for events, and strong understanding of volunteer management 
  • Desirable experience in delivering volunteer programmes supporting the volunteer journey, including fit for purpose attraction, promotion, recruitment, training, engagement, and tournament operations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Knowledge of volunteer or workforce system an advantage
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, as well as with local networks within the Host City, especially among the football community.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and remain solution oriented.
  • Strong public speaking and presentation skills
  • Experience in delivering workshops, volunteer briefings or training sessions
  • Enthusiasm, and the ability to inspire and motivate volunteers from diverse backgrounds
  • Ability to facilitate workshops, information sessions, and volunteer briefings
  • Knowledge of the local landscape, community networks, and key stakeholders within the respective Host City is an advantage.

job.title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership 
  • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.
Team Leadership
  • Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
  • Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness.
  • Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback.
  • Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.
Major Ceremonies Oversight
  • Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.
Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management
  • Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony.
  • Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way.
  • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines.
  • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements.
  • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.
Planning Scheduling & Documentation
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.
Supplier & Budget Management
  • Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. 
  • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. 
  • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. 
  • Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. 
  • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. 
  • Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. 
Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison
  • Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE.
  • Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
  • Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.
Venue Readiness & Execution
  • Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns.
  • Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases.
Other Duties
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery.
  • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration.
Education:
  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.
Experience
  •  Experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.
Skills & Competencies
  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment
  • CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus
  • The right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
job.plain_text_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.
Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.
Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Ceremonies Project Leadership
- Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. - Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. - Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. - Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. - Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. - Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. - Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. - Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. - Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. - Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.
Team Leadership
- Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. - Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. - Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. - Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. - Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. - Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.
Major Ceremonies Oversight
- Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament - Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.
Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management
- Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. - Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. - Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. - Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. - Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. - Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.
Planning Scheduling & Documentation
- Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. - Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. - Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. - Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. - Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. - Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. - Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. - Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. - Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. - Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. - Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.
Supplier & Budget Management
- Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. - Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. - Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. - Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. - Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. - Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers.
Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison
- Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. - Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. - Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. - Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.
Venue Readiness & Execution
- Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. - Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. - Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. - Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. - Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. - Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases.
Other Duties
- Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery. - Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings. - Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration.
Education:
- Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.
Experience
- Experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. - Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. - Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. - Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. - Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. - Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.
Skills & Competencies
- ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. - ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. - FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. - COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. - ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. - PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. - CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. - INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment - CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. - PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.
Certifications & Requirements
- Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. - Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. - Experience of Monday.com an advantage. - Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus - The right to work in Brazil. - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Fleet and Bus Service Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Fleet and Bus Service Manager will oversee the efficient and effective operation Tournament fleet and for any ancillary event. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of bus services and operations, working close to the other Transport workstreams, providing a reliable, on-time and outstanding service for the established FIFA Client Groups, such as PMAs, Referees, Media and Broadcast, FIFA Workforce and Arrivals and Departures. The Fleet and Bus Services and Operations Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing bus performance, developing, and ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements, Policies and Procedures, Operational Plan and Reports. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA27 departments for all bus and minibuses related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event.
  • Act as the primary operational interface between FIFA Transport and the event bus and minibus suppliers, ensuring full alignment on vehicle specifications, delivery timelines, KPIs, and operational needs.
  • Coordinate the reception, inspection, and acceptance of vehicles (e.g. buses), ensuring all units meet quality and operational readiness criteria before deployment. Manage the return, decommissioning, and handback process of fleet and buses post-tournament.
  • Act as the primary operational interface with cars, buses and minibuses and drivers’ suppliers ensuring service has been delivered as per contract. Monitor Fleet services performance against agreed KPIs, escalating issues and implementing corrective actions when service levels are not met.
  • Manage all ancillary contracts, if any, and operational processes related to the bus and minibus services, including vehicle washing and cleaning, refueling services, toll management, and the handling of traffic fines.
  • Develop the fleet and bus services Operational plan and well as the Depot Concept of Operations (including the design) and ensure its implementation across all Host Cities. Coordinate with all Host Cities depot locations, space, utilities, and facility requirements to confirm requirements are fully met.
  • Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all vehicle Operations.
  • Act as the central coordinator for the development of service-related Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines.
  • Manages day-to-day operations pre and during event and subordinate staff including supervisors, coordinators, dispatchers, depot planners, administrative assistants and drivers.
  • Setup of the bus timetables and any required information into Tournament Management System (TMM). Daily management and updates.
  • Ensure all FIFA and Supplier staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of FIFA-required modules (e.g TMM, fleet management system), operational workshops and briefings, safety guidelines, and role-specific instructions. The manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities.
  • It’s also responsible, in coordination with the bus and minibus service providers, for developing and delivering the full training program for all drivers and fleet operational team, including designing training content, defining formats (classroom, online, practical sessions), and establishing clear timelines and schedules. This includes planning how and when training will be delivered across all Host Cities, determining training duration and required number of days, organizing group sessions to cover the entire driver workforce, and ensuring consistent standards and materials. 
  • During tournament ensure all job requests are correctly entered, validated, and assigned with the appropriate vehicle and driver. Oversee dispatching procedures, monitor vehicles while in operation, and ensure real-time coordination with Host Cities for seamless service delivery. Particular attention should be given to PMA services, ensuring precise planning, communication, and execution in alignment with other Host City transport teams.
  • Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other event areas (Security, FIFA Travel, Guest Operations, Media, Broadcast, TSV, etc.) to ensure coherent and efficient engagement with fleet service matters.
Qualifications:
Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/ Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.

Experience:
  • Strong transport and fleet or bus services experience in international major events in at least two (2) world-class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. 
  • Strong management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project.
  • Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships.
Skills:
  • Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data validation, pivot tables, advanced formulas, and large database management. 
  • Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships.
  • Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes and activities.
  • Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests.
  • Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation.  
  • Proven project management skills within a complex project.
  • Strong analytical and organisation skills.
  • Proven solution orientated decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure to immoveable deadlines.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Guest Relations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Guest Relations Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of Guest Relations activities for VVIP/VIP and other FIFA guest groups at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

The role focuses on guest account management (including invitation, registration, and communication), as well as the coordination of end-to-end guest journeys and liaison with key stakeholders.

Under the guidance of the FIFA Guest Relations Lead, the role ensures the implementation of the Guest Relations strategy, maintaining high service standards, efficient processes, and seamless communication across all guest touchpoints.

The Guest Relations Manager acts as a key point of reference for guest management operations and supports the training and coordination of service providers and workforce in the respective areas.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and coordinate Guest Relations activities across all guest groups, ensuring alignment with service levels and event objectives.
  • Define and manage VVIP/VIP account management processes, including invitation, registration, communication, and quota management.
  • Liaise with stakeholders on guest invitation concepts, guest lists, and quota definitions, including coordination with offices and embassies of international and local authorities.
  • Map and oversee end-to-end guest journeys, ensuring high service standards across all touchpoints and efficient resolution of guest issues.
  • Oversee guest requests and bookings (e.g. program attendance, ticketing, travel, accommodation, transport), including structured change management processes.
  • Oversee ticketing-related guest processes and ensure consistency and efficiency in guest request handling.
  • Define and implement guest communication and liaison strategies, ensuring streamlined communication flows across all channels.
  • Collaborate with FIFA Zurich and relevant departments to ensure an integrated Guest Relations approach and consistent service delivery.
  • Establish and maintain clear communication lines with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop policies, guidelines, and protocol requirements for VVIP/VIP guests and other dignitaries.
  • Coordinate the management of guest-related IT systems and applications in alignment with FIFA Guest Relations.
  • Manage resources and support workforce planning for Guest Relations activities.
  • Ensure project delivery within defined timelines, milestones, and quality standards, including reporting and issue resolution.
  • Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for service providers, workforce, and volunteers.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Communications & Marketing, International Relations, Business Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Specialization in protocol, event management, or international relations is an advantage.
Experience:
  • Extensive experience in guest relations and guest management, including exposure to protocol environments and structured guest handling processes.
  • Experience in planning, coordinating, and delivering guest services in a professional or event-based environment.
  • On-site event experience in guest relations, protocol, or VVIP/VIP service delivery.
  • Experience in managing guest accounts, invitations, registrations, and communication processes is an advantage.
  • Experience in coordinating with high-level stakeholders (e.g. government representatives, embassies, international organizations) is an asset.
  • Ideally experience within a sport/event organisation or large-scale international project, preferably in a world-class event environment.
Skills & Competencies:
  • Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • High level of diplomacy and ability to handle sensitive VVIP/VIP interactions.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Proven problem-solving skills and ability to operate in dynamic environments.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to deliver under pressure.
  • Solid understanding of guest management processes and operational coordination.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); experience with planning tools is an asset.
Certifications & Requirements:
  • Project Management certification (e.g. PMI) or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Relevant certifications in hospitality, event management, or protocol are a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Academy Driver (Part-Time)
job.plain_text_description:
The Academy Driver is responsible for providing a safe, reliable and professional driving service across. the Academy. Reporting to the Head of Academy Operations, the role includes, management of part-time drivers (exclusively Academy), and to work alongside the Club Driver & Fleet Compliance Manager ensuring all vehicles are maintained and presented to a professional standard. The Academy Driver delivers a consistent, reliable service to ensure safe transport of Academy players, staff and guests.
This will be a part-time (20-hour) role, with hours split across a 7-day week.
Responsibilities
- Provide transport for identified registered players to and from our Motspur Park training site. - Provide transport for trialist players to and from airports, train stations, accommodation, and club activities. - Support the player induction process when identifying players in need of transport support. - Act as a guide for visits to Motspur Park and Craven Cottage. - Assist the club on 1st team match days for corporate driving requirement. - Support the Academy across key events and wider activities. - Promote the work of Fulham Academy amongst the London football community. - Always represent Fulham Football Club to a high standard in line with club values.
Requirements
- Hold a full clean driving licence - Interact with others in a positive manner - Strong understanding of the local area - Positive ability to work within a diverse organisation - Self-starter who takes pride in the delivery of a professional service - Bi-Lingual (Desired) - D1 driving licence (Desired)

job.title: Academy Kit Assistant
job.html_description:
The Academy Kit Assistant supports the smooth day-to-day running of the Academy by preparing, maintaining, and distributing training and match kit for players and staff. 

This role is 20hrs per week.

Responsibilities

Essential and Desirable
  • Organised and reliable.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Positive team player with a flexible approach to working evenings and weekends.
  • Full Driving License
  • Able to work in a fast-paced football environment while maintaining high professional standards.

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:  
 
  • Prepare and distribute training and match kit.
  • Ensure all kit and equipment is clean, organised, and ready for use.
  • Assist with stock control, kit issuing, and inventory management.
  • Support academy training sessions, fixtures, and tournaments as required.
  • Maintain high standards within the kit room and storage areas.
  • Work closely with academy staff to meet operational needs.
job.plain_text_description:
The Academy Kit Assistant supports the smooth day-to-day running of the Academy by preparing, maintaining, and distributing training and match kit for players and staff.
This role is 20hrs per week.
Responsibilities
Essential and Desirable
- Organised and reliable. - Strong attention to detail. - Positive team player with a flexible approach to working evenings and weekends. - Full Driving License - Able to work in a fast-paced football environment while maintaining high professional standards.
Requirements
The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
- Prepare and distribute training and match kit. - Ensure all kit and equipment is clean, organised, and ready for use. - Assist with stock control, kit issuing, and inventory management. - Support academy training sessions, fixtures, and tournaments as required. - Maintain high standards within the kit room and storage areas. - Work closely with academy staff to meet operational needs.

job.title: u21 Head Coach
job.html_description:
The U21 Head Coach plays a pivotal role in delivering the Academy's player development strategy, creating a high performance environment that prepares young players for the demands of professional football. Responsible for leading the U21 programme, the role focuses on maximising the development and progression of players, supporting their transition into the senior game, and ensuring alignment between the Academy and First Team. Working collaboratively across departments, the postholder will contribute to the continuous evolution of the Academy's technical and performance programmes, helping to create a seamless pathway for emerging talent.

Responsibilities

The u21 Head Coach must: 

Experience
•  Experience working with Professional Development Phase (u18-u21) aged players. 
•  Experience of successfully holding a leadership role or position within a Club or organisation. 
•  Experience of successfully supporting the development of people

Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications
•  To hold appropriate and up to date qualifications to conform to PL Academy Licence requirements. 
•  UEFA A License (FA Level 4 qualification). 
•  FA Advanced Youth Award (FA Level 4 qualification). 
•  Broad awareness of the football industry and governing policies. 
•  An understanding of player development principles or applied knowledge from across other sports, countries and/or clubs

Personal Qualities
•  To ensure the highest levels of professionalism in organisation, delivery and conduct. 
•  To demonstrate an engaging personality that naturally supports the learning and education of players and staff. 
•  To demonstrate growth mindset. 
•  To be Player or Person-Centred in the approach to development. 
•  To show diligence towards all aspects of the role. 
•  To have an outstanding work ethic. 
•  To actively demonstrate humility and vulnerability within the working environment.

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role: 
 
Coaching
  • Establish and continually refine the Season Plan for the u21 age group, shaping the player development programme in line with individual player and group needs. 
  • Lead coaching sessions across the u21 age group which align and integrate Season Plan commitments & players Individual Learning Plans (ILPs) to wider Academy and Club approaches and Values.
  • Create and sustain an elite learning environment that appropriately balances challenge and support, empowering players to take ownership of their development and become independent decision-makers.
  • Manage the u21 Games Programme in line with the Season Plan to ensure teams and players compete and develop appropriately through these experiences. 
  • Ensure all training and match experiences are purposefully designed to accelerate individual player development whilst maintaining alignment with the Academy Performance Plan and Club playing philosophy.
  • Lead weekly u21 Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT) meetings to shape and guide player development while ensuring the highest quality operations and organisation of resource. 
  • Integrate and connect the u21 group to both the u18 and First Team programmes. 
  • Maintain close alignment with First Team staff to ensure shared coaching language, tactical principles, behavioural expectations and physical demands that facilitate seamless player transition.
  • Support the u21 MDT (including u21 Assistant Coach) to integrate player development across disciplines. 
  • Plan, upload/record and reflect systematically on all coaching activity within the u21 age group. 
  • Support the delivery of u16 & u18 training and games programme to share ideas and approaches across the department, contribute to effective succession planning, and cover coaching colleagues as required.
  • Continually evaluate and innovate coaching practice by integrating current research, emerging methodologies and reflective practice to enhance player and programme development.
 
Player & Programme Management 
  • Develop and sustain frequent, consistent and supportive communication with all players, and where appropriate their families and other stakeholders, to support transitions into Professional Football. 
  • Oversee the implementation of the Academy Code of Expectations for all u21s players and staff.
  • Oversee the implementation of all Club policies that relate to the U21s programme. 
  • Lead all u21 player reviews, iteratively contributing to an on-going, continuous process of support for the u21 age group. 
  • Drive individual player acceleration through bespoke development planning, ensuring each player is appropriately challenged and supported in pursuit of First Team and professional football opportunities.
  • Manage the completion of ILPs for all u21 players in collaboration with other disciplines and stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary contributions to ensure each player's development programme is integrated, evidence-informed and aligned to individual needs.
  • Manage on-going reflection processes (of players and staff) in a way that contributes to on-going learning and development. 
  • Work with the Talent Identification and Recruitment team to provide suitable feedback to any players that trial with the u21s. 
  • Be an available point of contact for First Team colleagues, ensuring there is appropriate and regular connections on u21 players and the u21 programme. 
  • Provide informed recommendations regarding player progression, First Team integration, external loan opportunities and succession planning through regular collaboration with Academy and First Team staff.
  • Player a key role in the Succession Planning processes within the Academy to support the Club to retain individuals who have First Team potential.
  • Foster an elite performance culture that promotes accountability, professionalism, resilience and behaviours consistent with the Club's Values and Code of Expectations.
  • Attendance at First Team games as required.
 
Insights (in collaboration with the Insights department)
  • Align video to team and individual commitments, supporting team and individual player development over time. 
  • Manage all reporting systems to ensure accurate information is captured in relation to player performance. 
  • Ensure all players are provided with regular access to their personal performance data highlighting key metrics in line with the Academy Technical Plan. 
  • Utilise objective performance data, video analysis and observational insights to evaluate programme effectiveness, inform coaching interventions and support evidence-based decision making.
  • Support the development and integration of Insights staff within the u21 MDT. 
 
Leadership & Collaboration
  • Lead, support and positively influence the wider Academy coaching team through collaboration, mentoring and the sharing of best practice across the Professional Development Phase.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with all Academy departments to ensure a connected, player-centred and high-performing multidisciplinary environment.
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Academy Technical Plan by identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation across the programme.
  • Act as an ambassador for Fulham Football Club, consistently demonstrating the Club's Values of being Pioneers, Confident Custodians, Action Orientated, Open & Inclusive and committed to Service Excellence.

Benefits

The closing date for applications is Friday 14th August.

job.title: Pre-Academy & Development Centre Head Coach (Slough)
job.html_description:
1. To lead on the development of all talent and support Recruitment Managers by providing insight on player progress
  2. To lead on the organisation, management and setup of practices at your relevant centre 

Responsibilities

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
  • To ensure the high quality co-ordination and smooth operational running of the session you lead at your respective Pre-Academy or development centre session.
 
  • To ensure the deployment of appropriate football & sports coaches onto sessions. 
 
  • To collaborate effectively with the relevant Recruitment Manager manager to ensure a safe and fun programme for our young players. 
 
  • When required, to effectively support the running and development of the clubs Pre Academy at Motspur Park. 
 
  • To collaborate effectively with the wider academy team, driving high standards, sharing best practice and establishing strong opportunities for participant transitions between programmes. 
 
  • To identify talent and organise coach delivery at your centre or session, whilst attending any mandatory meetings. 
 
  • To manage registers, databases and spectators at the venue and provide feedback to parents when appropriate. 
 
  • To safeguard all personnel when the centre is running and correctly dismiss and welcome children upon arrival.

Requirements

The Pre-Academy & Development Centre Head Coach must have: 
  • Experience working in a sports participation-based environment 
  • Experience of managing projects coaching football to young people, specifically primary school aged children.
  • Experience working as an individual as well as part of a team. 
  • Experience working with Microsoft Office
  • Hold a UEFA C License/FA Level 2 Coaching in Football
  • FA First Aid Qualification
  • FA Safeguarding Children in Football Qualification
 
Ideally, the Pre-Academy & Development Centre Head will: 
  • Have worked in a Pre-Academy or Academy Development Centre
  • Have worked in an Academy setting
  • Have completed FA Talent ID Level 1 in Introduction to Scouting 
  • Have experience working in Scouting & Talent Identification

job.title: Matchday Groundsperson Casual
job.html_description:
The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:

• Repair works to the pitch in the form of divoting after warm up’s, half time and post-match use.
• Post-match pedestrian mowing using rotary and cylinder mowers.
• Setting up grow lights and moving them from storage compound into stadium post-game when required.
• Washing and cleaning of machinery after usage.
• Comply with all Health and Safety regulations and requirements within the Company and your role.
• Drive vehicles and handle equipment as required for grounds maintenance operations.
• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with managers, colleagues and end users, ensure grounds management are kept informed of any issues that may be identified.
• Undertaking general maintenance operations associated with pitch.
• Work within a stadium team to ensure the upkeep of the stadium pitch.
• This job description does not contain all the duties and responsibilities that may arise in this role, you will need to undertake other duties as instructed and use initiative to ensure the safe operational functioning of the stadium.
• Expectation is to work at least 75% of home fixtures.

job.title: Female Football Coach (Casual)
job.plain_text_description:
Fulham FC Foundation are currently seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and committed person to take up the casual position of a Female Football Coach.
Reporting directly to our Operations Officers the Female Football Coach will be responsible for managing a number of female teams at one of the foundations partner schools. This role would involve both the management of these teams, as well as providing high-quality, team-based training sessions throughout the week. You will also be responsible for overseeing any fixtures these team have across the season. This is a casual role where flexibility is essential, as the delivery of training sessions and fixtures changes across the school term.
The successful candidate will be somebody who has prior experience managing a female team, and holds at least a UEFA C License qualification. Due to the requirements stipulated by the school, the successful candidate will be a female coach with relatable experience to their players allowing them to be a positive role model to them.
Although this role is casual, with the hours varying across the season, meaning that there is no set timetable. There are some key times when training sessions and fixtures are likely to happen. Therefore, the ideal candidate will have good availability during the afternoons of the working week. The ideal availability will be:
Monday – Friday from 2pm to 6pm
There will also be opportunity to work across other foundation programmes such as our ‘Player Development Centres’ and ‘Girls Development Centres’ should the successful candidate want to.
Whilst there is no obligation for Fulham FC Foundation to provide, or for the Female Football Coaches to accept, work. Female Football Coaches who do not work for an extended period of time (3 months), may no longer be offered work.
Salary: £16.50 p/h
Next steps:
The closing date for this role is the 30th of June, however applications will be reviewed consistently so any appropriate candidate may be interviewed before this date.
If successful, you will join a vibrant team who are passionate about achieving the organisation's vision of “an active healthy, inclusive and thriving community”, and you’ll have the opportunity to build on your existing skills through a variety of training and development opportunities and experiences. This role will also play a role in supporting the Foundation’s Women’s and Girls Strategy to develop and support opportunities for underrepresented groups.
*This job description should not be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive. It is intended as an outline indication of areas of activity and responsibility and will be amended in the light of the changing needs of the organisation.
Responsibilities
- To act as an Ambassador for Fulham FC Foundation (FFCF), representing the organisation professionally in line with its values.
- To design and deliver high quality, team training sessions to the teams you’ll be working with.
- To manage the teams during both home and away fixtures, including all the team admin that does along with managing the team.
- To provide high-quality, individualised feedback to each of the players in your teams to support their footballing development.
- To be a positive role model to the student athletes, helping both motivate and support them with their football, and education.
- To identify and support progression pathways for talented young people.
- To provide a safe, positive and inclusive learning environment at all times,
- To adhere to FFCF’s safeguarding policies and procedures, ensuring the timely reporting of any safeguarding concerns or incidents within sessions.
Requirements
Essential:
Experience:
- Experience of delivering high quality training sessions to female footballers. - Experience of running a 9 or 11 aside female football team. - Experience of working with others as part of a coaching team. - Has a driving license and/or is willing to travel independently.
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
- Excellent verbal communication skills. - Excellent knowledge of Women’s Football. - Excellent knowledge of the pathway opportunities for female players. - First Aid, Safeguarding and DBS qualification. - A UEFA C Coaching Qualification, or currently undertaking and due to complete this year. - Base knowledge of and willingness to learn & contribute towards FFCF strategic aims.
Personal Qualities:
- A positive role-model for children & young people. - Ability to travel independently across Surrey and South-West London, including transport of equipment. - Well presented, with a professional manner. - Positive, energetic persona. Able to build rapport with participants. - Excellent time-keeping & punctuality. - Willingness to learn & develop personally & professionally.
Preferred:
Experience:
- Experience of delivering football sessions in a secondary school - Experience of working with high performing footballers. - Experience of leading a local female grassroots team
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
- Additional football qualifications such as Goalkeeping, S&C, or Fitness. - Knowledge and links to local grassroots football teams. - UEFA B License (or willing to work towards)

job.title: Academy Lead Analyst
job.html_description:
Support the implementation of the Academy Vision, Mission and Objectives through the delivery of analysis work with the Professional Development Phase. This role will provide analysis leadership within the Insights department as well as lead the analysis provision for the U18 age group. This role will support the overarching age group objectives and commitments to player development in collaboration with the wider multi-disciplinary team. Furthermore, the role will lead the creation of bespoke, streamlined data systems and effective workflows to ensure the delivery of the Insights department strategic objectives.

Responsibilities

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
• Lead the creation and dissemination of analysis workflows throughout the Insights department ensuring these are appropriately aligned and scaffolded across phases and age groups.
• Manage analysis students through effective and robust recruitment, induction and appraisal processes.
• Manage hardware and software equipment to ensure the Insights staff effectively function and deliver on department objectives.
• Support the tracking of key results to ensure Insights strategic objectives are met.
• Lead weekly department meetings and contribute to monthly knowledge share events.
• Be an active member of the U18s multi-disciplinary team developing, monitoring, and reviewing both team and individual KPI's across the season.
• Support the broad player development processes with the U18 MDT to ensure a tailored individual approach.
• Ensure 'best practice' is used throughout the Academy with specific regards to the capturing, coding, and visualisation of video and data.
• Support the U18 MDT with timely and appropriate presentations / reports to support ongoing and iterative reflections of player performance.
• Contribute to our student learning programme by providing support to staff around coding and presenting of video content.
• Undertake continued professional development and be able to present learnings back to the Insights teams and/or U18 MDT.
• Support the highest levels of safeguarding.

Requirements

The Lead Analyst must:
• Have 2+ years’ experience working as an analyst (or similar title) in elite sport.
• Have experience in the effective management and use of data to measure player development.
• Understand the demands and processes within an elite football environment.
• Be competent in using Apple Mac Products and Microsoft Office.
• Have experience in designing analytical workflows to support pre-match, live and post-match analysis in elite sport.
• Be highly skilled in the use of SportsCode, Hudl Insight, and Power Bi.
• Be highly skilled at communicating and presenting to coaches and players using a combination of video and data.
• Have high levels of empathy and care for young people and their development.
• Be diligent with and excellent eye for detail.
• Possess good emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.
• Hold a UEFA C Coaching Qualification.

Ideally, Lead Analyst will: 
• Have experience in conducting case study research to support individual development plans. 
• Have experience of managing iterative processes within a multi-disciplinary team. 
• Hold a UEFA B Coaching Qualification. 
• Hold an operator ID with the Drone and Model Aircraft Registration Team, CAA. 
• Be creative when implementing strategies for process improvement. 
• Have a curious nature when it comes to the evolution of football insights, 
• Hold a FA Safeguarding qualification. 
• Be FA First Aid Qualified.

Benefits

Applications close 18th August

job.title: Host Family
job.html_description:
Are you passionate about football and looking for a unique opportunity to make a difference in the lives of young athletes, aged 15-21?


Fulham FC is seeking warm and welcoming host families to provide a safe and supportive home environment to support our Academy players who will be required to live away from home to fulfil their education and football training at our club.


As a host parent, you will play an essential role in helping our players thrive both on and off the pitch. You'll provide a comfortable living space, home-cooked meals, emotional support and help them to adjust to life away from home as they focus on their training and academic pursuits.


What we are looking for:
  • A friendly, caring family or individual with a spare room
  • A willingness to provide support, guidance, and encouragement to our young players
  • A safe and welcoming home environment
  • Support our young people by teaching them basic independent living and self-care skills such as washing, cooking and cleaning up after themselves.
  • Providing meals in line with nutritional guidance from the Academy.
  • Accommodation has access to public and local amenities with good transport links to the Academy training ground.
  • Report any welfare concerns to the Academy Safeguarding and Player Care team should they occur.
  • Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with.
  • The club will regularly inspect and visit the placement during the season.
  • The club will provide further guidance to host families, young people and their parents explaining what would be expected of them.

In order to be considered for this position you must live within 30 minutes travel for the player from the training ground.

Fulham Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and young people and expects host families to share this commitment. As such, the host family provider will be subject to an Enhanced Disclosure & Barring Service (DBS) check and risk assessments prior to a placement commencing.


Any other person over the age of 18, who resides in the household or has regular contact with the player will be required to complete an enhanced DBS. Host Families will be required to attend safeguarding training and workshops arranged by the Academy.


We are committed to supporting an environment where all staff have a personal responsibility to uphold the Club’s Equal Opportunities Policy by treating fellow employees, prospective employees, casual workers, prospective casual workers, players, prospective players and customers fairly and impartially.
