job.plain_text_description:
Description
About the Company:Inter Miami CF (IMCF or the Club) is a Major League Soccer club competing in the Eastern Conference, owned by Miami Beckham United and playing at its newly developed permanent stadium (Nu Stadium) at Miami Freedom Park, a 25,000-seat stadium within a 131-acre master-planned site featuring a 55-acre public park, structured parking, and over one million square feet of mixed-use retail, entertainment, commercial, and hospitality development. The Club operates a growing and complex business spanning professional sports, live events, stadium operations, retail, food and beverage, sponsorships, and media which is supported by a lean Finance and Accounting function responsible for accounting, financial planning and analysis, cash management, procurement, and investor relations across multiple legal entities.
Position Summary:
The Senior Manager, Procurement will be the Club's inaugural dedicated procurement leader, responsible for architecting, implementing, and enforcing the end-to-end source-to-pay (S2P) function across Miami Beckham United (MBU). This is a rare opportunity for a seasoned procurement professional to design a procurement operating model from the ground up in a high-growth, high-visibility organization entering its most consequential phase of commercial scale.
The Senior Manager, Procurement will be responsible for enabling cost containment, cost reduction, and cost control across all third-party spend at MBU. This role will design and enforce the Club's purchase order policy, approval authority matrices, vendor onboarding standards, payment governance, and compliance reporting. The Senior Manager, Procurement will operate as the enforcement arm of the Club's Cost Control Policy Framework, with explicit authority relating to non-compliant spend.
In addition to policy authorship and enforcement, this role will build the Club's vendor management infrastructure, including vendor master data integrity, competitive bidding programs (RFI/RFQ/RFP), recurring and periodic contract commercial reviews, insurance and tax compliance validation, and ongoing spend analytics for sustainable cost reduction. The Senior Manager, Procurement will drive the transition to an environment where essentially all spend flows through procedures where competitive sourcing, PO discipline, and vendor accountability are the operating standards.
The role initially covers all MBU operations, with scope expansion into Miami Freedom Park (MFP) contemplated as that business platform matures. The Senior Manager, Procurement will report directly to the MBU Chief Financial Officer, and unify source-to-pay execution under a single accountable owner and function.
The Senior Manager, Procurement will serve as a trusted operational partner across the organization, translating procurement discipline into measurable outcomes: quantified savings, improved control coverage, cleaner vendor data, and defensible spend governance visible to lenders, auditors, and ultimately the ownership group.
Key Responsibilities:
Procurement Policy and Enforcement
- Author, publish, and enforce the Club's Cost Control Policy Framework, including purchase order requirements, approval authority matrices, vendor onboarding standards, and payment governance. - Exercise stop-work and stop-payment authority for any commitment or invoice that does not comply with established procurement policy, escalating exceptions to the Chief Financial Officer on a documented basis. - Serve as the Club's primary internal enforcement authority for third-party spend discipline, including formal partnership with cost center leaders on remediation of policy exceptions. - Design and administer training programs and materials for department leaders, budget owners, and approvers on procurement policy, personal accountability standards, and system workflows. - Establish and maintain the exceptions process, including documentation, review cadence, escalation protocol, and highly visible compliance reporting.
Strategic Sourcing and Cost Reduction
- Design and lead all RFI, RFQ, and RFP activity for the Club, including scope definition, vendor identification, bid evaluation, and award recommendation for new and all existing vendor relationships - Build and execute a competitive re-bid program for legacy vendors who have never been formally sourced, prioritized by annual spend and strategic importance. - Develop category strategies for the Club's major spend categories, including retail merchandise (inventory), variable matchday operations (e.g., day of game / event), third-party outsourced professional services, marketing, and travel. - Identify, quantify, and deliver measurable cost savings through consolidation, competitive bidding, negotiated terms, business back, and category rationalization. - Oversee the Club’s corporate credit card, employee reimbursement, and capital expenditure policies and administration. - Partner with department leads (i.e., cost centers) and Legal on commercial term negotiation for material third-party contracts. - Design regular enterprise tests to ensure effective control environment around spend.
Vendor Management and Master Data
- Own the vendor master data file, including new vendor onboarding procedures, periodic re-validation, deactivation of dormant vendors, and duplicate vendor resolution. - Establish and enforce vendor onboarding standards including W-9 collection, banking verification, insurance and certificate of insurance validation, sanctions screening, and 1099 readiness. - Administer the Club's contract and renewal calendar, ensuring proactive engagement on renewals, expirations, and auto-renewal exposures. - Monitor vendor performance against contractual service levels and escalate non-performance to the appropriate business owner.
Purchase Order Governance
- Design and administer the Club's purchase order workflow utilizing existing platforms , including approval routing, expense category discipline, and system configuration. - Evaluate and determine if existing procurement-related technology stack sufficiently scales to the heighted business complexity and transaction volume of the organization. - Drive purchase order compliance from current baseline toward best-practice benchmarks (at or above 90% of spend under PO). - Enforce the "no PO, no pay" standard, including formal return-to-requester process for non-compliant invoices. - Monitor and report to the executive leadership team and ownership group on PO compliance by cost center, category, and dollar band.
Accounts Payable Operations
- Directly supervise the accounts payable function, providing day-to-day direction, quality review, and supervision. - Own AP operations end-to-end, including invoice intake, three-way match, payment run execution, and month-end AP close activities. - Administer the Club's rush payment policy, requiring documented business justification and Chief Financial Officer approval for any exception to standard payment timing. - Ensure integrity of the AP subledger and its reconciliation to the general ledger, in coordination with the Club’s accounting team.
Spend Analytics and Reporting
- Establish a recurring spend analytics capability, including monthly PO compliance reporting, quarterly spend-by-category analysis, and annual savings realization tracking. - Deliver executive-level reporting on procurement KPIs, vendor risk exposures, and cost containment outcomes. - Partner with Financial Planning and Analysis on the annual budget cycle to align procurement sourcing calendars with budget commitments. - Support internal and external inquiries (including audit engagements) as the primary point of contact for procurement, AP, and vendor master data inquiries.
Cross-Functional Partnership
- Serve as the primary Finance interface with department leads, Legal, and executive leadership on all third-party spend matters. - Partner with Legal on contract commercial review, MSA and SOW structuring, and any renewal negotiations. - Coordinate with the Senior Director, Controller and the Senior Director, Finance on treasury, budget, and reporting alignment. - Support the Chief Financial Officer on ad-hoc initiatives, including cross-entity procurement, MFP scope expansion, executive-level cost management reporting, and cost reduction strategies.
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field required. - 6+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience, including 2+ years leading procurement in a high-growth or transformation environment. - Demonstrated success authoring and enforcing procurement policy in an organization that previously lacked one. - Track record of delivering quantified cost savings through competitive sourcing, vendor consolidation, and category strategy. - Deep experience with source-to-pay technology platforms; direct experience with Tipalti and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is helpful but not required. - Working knowledge of accounts payable operations, three-way match, and vendor master data governance. - Experience managing direct reports, with a demonstrated ability to develop an AP function with procurement staff. - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold firm on policy in cross-functional and executive settings. - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume vendor and contract portfolio across multiple entities and stakeholders. - Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder sourcing initiatives from scoping through implementation and handoff. - Strong financial acumen with the ability to identify, quantify, and communicate savings, risk, and exposure to senior leadership. - Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority. - Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to define structure, process, and controls where none currently exist. - Bias towards initiative, is resourceful and solutions-oriented, and can break down complex problems into digestible, actionable components. - Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and procurement/project management tools. - High degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
Preferred Experience
- MBA or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification. - Prior experience building a procurement function from the ground up in a scaling organization. - Background in professional sports, live events, hospitality, stadium operations, or high-growth consumer brands. - Experience with real estate development, construction procurement, or capital project sourcing (relevant to future MFP scope expansion). - Familiarity with lender-facing environments where procurement discipline supports covenant compliance and audit readiness. - Experience with vendor risk programs, insurance and COI compliance, and 1099 administration. - Bilingual English / Spanish given vendor and community mix.

job.title: Coordinator, Shipping & Receiving
job.html_description:
Description

The Coordinator, Shipping and Receiving is responsible for managing and distributing mail within an organization. This role is essential for ensuring smooth communication and efficient mail handling within our organization.  


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Collect incoming mail from postal workers, sort it by departments, and distribute it accordingly.  
  • Maintain an organized and clean mail room. 
  • Prepare and dispatch outgoing mail, including weighing packages, affixing postage, and ensuring timely delivery. 
  • Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing mail, including dates and recipients. 
  • Manage the receipt and delivery of packages, including special deliveries like overnight shipments. 
  • Assist with customer inquiries regarding postal rates, delivery times, and other mail-related questions. 
  • Ensure the mailroom and the business office is stocked with postage stamps, envelopes, packing materials and essential office supplies.  
  • Assist the security team when needed at the security control room desk. 
  • All other duties as assigned. 

Requirements

  • High school degree or GED 
  • Accurate sorting and record-keeping is crucial 
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively 
  • Clear communication with colleagues and postal workers 
  • Ability to lift and move packages, sometimes up to 50lbs
  • Proficiency preferred with mail sorting software and tracking systems, CCTV camera system, 24/7 Incident Management System and Envoy (visitor check in and tracking system)
  • Must be able to work flexible hours including some weekends and/or holidays
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish is a plus 
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite
  • Forklift certification a plus


Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds. 
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions. 
  • Work in various positions, including but not limited to, stooping, standing, walking, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time. 

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Commercial Matchday Hosts
job.html_description:
Job Title: Commercial Matchday Hosts

Responsible to: Head of Commercial

Apply here: https://forms.office.com/e/12c4GXBGmg

About The Role:

As a host at Elland Road, you will be the first point of contact for many of our VIP hospitality guests. In this role you would be required to act as the face of the Club within your allocated hospitality lounge, creating a seamless link between our hospitality department, our catering department and our VIP matchday guests. This will ensure that our guests receive the highest possible standard of service and have an exceptional hospitality experience.

Allocation Main Responsibilities

  • Positions are offered for matchdays only, with a typical shift lasting approximately seven to eight hours.

  • Attending pre-match hospitality host / hostess briefing prior to each shift;

  • Familiarise yourself with your designated suite (which may change each shift), checking the suite and other guests facilities meet required standards and ensuring corporate lanyards and programmes are set out as per the guests chosen package;

  • Welcoming all guests into your suite, building relationships by using eye contact and escorting guests to their assigned dining area / table;

  • Build relationships with customers pre-match, at half time and full time.

  • Continuously managing the flow of guests in to the suite ensuring all

    guests catering needs are being met and all guests are happy;

  • Be particularly attentive to new guests to ensure they are comfortable in their surroundings whilst being observant towards and engaging with all guests at all times to ensure the highest levels of service throughout the day;

  • Resolving any issues as they arise to ensure the guests' matchday experience is not effected, raising to the next level and / or appropriate departments as required (usually Duty Manager in your allocated lounge)

  • Directing guests to the appropriate match seats;

  • Answering any questions hospitality guests may have about other events

    and fixtures;

  • Report any faults with facilities and any catering issues without delay;

  • Any other reasonable duties

Required Technical Skills

  • Previous experience as a host or hostess, or hospitality waiter or waitress in a hospitality environment, or front of house experience, is preferred.

Required Behavioural Attitudes

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Candidates must be well presented, mature, professional and have an outgoing personality

  • The ability to work efficiently in a high pressured and dynamic sporting environment

  • A good approach to teamwork and ability to manage a busy hospitality area

  • Ability to troubleshoot under pressure

  • Excellent customer service skills and spoken English required

  • Ability to use initiative and be creative

  • Strong customer service skills

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Ability to prioritise case load and manage time effectively

  • Confident and assertive

  • Ambition, passion and willingness to learn

job.title: Casual Match Day Line Chef
job.location: Anfield Stadium, Anfield Road Anfield Liverpool, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We are currently recruiting for experienced Line Chefs to support our casual catering team.

This is a fast-paced role, ideal for chefs who are confident working in high-volume environments and delivering consistent, quality food service.

What will you be doing?

  • Preparing and cooking core match day menu items (e.g. burgers, chicken wings and other grab and go favourites).
  • Supporting with preparation and delivery of any match day specials (varies per fixture).
  • Ensuring food is prepared, cooked and presented to company standards.
  • Maintaining high standards of food hygiene, safety and cleanliness at all times.
  • Working collaboratively with the wider kitchen and hospitality teams to ensure smooth service.

Who are we looking for?

  • Previous experience at prep chef level or similar.
  • Level 2 Food Hygiene Certificate (essential).
  • Confident cooking a consistent menu in a high-volume environment.
  • Strong team player with a positive, reliable attitude.

Why should you apply?

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment.

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

job.title: Football Development Casual Coach (LFC Foundation)
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our LFC Foundation as a Football Development Casual Coach. In this role you will support and develop all players within the group to attain the highest levels of performance in a safe, secure, and supportive environment and drive and nurture a positive culture within the training group. Be a coach who makes the Football Development Programme a place where players learn, have fun, and develop a love for the game

To be successful in this role you will have experience of working with young athletes, with a football environment. You will have an understanding of the modern young player in terms of their physical and psychological development, including an up to date understanding of Child Protection and Safeguarding procedures. You’ll have experience in roles, which have brought an understanding of how children learn and develop such as teaching.

You’ll be willing to commit to working evenings, weekends, and public holidays. You will demonstrate a willingness to flex and change with the demands of a situation. You’ll showcase an interest and genuine care about player needs. Providing players personalised support and communication. You are innovative and open minded; Unafraid to try new things in pursuit of developing and engaging players.

What you will be doing?

LFC Foundation 

  • Plan, prepare, deliver, and evaluate coaching sessions, following a training programme.
  • Provide input to the development and ongoing improvement / adaptation of the coaching curriculum.
  • Coach in a way that ensures players are encouraged to ask questions and seek feedback for improvement and clarity.
  • Ensure players are encouraged to have input to footballing decisions and their own learning process.
  • Ensure players are communicated the why’ as well as ‘what’ of decisions.
  • Ensure players know and understand the purpose and ‘why’ of training sessions.
  • Provide learning and development opportunities 
  • Input into selection decisions (e.g., attend trials and take part in selection decisions post-trial)
  • Work across age groups (coach is likely to hold responsibility for one age group and work with different groups from time to time)
  • Work with individual players set appropriated development targets with a plan to work towards
  • Provide feedback to players (using technology where appropriate)
  • Monitor and evaluate player development and provide feedback to players and parents/carers on a regular basis.
  • Liaise with and work closely with coaches, medics and performance staff regarding player development, and prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation of injuries.
  • Ensure all games and festivals are well managed with a development philosophy clear to players and parents/carers.
  • Be available to players to offer advice, guidance and support on football and personal matters.    E.g., ensure they are managed well through things like injury and other challenges that could affect their performance and wellbeing.
  • Ensure player behavior in the group reflects what is required.
  • Work with the Safeguarding Manager to ensure that the wellbeing and welfare of all players and staff is always an operational priority.

Other responsibilities 

  • Ensure all pathways and opportunities are inclusive and accessible to all  
  • Ensure effective collection of all monitoring and evaluation data
  • Record data on LFC Foundation databases. 
  • Provide timely reports and analysis of performance
  • Ensure the safeguarding of participants and staff is at the forefront of all decisions and Foundation safeguarding policy is adhered to at all times. 
  • Provide content for LFC Foundation social media
  • Support other Foundation programmes and activities as required

Who we are looking for?

job.title: Premier League Inspires Coordinator
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our LFC Foundation team as a Premier League Inspires Coordinator. 

This role will enhance the delivery of a world-class secondary school programme across the Liverpool City Region, empowering young people to realise their full potential. Working with those who are marginalised, vulnerable, or at risk of offending behaviour, the post holder will inspire positive change by developing the skills, knowledge, confidence, and mindset needed for success in education, employment, and life. Through meaningful engagement and targeted support, this role will help young people overcome barriers, build resilience, and create brighter futures.

What will you be doing?

  • Deliver a high-quality educational programme that develops young people's skills, raises aspirations, and enhances engagement in education and personal development. 
  • Contribute to the design and delivery of an innovative curriculum that aligns with the objectives of LFC foundation, partner schools, and the national curriculum.  
  • Work collaboratively with external partners to ensure curriculum content supports programme outcomes and achieves agreed key performance indicators (kpis). 
  • Support the development of curriculum pathways linked to recognised accredited qualifications, including programmes such as the king's trust and leadership skills foundation awards. 
  • Build, manage, and maintain strong relationships with school leaders and staff, working in partnership to identify and support young people who would benefit most from the programme.  
  • Deliver an engaging timetable of activities that motivates and supports young people to achieve recognised qualifications and positive educational outcomes.   
  • Provide targeted one-to-one mentoring and intervention support, signposting young people to additional services where appropriate to address individual needs and barriers. 
  • Liaise regularly with school staff to gain a thorough understanding of individual students, including behaviour, attendance, wellbeing, and support plans, ensuring interventions are tailored and effective. 
  • Share learning, best practice, and innovative approaches with both school colleagues and LFC foundation staff to continuously enhance programme delivery and impact. 
  • Promote the personal and social development of young people, with a focus on improving mental health and wellbeing, encouraging positive behaviours, increasing school attendance, and raising educational attainment.  
  • Ensure full compliance with the LFC foundation safeguarding policy and procedures, always maintaining the highest standards of safeguarding practice.  
  • Adhere to safeguarding policies and procedures within each partner school, ensuring a consistent and child-centred approach to safeguarding.  
  • Embed the LFC foundation theory of change and outcome framework throughout programme delivery, supporting robust monitoring, evaluation, and impact measurement. 
  • Accurately collect, record, and report programme data in line with LFC foundation monitoring, evaluation, and reporting requirements. 
  • Maintain quality assurance standards, ensuring all programme delivery is engaging, effective, and of the highest quality. 
  • Reflect on and evaluate individual sessions and practice, identifying strengths, learning opportunities, and areas for continual improvement. 
  • Conduct and manage risk assessments across multiple school settings, ensuring a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment for all participants and stakeholders 
  • Develop and strengthen partnerships across the Liverpool city region, including schools, Merseyside police, local authorities, and community organisations, to maximise opportunities and support for young people. 
  • Support wider LFC foundation programmes, projects, and events as required, contributing to the organisation's overall mission of creating positive and lasting change in the lives of young people. 

Who are we looking for?

  • Experience planning, delivering, and evaluating youth or education programmes.
  • Experience supporting vulnerable, disadvantaged, or at-risk young people.
  • Understanding of inclusive youth work practices.
  • Knowledge of the National Curriculum in secondary settings.
  • Understanding of youth mentoring approaches.
  • Experience building relationships with schools and external partners.
  • Ability to identify needs and signpost young people to support.
  • Commitment to Liverpool FC Foundation’s mission and values.
  • Commitment to supporting partner school priorities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to reflect and improve programme delivery.
  • Experience measuring impact and evaluating outcomes.
  • Highly organised with strong time management skills.
  • Level 3 qualification (or above) in Education or Youth Work.
  • Level 1 Safeguarding qualification, or willingness to obtain.
  • Confident using Microsoft Office.
  • Experience collecting and reporting programme data.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and support reporting.
  • Understanding of safeguarding, boundaries, and risk management.

Desirable:

  • Level 3 AET or equivalent teaching qualification.
  • Experience delivering accredited qualifications.
  • Experience in secondary school or community settings.
  • Mental health or trauma-informed practice training.
  • Experience working with statutory services or community partners.
  • Full UK driving licence and access to transport.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

job.title: Casual Concourse Food Service Assistants
job.location: Anfield Stadium, Anfield Road Anfield Liverpool, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
What will you be doing?

Working on our busy concourse kiosks, you’ll help serve over 45,000 fans on matchdays and events, providing fast, friendly service in a high-energy environment.

This role is perfect for individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced, hands-on service setting.

 In this role, you will:

  • Serve a range of food and drinks from concourse kiosks, including hot drinks, alcoholic beverages, pies, burgers, and snacks.
  • Work behind busy counters and bar-style service areas during peak periods.
  • Take orders quickly and accurately while delivering great customer service.
  • Maintain a fast, efficient service during high-volume matchday demand.
  • Keep your area clean, organised, and well-stocked throughout your shift.
  • Support your team to ensure smooth and coordinated service.

Average shift length: approximately 6 hours.

Please be aware that this role involves the handling and serving of alcoholic beverages, as well as various food products, including pork.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who are:

  • Friendly, approachable, and enjoy working with the public.
  • Confident in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Comfortable handling food and drinks, including alcohol service.
  • Reliable and able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Willing to learn and take on a variety of tasks.
  • Experience in hospitality, catering, or customer service is beneficial but not essential.

Please note: We may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

job.title: Casual Matchday Chefs £14-£17/hour + Holiday Pay
job.html_description:
Location: Anfield Stadium, Liverpool

Pay: £14–£17 per hour + holiday pay (paid weekly)

Start: From August 2026

We have opportunities across matchdays for all level of Chefs.

This is a casual position, offering variable hours for matchdays, on a flexible assignment basis - ideal for picking up extra shifts around other work or commitments.

What will you be doing?

  • Prepare and cook dishes in line with recipes and service standards.
  • Maintain consistency in quality, portions, and presentation.
  • Ensure full compliance with food safety, allergen, and hygiene standards.
  • Assist with stock control and minimise waste through rotation.
  • Support senior chefs with service planning and kitchen organisation.
  • Contribute to a professional, high-performing kitchen environment.

Who are we looking for?

  • Chef experience in a professional kitchen.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Food Hygiene Level 2.

What’s on offer?

  • £14–£17 per hour + holiday pay.
  • Weekly pay.
  • Home games only - no away travel required.
  • Casual position, offering variable hours on a flexible assignment basis.
  • Starts available from August.

job.title: Senior Licensing Manager
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC team as a Senior Licensing Manager.

You will play a pivotal role in growing one of the world's most iconic sports and entertainment brands. Leading new business acquisition across global licensing categories and markets, you will identify, negotiate and secure strategic licensing partnerships that expand the Club's international consumer products presence.

You will help shape licensing strategy, drive commercial growth, and deliver complex partnership deals that maximise the value of Liverpool FC's brand and intellectual property. Success in this role requires strong commercial acumen, outstanding relationship management skills, and the ability to operate effectively across diverse international markets.

This role offers the opportunity to work on a global stage, with regular travel to Liverpool and international travel required for licensee meetings, trade shows, and key business development activities.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead new business development efforts, securing high-value licensing partnerships across global categories and markets.
  • Build and manage a robust sales pipeline, delivering against revenue and commercial growth targets.
  • Develop compelling commercial proposals, category insights, and presentations to win new business.
  • Represent Liverpool FC at industry events and trade shows, identifying opportunities, building networks, and staying ahead of market trends.
  • Support the development and execution of the Club's global licensing strategy, identifying new categories, products, and regional growth opportunities.
  • Provide market intelligence and commercial insights to inform strategic decision-making and maximise brand growth.
  • Manage senior-level relationships with key licensees, driving account growth through renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and long-term planning.
  • Conduct regular business reviews, ensuring partners meet agreed commercial objectives, KPIs, and growth plans.
  • Collaborate with licensees to deliver innovative products and marketing initiatives that enhance the global fan experience.
  • Work closely with senior stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Product Development, Retail Marketing, and Merchandising to ensure successful deal execution and commercial alignment.
  • Present commercial opportunities and recommendations to senior leadership, influencing decision-making and protecting long-term revenue growth.
  • Proactively identify risks and opportunities within partner portfolios and implement strategies to optimise performance.

Who are we looking for?

  • Degree in Business, Marketing or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Significate, proven experience in licensing, commercial partnerships, or consumer products, with proven success closing high-value deals and managing strategic accounts.
  • Proven track record of negotiating and closing significant licensing agreements.
  • Experience managing strategic accounts in international licensing environments.
  • Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding sales targets and KPIs in a commercial, target-driven role.
  • Experience operating across global markets, adapting strategies to local consumer and retail dynamics.
  • Experience within international licensing, sports, entertainment, or consumer brands.
  • Understanding of global retail, category dynamics, and product development processes.

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Exceptional negotiation and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in revenue forecasting, sales pipeline management, and P&L awareness.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex deals simultaneously while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, comfortable navigating cross-functional environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Willingness to travel internationally and domestically to meet partners, attend events and close deals.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time permanent role working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our London Office. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. job.title: Manager, Ticketing, Access and Hospitality Systems
job.html_description:
We are looking for a Manager, Ticketing, Access & Hospitality Systems to join the team at Liverpool FC. 

We are looking for an experienced professional to oversee the setup, configuration, testing and day-to-day operation of the Club’s Ticketing, Hospitality and Access Control systems across all football and non-football events. The role will act as the business owner for these systems, ensuring they are maintained effectively to deliver a seamless supporter experience while meeting operational and stadium security requirements.

The successful candidate will lead the planning, testing and delivery of system-related initiatives, enhancements and event operations, developing test plans, task lists and operational procedures as needed. Working closely with internal teams including Product, Operations, Hospitality, Safety, IT and Supporter Services, as well as external suppliers, they will serve as the key stakeholder for ticketing, hospitality and access system matters, helping to deliver departmental and club-wide objectives.

What will you be doing?

  • Manage the delivery and operation of ticketing, hospitality and access control systems across men's, women's, academy and non-football events.
  • Oversee ticket sales, renewals, special events and third-party venue fixtures, ensuring accurate system setup and configuration.
  • Lead the administration and distribution of ticketing and access products, including hospitality, parking and NFC passes.
  • Coordinate ticketing and access control requirements for major events, concerts and external venues, ensuring systems are thoroughly tested and event-ready.
  • Develop and manage testing plans, operational procedures and validation processes to ensure successful event delivery and system performance.
  • Act as a business owner for key ticketing and access control platforms and suppliers, driving system enhancements and continuous improvement.
  • Produce and analyse operational reports relating to attendance, stadium access, ticket activations and supporter behaviour to support decision-making.
  • Monitor, investigate and resolve ticketing and access-related incidents, ensuring a high-quality supporter experience.
  • Lead event-day access support and collaborate with internal teams and suppliers to quickly resolve operational issues.
  • Manage user access governance, security controls and annual system rollover activities.
  • Deliver training and knowledge-sharing to promote best practice and effective system use across the organisation.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including Operations, Hospitality, Safety, Finance, Technology and Supporter Services to support business objectives and event delivery.
  • Contribute to strategic projects, supplier relationships and future technology developments relating to ticketing, access control and supporter experience.

Who are we looking for?

Essential Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • Proven experience working in a high-volume ticketing, access control, sports, entertainment or venue environment.
  • Strong understanding of ticketing operations, stadium access systems and supporter entry processes.
  • In-depth knowledge of the football, live events and venue operations industry.
  • Experience managing operational systems, process improvements and quality assurance activities.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and with external suppliers.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, particularly in fast-paced operational environments.
  • Experience developing testing plans, operational procedures and readiness reviews.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure and manage operational incidents effectively.

Technical Skills

  • Significant experience with access control platforms such as Fortress and ticketing systems such as SeatGeek or similar.
  • Experience managing digital ticketing products, NFC credentials and stadium access technologies.
  • Strong testing and quality assurance experience, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and operational readiness reviews.
  • Advanced reporting, data analysis and Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience working with large datasets, operational reporting tools and incident management processes.
  • Good understanding of stadium operations and event-day delivery.

Desirable

  • Experience managing supplier relationships and contract governance.
  • Experience leading system implementation, integration or transformation projects.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office in Liverpool.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

job.title: Senior Coordinator, Ticketing, Access and Hospitality Systems
job.html_description:
We are looking for a Senior Coordinator, Ticketing, Access & Hospitality Systems to join the team at Liverpool FC. 

You will support the delivery and operation of the Club's ticketing, hospitality and access control systems across football and non-football events. Responsible for system setup, testing and pre-event validation, ensuring a seamless supporter experience and successful event delivery. Working closely with internal teams and suppliers, the role also supports reporting, projects and the resolution of ticketing and access-related issues.

What will you be doing?

  • Support the operation and delivery of ticketing, hospitality and access control systems across football and non-football events.
  • Assist with event setup, ticket fulfilment, barcode management, testing and event-day readiness.
  • Perform pre-event validation checks to ensure ticketing and access systems are accurate and functioning correctly.
  • Monitor systems during events and help resolve supporter, ticketing and access-related issues.
  • Produce operational reports and analyse attendance, ticket activation and entry performance data.
  • Investigate supporter enquiries relating to ticketing, attendance and access records.
  • Maintain system user access, permissions and governance controls.
  • Support seasonal renewals, annual system rollovers and contingency testing activities.
  • Deliver training and guidance on ticketing and access control processes and best practices.
  • Work closely with internal teams and external suppliers to support event delivery, incident management and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the supporter experience.

Who are we looking for?

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Experience working in ticketing, access control, customer operations or event delivery environments.
  • Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure in fast-paced operational settings.
  • Collaborative approach with a strong focus on delivering an outstanding supporter experience.

Technical Skills

  • Experience using ticketing platforms such as SeatGeek and access control systems such as Fortress or similar.
  • Skilled in data validation, reconciliation, system testing and ticket fulfilment processes.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and data analysis skills, with experience producing operational reports and identifying trends.
  • Good understanding of ticketing operations, stadium access and event delivery processes.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting event-day operations.
  • Experience working with third-party venues and supplier-managed systems.
  • Basic project coordination experience.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office in Liverpool.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

job.title: Girls Academy U12 Strength and Conditioning Coach (LFC Foundation)
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
Join LFC Foundation and play a key role in developing the next generation of female footballers. As the Girls Academy U12 Strength & Conditioning Coach, you will create a safe, supportive, and enjoyable environment where players can develop physically, build confidence, and foster a lifelong love of the game. Working within the Academy programme, you'll deliver high-quality coaching, provide individualised support, and help cultivate a positive, player-centred culture.

We're looking for someone with experience supporting young athletes, ideally within a football environment, and a strong understanding of youth physical and psychological development. The successful candidate will be innovative, adaptable, player-focused, and committed to safeguarding best practices, with the flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required.

What you will be doing?

LFC Foundation 

  • Contribute to the LFCW Academy blueprint / curriculum ensuring there is S&C provision which complements the football programme.   
  • Deliver – or oversee the delivery of – the U12’s Girls Academy physical development programme, including:
  • Design and deliver individualised athletic development programmes as well as group training sessions
  • Provide injury rehabilitation training of players as directed by the physiotherapist/sports therapist, in preparation for return to training. 
  • Work with Physiotherapist/Sports Therapist to develop and support an activation / prehab programme
  • Manage facilities and equipment within the ETC so that it is well maintained and safe to use
  • Maintain a comprehensive database of work conducted with athletes and coaches.  Keep records which meet the standard required by The FA and the appropriate professional bodies
  • Communicate with parents in the event of S&C related queries, generally and specifically to their children. Educate parents with regard to their role in supporting physical development, injury prevention, injury care, recovery, diet and other factors relating to lifestyle away from the Academy.

 Other responsibilities 

  • Advise and direct other staff on the needs of players. 
  • Attend case management meetings and provide professional opinion
  • Educate coaches on the S&C provision and embedding physical outcomes within technical sessions
  • Work with the LFC Foundations Safeguarding Manager to ensure that the wellbeing and welfare of all players and staff is always an operational priority

Who we are looking for?

job.title: Casual Matchday Kitchen Assistants
job.location: Anfield Stadium, Anfield Road Anfield Liverpool, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
What will you be doing?

You’ll work in our state-of-the-art kitchens alongside a team of highly skilled and creative chefs, supporting the delivery of high-quality food across match days and events.

You will:

  • Assist with basic food preparation.
  • Unload and store deliveries safely and efficiently.
  • Maintain cleanliness by emptying bins, sweeping, and mopping floors.
  • Ensure all kitchen equipment is cleaned and stored correctly.
  • Carry out deep cleaning of fridges and storage areas to meet hygiene standards.
  • Support with washing up, ensuring all items are cleaned and ready for service.
  • Keep back-of-house areas clear and organised, including end-of-day cleaning and waste removal.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who are:

  • Experienced in working in a fast-paced kitchen or similar environment.
  • Knowledgeable or aware of manual handling techniques.
  • Familiar with basic kitchen equipment and processes.
  • Reliable, proactive, and able to work as part of a team.
  • Committed to maintaining high standards of cleanliness and food safety.

Due to the nature of this role, applicants must be 18 years of age or over at the time of application. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications from anyone under the age of 18 for this role.

Why should you apply?

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

job.title: ALTERNANCE - Assistant Chef de Projet Marketing
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

 

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

 

Nous recherchons actuellement notre alternant Assistant chef de Projets Marketing avec pour missions d’accompagner le club à la réalisation de ses objectifs business. L'Assistant chef de projets marketing aura pour missions d'assister la chef de groupe  dans l’élaboration des plans de promotion billetterie/expériences stade et leur exécution :

 

  •  Participer à l’élaboration des contenus des supports et des outils de communication 
  •  Briefs créatifs
  • Rédactionnels (mailings, posts réseaux, argumentaires commerciaux) 
  • Participer au pilotage et à la mise en place des opérations commerciales et plans médias o Veiller à la bonne circulation des informations avec l’ensemble des services (force de ventes, marketing, digital, communication interne…) 
  • Participer au suivi du déroulement des opérations commerciales (reporting, analyse) et à la mise en place d’un calendrier de promotion partagé 
  • Participer à la coordination des shooting photos pour assurer le lancement des nouvelles collections 
  • Participer au développement et à la mise à disposition auprès des boutiques et du ecommerce, des outils pour animer les points de ventes toute au long de la saison 
  • Participer au suivi de l’impact des opérations marketing sur les ventes

 

 Formation et expérience

 

 De formation BAC+4/5 en école de management, commerce ou communication. Dispose idéalement d’une première expérience en marketing opérationnel

 

Compétences et savoir-être

 

  •  Aisance relationnelle
  •  Capacité de synthèse et d’analyse
  •  Autonomie et rigueur
  •  Aptitudes rédactionnelles
  •  Connaissance du monde du foot 

 

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

job.title: OL Lyonnes - STAGE / REDACTION DIGITALE (H/F)
job.html_description:
Né en 2004, OL Lyonnes est le club le plus titré de l’UEFA Women’s Champions League avec 8 trophées eu-ropéens à son actif (dont 5 remportés consécutivement). 

 

Avec un total de 42 titres, dont 19 de Championnes de France, 11 Coupes de France, 3 Trophées des Championnes et 1 Coupe LFFP, OL Lyonnes possède le plus grand palmarès du championnat féminin français. 

 

Racheté par Michele Kang en 2023, le club intègre la première organisation multi-clubs de football féminin détenue et dirigée par une femme, aux côtés des clubs Washington Spirit et London City Lionesses.

 

 

OL Lyonnes recherche son/sa futur(e) Stagiaire en rédaction digitale à pourvoir dès le 1er septembre pour une durée de 6 mois. 

 

Les principales missions rédactionnelles sont les suivantes : 

 

- Production et rédaction d'articles pour le site Internet

- Veille de l’actualité et propositions de sujets

- Uniformisation des articles et contenus

- Mise en place des bonnes pratiques SEO

- Mise à jour et gestion du site Internet

- Actualisation des effectifs, pages fixes

 

Les compétences requises pour ce poste sont : 

 

· Etudiant (e) en journalisme, communication

· Excellentes aptitudes rédactionnelles

· Très bonne connaissance du sport et du football féminin ;

· La maîtrise de l’anglais (oral et écrit) est un plus.

 

Vous êtes motivé(e), autonome et force de proposition. Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans l'exécution de vos missions et savez vous adapter à différentes situations grâce à votre débrouillardise.

 

Doté(e) d'un bon relationnel, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et contribuez activement à une collaboration efficace et constructive. 

 

Des déplacements sont à prévoir. Le poste nécessite une certaine flexibilité horaire, avec une disponibilité ponctuelle en soirée et le week-end en fonction de l'actualité et des événements.

 

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Notre grande famille rouge et bleue recherche son/sa futur(e) stagiaire - Assistant(e) Chef(fe) de Projet Evénementiel pour une durée de 6 mois à partir de septembre prochain ( avec la possibilité de démarrer dès cet été!)  :

 

En quoi cela consiste ?

 

Le stagiaire dans le cadre du fonctionnement du service Séminaires, devra travailler en collaboration avec l’équipe sur les tâches suivantes : 

 

Commercialisation d’événements (séminaires, visites): 

  • Réception des demandes clients
  • Réalisation des offres commerciales
  • Suivi des offres et relances commerciales 
  • Editions de devis, factures pour les visites de Stade

 

Organisation d’évènements :

  • Organisation en amont de l’évènement avec le client et avec les différents services
  • Présence le jour J sur l'évènement
  • Soutien opérationnel et coordinations équipes terrain 

 

Prospection commerciale :

  • Phoning
  • Participation à des opérations de promotion, présence sur les réseaux sociaux 
  • Renseignement d'une base CRM

 

Participation à la coordination du service : 

  • Création de plannings
  • Suivi du reporting CA

 

De formation Bac+3/5, vous justifiez d'une première expérience commerciale dans le secteur événementiel ou touristique (stage/alternance). 

 

Compétences et savoir-être :

 

  • Autonomie
  • Rigueur
  • Relation client
  • Aisance Orale 
  • Force de proposition 
  • Maitrise du pack Office
  • Anglais, un vrai +

 

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

job.title: Chargé(e) Billetterie (H/F)
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) Chargé(e) billetterie (H-F) en CDI à pourvoir début août.  

 

Au sein de la Direction Opérations et de l’équipe paramétrage billetterie, le/la Chargé(e) 
Billetterie (H-F) est en charge de l'organisation opérationnelle et technique de la billetterie 
sur toutes nos plateformes billetterie (OL/OL Entreprise). 


Il/elle joue un rôle clé dans l'optimisation des parcours d’achat, la configuration des offres, 
fluidité des processus de vente jusqu’au coup d’envoi de chaque événemen et a une importance capitale dans la coordination des toutes les informations billetterie de chaque événement. 


MISSIONS PRINCIPALES 


1. Paramétrage technique des éléments billetterie 

 

  • Configuration des événements (matchs, abonnements, hospitalités, parkings, 
    visites/musée…) sur le logiciel billetterie FanXP (back et front office) 
  • Création et gestion des plans de stade en accord avec les obligations de chaque 
    demandeur. 
  • Paramétrage des offres tarifaires, opérations commerciales, 
  •  Gestion des différents canaux de vente (site web, revendeurs).
  • Gestion des quotas de chaque événement. 
  • Ajustement des offres tarifaires en accord avec le pricing manager pour chaque 
    commercialisation.

 

2. Coordination opérationnelle

 

  •  Supervision de l’ouverture à la vente de tous les événements se déroulant au stade. 
  •  Coordination avec les équipes marketing, communication, service client, 
    commerciaux afin d’assurer la transmission des informations paramétrages.
  • Coordination et suivi des demandes ayants droits pour chaque match. 
  • Suivi de la performance des offres en liens avec les équipes du pôle business. 
  • Coordination et accompagnement des équipes (service client, B2B, finance, etc.) 
    dans l’utilisation de l’outil selon les besoins spécifiques de chaque département. 
  • Coordination avec notre prestataire de l’outil billetterie concernant d’éventuelles 
    corrections et évolutions. 
  • Collaboration avec l’équipe service client à la gestion des réclamations billetterie.
  •  Soutien si besoin aux équipes les jours de match : guichets litiges, contrôle d’accès, 
    équipes commerciales. 


3. Suivi et analyse

 

  • Suivi des reporting quotidien/hebdomadaire/mensuel des ventes. 
  • Accompagnement des équipes pricing, marketing à l’analyse des performances 
    commerciales des offres billetterie. 
  •  Recommandation d’améliorations, ajustements (UX, tarification, ciblage client, etc.)

 

PROFIL SOUHAITE : 

 

Titulaire d'une formation de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 en management des organisations sportives, événementiel ou domaine équivalent, vous justifiez d'une expérience de 2 à 5 ans dans la gestion de la billetterie et l'organisation d'événements accueillant du grand public. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés à la billetterie, notamment en matière d'expérience spectateur, de gestion des flux et de sécurité.

 

Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques, en particulier Excel et Power BI.

 

Reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre sens de l'organisation et votre capacité à gérer les priorités, vous savez évoluer efficacement dans un environnement exigeant et faire face aux périodes de forte activité.

 

Doté(e) d'un excellent relationnel et d'un fort esprit d'équipe, vous faites preuve de disponibilité et de flexibilité pour travailler en soirée, les week-ends et les jours d'événements.

 

La maîtrise de la solution de billetterie FanXP constitue un atout.

 

 

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

- Supervision de l’ouverture à la vente de tous les événements se déroulant au stade. - Coordination avec les équipes marketing, communication, service client, commerciaux afin d’assurer la transmission des informations paramétrages. - Coordination et suivi des demandes ayants droits pour chaque match. - Suivi de la performance des offres en liens avec les équipes du pôle business. - Coordination et accompagnement des équipes (service client, B2B, finance, etc.) dans l’utilisation de l’outil selon les besoins spécifiques de chaque département. - Coordination avec notre prestataire de l’outil billetterie concernant d’éventuelles corrections et évolutions. - Collaboration avec l’équipe service client à la gestion des réclamations billetterie. - Soutien si besoin aux équipes les jours de match : guichets litiges, contrôle d’accès, équipes commerciales.
3. Suivi et analyse
- Suivi des reporting quotidien/hebdomadaire/mensuel des ventes. - Accompagnement des équipes pricing, marketing à l’analyse des performances commerciales des offres billetterie. - Recommandation d’améliorations, ajustements (UX, tarification, ciblage client, etc.)
PROFIL SOUHAITE :
Titulaire d'une formation de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 en management des organisations sportives, événementiel ou domaine équivalent, vous justifiez d'une expérience de 2 à 5 ans dans la gestion de la billetterie et l'organisation d'événements accueillant du grand public. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés à la billetterie, notamment en matière d'expérience spectateur, de gestion des flux et de sécurité.
Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques, en particulier Excel et Power BI.
Reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre sens de l'organisation et votre capacité à gérer les priorités, vous savez évoluer efficacement dans un environnement exigeant et faire face aux périodes de forte activité.
Doté(e) d'un excellent relationnel et d'un fort esprit d'équipe, vous faites preuve de disponibilité et de flexibilité pour travailler en soirée, les week-ends et les jours d'événements.
La maîtrise de la solution de billetterie FanXP constitue un atout.
Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.
Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :
- Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ; - Un parcours d’intégration unique ; - La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.
Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

job.title: Chargé de missions sureté sécurité
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

 

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

 

Dans le cadre de nos activités, nous recrutons un(e) Chargé(e) de missions sûreté-sécurité en CDD pour une durée de 12 mois. Le poste est à pourvoir à compter du 1er août.

 

Sous la responsabilité de la Directrice Sureté et Sécurité de l’Olympique Lyonnais, le Chargé de mission Sureté / Sécurité interviendra notamment dans les domaines suivants :

 

Missions Principales

  • Piloter la sureté d’événements (Matchs OL Lyonnes, Concerts, autres)
  • Contribuer l’organisation de la sûreté des rencontres de l’Olympique Lyonnais
  • Assurer la gestion des dispositifs logistiques et du système d’accréditation soir de match
  • Répondre aux besoin d’analyse de vidéo surveillance du club

 

 

Préparation des matchs

  • Préparer et participer aux réunions de préparatoires (centralisation des informations internes, aide à la rédaction des comptes rendus entre les parties prenantes externes)
  • Evaluer, mettre en place et contrôler les moyens humains et matériels visant à assurer la bonne organisation et la sécurité des évènements
  • Configurer le centre d’accréditation pour l’événement, suivre et contrôler les demandes
  • Optimiser les process
  • Gestion des commandes

 

 

Jour de match

  • Assurer en autonomie l’encadrement de rencontres à faible risques
  • Valider les demandes d’accréditations additionnelles en lien avec le centre d’accréditation
  • Administratif et relai interservices – Gestion main courante – Assistance Vidéo surveillance

 

 

Autres

  • Suivi facturation
  • Rédaction de retex internes
  • Répondre aux besoins d’analyse vidéo post match pour commission ou recours
  • Participer à la formation des prestataires de sécurité (formation, outils, etc.)
  • Suivi et entretien du parc logistique
  • Préparer les déplacements des équipes sureté pour match à l’extérieur

 

 

D’autres domaines d’intervention pourront être inclus au périmètre du Chargé de Mission Sureté/Sécurité au fur et à mesure de l’évolution de l’activité du service

 

 

Expérience et compétences

  • Diplôme de Niveau Bac+3/Bac+5
  • Titulaire de la carte professionnelle CNAPS indispensable
  • Niveau d’anglais opérationnel
  • 2 à 3 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la sûreté et sécurité et/ou de l’évènementiel
  • Parfaite connaissance du milieu de la sécurité privée : acteurs, réglementations, enjeux
  • Expérience certaine dans la gestion d’une équipe et/ou d’un prestataire de sécurité privée
  • Maîtrise informatique pack office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
  • Connaissance et agilité avec les outils vidéo, billetterie, service client serait un plus (genetec, DUC, Live Access)

 

 

Qualités personnelles 

  • Capacité d’organisation
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe
  • Discrétion / sens de la confidentialité
  • Disponibilité et adaptabilité
  • Respect des délais et des procédures
  • Réactivité / polyvalence
  • Communication Orale & écrite
  • Capacité d’analyse et de synthèse,
  • Implication, engagement,
  • Confidentialité

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

job.title: Stage - Assistant commercial merchandising GMS
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

 

Notre grande famille rouge et bleue recherche son/sa futur(e) stagiaire - Assistant(e) Commercial(e) GMS pour une durée de 6 mois à partir de septembre. 


En soutien au Responsable Commercial GMS, l'Assistant(e) Commercial(e) aura notamment pour missions premières de savoir gérer le quotidien administratif, commercial et logistique du service VHC-GMS.
L'Assistant(e) Commercial(e) aura un vrai rôle stratégique au bon fonctionnement du service.
Véritable interface entre les clients et les équipes internes (commerce, logistique, ADV), il/elle assure la fluidité des opérations commerciale au quotidien.

 

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES 


Gestion commerciale

•    Connaître les offres et produits, répondre aux demandes d'informations et réceptionner les commandes 
•    Saisir et envoyer des devis/commandes aux clients
•    Gérer les litiges clients et SAV
•    Créer et mettre à jour le catalogue et les grilles tarifaires
•    Participer à la préparation de rendez-vous commerciaux et, ponctuellement, accompagner le Responsable Commercial en rendez-vous clients 

 

Gestion logistique
•    Suivre les expéditions et livraisons en lien avec le service logistique et les transporteurs
•    Participer à la gestion de la facturation (émission, contrôle et suivi des factures)

 

Gestion administrative
•    Créer les nouveaux comptes clients GMS
•    Mise à jour des fiches clients existantes.
•    Faire évoluer le fichier client 

 


Support opérationnel au développement de l’activité
•    Contribuer à l’amélioration des outils interne de reporting
•    Proposer des analyses pertinentes des ventes réalisées 
•    Participer à l’élaboration d’offres personnalisées BtoB

 


QUALITES REQUISES 

 

Esprit d'équipe
Aisance relationnelle physique et téléphonique.
Bonne élocution ; bonnes qualités rédactionnelles.
Avoir le sens de l'écoute.
Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse. Avoir le sens de l'organisation.
Bonne autonomie
Maîtriser les outils bureautiques et informatiques (Word, Excel, Power Point).

 

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !
