job.title: Marketing - Street Team PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
Position Summary
Nashville SC Street Team members serve as key community ambassadors for the Club throughout the 2025 season. This role supports fan engagement at public appearances, home matches, away watch parties, and community events across the Nashville area. Street Team members play a vital role in strengthening fan loyalty by enhancing the matchday and event experience, while also serving as an extension of the Club’s Marketing and Entertainment teams.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Facilitate on-site activations and promotional events while delivering exceptional customer service and representing the Club with energy and professionalism.
  • Serve as an extension of the Marketing Department by promoting club initiatives, ticket programs, and brand messaging.
  • Assist guests as part of the GEODIS Park guest experience team when needed.
  • Actively engage with fans to encourage participation in activations, distribute giveaways, and provide event-specific information.
  • Assist with the setup, operation, and breakdown of interactive displays, promotional booths, and event materials.
  • Distribute marketing collateral in an organized and professional manner.
  • Collect and report feedback, observations, and insights following events to supervisors.
  • Support pre-match activities, including Opening Act activations (e.g., Kick Wall, premium tailgate).
  • Serve as a matchday runner for the Nashville SC Entertainment team as needed.
  • Assist with matchday entertainment management, hospitality, and game presentation needs.
  • Support production logistics, including entertainment personnel arrival, load-in, and load-out.

Shift Information
  • Shifts include all home matches, the majority of away matches, and additional off-site community events throughout the season.
  • Hours vary by event schedule, with an expected commitment of approximately 5–15 hours per week during the season.
  • Some shifts require transporting materials to and from event locations and assisting with setup and teardown.

Qualifications
  • Ability to commit to all Nashville SC matchdays (home and away) with minimal scheduling conflicts.
  • General interest in and working knowledge of soccer, including basic understanding of Nashville SC’s schedule and roster.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a positive, outgoing attitude.
  • Comfortable engaging with fans and promoting club initiatives in public settings.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to learn club promotions, ticket programs, and soccer-related information (training provided).
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and a good driving record.
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and select holidays.
  • Dependable, punctual, and professional.
  • Ability to lift and move materials exceeding 50 lbs.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism when interacting with VIP-level personnel.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required.
  • Prior experience in promotions, events, or brand ambassador roles preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Housekeeping - Housekeeping PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
About Nashville SC & GEODIS Park:
 Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Locally, Nashville SC is in its sixth season and continues to thrive both on and off the field, highlighted by the opening of GEODIS Park in May 2022—the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer. 
 
What we are looking for:
  • Individuals available for 6-8 hours, 15-20 times per year, and available to attend all necessary in-person and virtual training as a prerequisite for employment
  • Someone who enjoys speaking and interacting with others in a warm, and respectful manner
  • Must enjoy helping others and working within a team environment
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time and be exposed to different types of weather 

Primary roles & responsibilities:
  • Maintain stadium cleanliness, emptying trash cans, replacing trash cans with a new liner, wiping down countertop areas, tops of trash cans; sweeping/mopping the concourse as necessary; squeegeeing standing water to provide a safe environment for our guests; picking up and throwing away trash left in the stadium and outside perimeter that cannot be swept.
  • Responsible for providing a clean and safe facility before, during, and after all events
  • Responsible for picking up trash and emptying trash and recycle receptacles
  • Maintain all aspects of restroom cleanliness and preparedness by stocking and wiping down dispensers; cleaning and disinfecting all fixtures (toilets, urinals, sinks, baby changing tables); keeping the floor clean, dry and free of debris; and emptying trash cans
  • Respond to and resolve guests’ questions, concerns, complaints or suggestions in a professional and polite manner. Recognize and respond effectively in emergency situations
  • Supervisory positions available

job.title: Performance Nutritionist
job.html_description:
Position Summary

Under the direction of the Director of High Performance, the Performance Nutritionist is primarily responsible for the development and execution of nutrition services for the first team, providing individualized and team-based nutrition support that optimizes player health, adaptation, recovery, and performance. This role requires a high level of organization and communication to facilitate collaboration with team operations, high performance staff, and the culinary team.

 

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive nutrition program designed for optimal performance: the evaluation, interpretation, and monitoring of the nutritional status and nutritional needs of the team, using established standards of care and practice guidelines.
  • Conduct nutrition assessments, care planning, education, and counseling of athletes and staff, including personalized nutrition services and medical nutrition therapy for athletes with clinical nutrition needs and food allergies, integrated with the individual athlete’s nutrition goals as indicated.
  • Design, implement, and oversee an evidence-based supplementation program, prioritizing NSF Certified for Sport (or equivalent third-party banned-substance-tested) products, with ongoing education and monitoring to ensure compliance with MLS rules, regulations, and nutrition-related bylaws and to minimize inadvertent doping risk.
  • Order, interpret, and act on blood biomarker panels (e.g., iron/ferritin, vitamin D, complete metabolic and lipid panels, CBC, inflammatory markers) in collaboration with team physicians, translating findings into individualized lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations that optimize athlete performance and health.
  • Leads and conducts individual and team nutrition counseling and education sessions; development of effective individual nutrition prescriptions and educational materials for athletes.
  • This position will require strong communication skills, both verbal and written and the ability to collaborate with Coaches, Sports Medicine staff, Strength and Conditioning staff, physicians, and other support staff to ensure a collaborative and comprehensive approach to training, nutrition and recovery, as well as aiding in the treatment of diet and nutritional related medical issues.
  • Coordinate and implement nutritional recovery process through pre- and post-competition menus with training ground chefs; oversee and implement catering and meals during team travel with hotels. Coordinate/manage quantity food production, inventory and distribution, of other food products, supplements and beverages. oversee ordering, vendor relationships, procurement of goods and payment of purchases.
  • Body Composition testing (DEXA and other) including assessment, education, and programming regarding the nutritional needs. Conduct body composition assessments by utilizing and maintaining appropriate technology (i.e. DEXA, BodPod or InBody) and other manual anthropometric testing (i.e. ISAK).
  • Implementation of hydration testing and strategies.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

 

 

Requirements

  • Registered Dietitian, by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, must be Registered and Licensed by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND) of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics and licensed in the state of Tennessee of a minimum of 2 years. 
  • Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Dietetics, Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Biology, or other Health Sciences related field.
  • Excellent multi-tasking and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including: evenings and weekends, with possible travel.  Must be available for in-person work/team interaction at an average of 15-25 hours per week.
  • Candidate should possess strong computer knowledge including proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office and other relevant software.
  • Professional, collegiate or club level sport nutrition experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency interpreting blood biomarker panels and translating results into actionable lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations, with working knowledge of third-party supplement testing/certification standards (e.g., NSF Certified for Sport) and anti-doping regulations relevant to professional sport.

 

Preferred but not required:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Eligible to be Board Certified as a Specialist in Sports Dietetics (CSSD).
  • Soccer experience
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist, through NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association)
  • ISAK certified 
  • Certified in Sports Nutrition (CISSN, ISSN) or comparable applied supplementation credential
  • Experience partnering with physicians on blood panel-driven nutrition and supplementation protocols
  • Experience in research, data collection, analysis of monitored stats, and evaluation of technology used by Sports Science/Performance department.

job.title: I.T. Network Administrator
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The IT Network Administrator supports Nashville SC’s technology infrastructure across the Club’s facilities, with a primary focus on maintaining a reliable, secure, and well-documented network environment. This role requires a hands-on technical operator who can support network administration, infrastructure troubleshooting, end-user needs, and event technology in a small IT team. The ideal candidate brings strong network infrastructure experience, practical troubleshooting ability, clear communication skills, and sound judgment around security, confidentiality, and escalation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Install, configure, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot network equipment and infrastructure across Club facilities
  • Maintain and document network assets, configurations, procedures, and escalation paths to support operational continuity
  • Support end-user helpdesk needs as part of a small IT team
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to wired/wireless networks, VLANs, firewalls, and related network services
  • Contribute to technology planning and execution for matchdays, concerts, international matches, and other major events
  • Work closely with IT staff, end users, external stakeholders, and technology partners to identify issues, implement solutions, and support system improvements
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating issues and next steps as needed
  • Work nights, weekends, and holidays as required, including matchdays and stadium events
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT administration, network administration, or related technical support
  • Strong hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, and maintaining Cisco-based enterprise network environments
  • Working knowledge of IP networks, routing protocols, LAN/WAN configurations, firewalls, VPNs, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, and VMware
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and customer-service skills
  • Comfortable working in a small IT team where priorities can shift quickly between helpdesk requests, network issues, event support, and longer-term project needs
  • Sound judgment in handling network access, systems, credentials, confidential information, and appropriate escalation practices

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft, or VMware certifications
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki, enterprise wireless environments, and advanced VLAN troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting technology operations across multiple facilities or event-based environments
  • Experience working with external vendors, managed service providers, or technology partners

job.title: Financial Analyst
job.html_description:
Nashville SC is seeking a full-time Financial Analyst to join the club. The Financial Analyst is responsible for supporting financial planning, analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities across the organization. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, capable of translating financial data into actionable business insights.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and variance analyses.
  • Assist with development of budgets, forecasts, and long-range financial plans.
  • Analyze financial performance and key business metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Support management’s strategic initiatives with ad hoc financial modeling and business case analyses.
  • Maintain and improve financial reporting tools, dashboards, and KPI tracking.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance financial performance.
  • Assist with accounting and month end close as needed.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of proven experience as a financial analyst or similar role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and modeling.
  • Understanding of GAAP and basic accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

 

Preferred Skills:

  • CPA, CMA, CFA, or progress toward a professional certification is a plus.
  • Experience with NetSuite, Vena, Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence and automation tools is a plus.

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. - 2+ years of proven experience as a financial analyst or similar role. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and modeling. - Understanding of GAAP and basic accounting principles. - Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. - Excellent communication and presentation skills. - Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Preferred Skills:
- CPA, CMA, CFA, or progress toward a professional certification is a plus. - Experience with NetSuite, Vena, Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence and automation tools is a plus.

job.title: Manager, Special Event Sales
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
As the Manager, Special Events Sales at GEODIS Park, home of Nashville SC, you will play a critical role in driving revenue through the sales and coordination of special events. This position is focused on developing new business, maintaining strong client relationships, and creatively packaging GEODIS Park’s unique venue spaces. You will work collaboratively with internal stakeholders to maximize venue usage and ensure an exceptional client experience from initial outreach through event execution.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through networking, cold outreach, client referrals, trade publications, and database research.
  • Build relationships with local event planners, corporate planners, and decision-makers to promote GEODIS Park’s event offerings.
  • Schedule and lead venue tours for prospective clients, showcasing features and amenities.
  • Prepare and deliver professional proposals and presentations using data, visuals, and client-focused storytelling to secure bookings.
  • Maintain and grow relationships with existing clients to drive repeat business and long-term partnerships.
  • Conduct market research to uncover new leads and cross-departmental tie-in opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal scheduling and booking teams to secure venue availability.
  • Partner with operations, marketing, ticketing, sponsorship, and premium sales teams to support event execution and maximize revenue.
  • Work with sponsorship and premium sales teams to package special event opportunities with partner or hospitality activations.
  • Assist in the ideation and execution of internal special event series and venue-driven initiatives.
  • Develop innovative sales strategies and social event packages to increase visibility and overall revenue.
  • Attend industry events and networking functions as a representative of GEODIS Park to generate new leads and stay connected to local trends.
  • Provide regular reporting on sales activity, pipeline updates, and performance metrics to the Senior Director of Special Events.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff and continued communication with operations teams to execute event logistics successfully.
  • Support the Senior Director in strategic initiatives, special projects, and other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Marketing, or related field; or 3+ years of relevant sales experience in events, hospitality, or corporate settings.
  • Experience working in a stadium, sports, entertainment, hotel, or convention center setting in an event sales role preferred.
  • Proven success in prospecting, negotiating, and closing diverse event sales.
  • Strong knowledge of the event/hospitality industry; familiarity with the Nashville market is a plus.
  • Strong Food and Beverage Knowledge
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Detail-oriented multitasker with experience managing fast-paced projects.
  • Advanced experience in CRM and venue management tools (e.g., Tripleseat, Momentus, VenueOps) and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Creative in developing tailored event packages.
  • Self-driven, collaborative, and results-driven.
  • Availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required by event schedules.

job.title: Host Families
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Football Operations Job type: Casual Job ref: 008802 Published: 5 months ago Expiry date: 30 Sep 2026 20:00
job.html_description:
Could you provide a welcoming home for the next generation of Newcastle United stars?

 

We’re looking for Host Families to support our young players as they move to Newcastle United from outside the North East.

 

Why Become a Host Family?

 

*        Provide a stable, safe, and welcoming home

*        Play a vital role in a player’s growth on and off the pitch

*        Support their academic and personal development

*        Receive competitive remuneration

 

Family is at the heart of Newcastle United. We know our players perform at their best when they feel happy and secure at home.

 

We offer both short-term (1–2 nights) and full-time (7 nights per week) placements for players aged 14–21.

 

If you can offer a nurturing environment and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

 

What we’re looking for:

 

We’re seeking Host Families in Newcastle upon Tyne (postcodes NE7, NE6, NE2, NE3, NE12), located close to our education partner or the Academy. You should be able to provide high-quality accommodation, ideally in a family environment.

 

Requirements:

 

*        Provide an evening meal, breakfast (for school-age players)

*        Access to laundry facilities and Wi-Fi

*        A safe and suitable environment for the player

*        Private bedroom with a double bed

*        Full or part-time placements available year-round to align with the football season

*        Willingness to accommodate trialists and provide holiday cover when needed

 

You’ll be able to:

 

*        Create a welcoming, homely environment for young players

*        Teach essential independent living skills like cooking, cleaning, and self-care

*        Provide meals following nutritional guidance from the Academy

*        Ensure accommodation is close to local amenities with good transport links to the Academy

*        Report any welfare concerns to the Academy’s Safeguarding and Wellbeing team

*        Integrate players into family life as much as they feel comfortable

*        Accommodate regular inspections and visits during the season

*        Build trusted relationships through open communication

*        Adapt to the flexible schedule of young players throughout the football season

*        Promote and demonstrate a strong anti-discriminatory practice

 

It would be great if you have:

 

*        Experience working with young people

*        Understanding of the emotional impact and well-being challenges young athletes face

*        A child-focused approach

*        The capacity to accommodate more than one player

 

We welcome applications from all sections of the community. In particular, we encourage candidates from Black, Asian and other minority ethnic backgrounds to apply, as these groups are currently under-represented in this role. If you're ready to offer a supportive home and make a lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you! 

 

To express an interest and find out more information please email Callum.Thompson@nufc.co.uk detailing the following:

 

1)      Your full name and current address

2)      Current occupation

3)      Whether you are interested in offering a full-time placement or intermittent support for trialists

4)      Your current property situation including availability of a private bedroom / number of rooms available

5)      Why you would like to become a host family in no more than 250 words

job.title: Lead Recruitment Data Analyst
job.html_description:
Lead Recruitment Data Analyst

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 24th June 2025

Be part of something bigger.

We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

To lead the application of data informed intelligence within the recruitment department, identifying, evaluating and ranking player targets to support first team and emerging global talent performance objectives.

What you’ll do

- Produce reporting and insights on transfer market trends and competitor benchmarking.

- Build and manage recruitment dashboards and automated workflows.

- Collaborate with data teams and external providers to drive innovation.

- Identify and rank player targets using data-led models.

- Deliver player analysis and evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders.

- Support recruitment strategy with data-driven insights and reporting.

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach.

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate details. Any candidates submitted without request will be considered direct applicants.

job.title: Research and Insights Analyst
job.html_description:
Research & Insights Analyst

 Permanent  

Newcastle upon Tyne  

Competitive Salary 

 

 Be part of something bigger. Help shape the future of talent identification and recruitment through research, insight and data-driven decision making. We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.  This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

As a Research & Insights Analyst within our Recruitment department, you will support Talent Identification & Recruitment through high-quality research, data analysis and presentation outputs. You will deliver focused research projects, benchmarking and horizon scanning activities, providing clear and compelling insights that inform decision-making across First Team, Global Talent and Academy recruitment.

What you’ll do

  • Deliver research projects aligned to departmental priorities and development objectives.

  • Conduct benchmarking, trend analysis and market research to support recruitment strategy.

  • Analyse and interpret data, reports and research outputs to generate actionable insights.

  • Produce high-quality reports, presentations, briefing materials and dossiers for stakeholders.

  • Translate complex data and research into clear, engaging and accessible outputs.

  • Support senior leaders with evidence-based recommendations and strategic insight.

  • Research best practice across high-performing teams and environments.

  • Coordinate and track research and development projects while maintaining awareness of emerging tools and innovations.

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach. Working closely with recruitment leads, analysts and scouts, you’ll contribute to a high-performing environment focused on identifying and developing talent.

What we’re looking for

  • Degree in a sports-related discipline or equivalent experience within a football or sporting recruitment environment.

  • FA Talent Identification Level 3 qualification (or equivalent).

  • Strong research, analytical and insight-generation skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience producing presentations, reports and data visualisations using tools such as Excel, PowerPoint and Tableau.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with excellent attention to detail.

  • Professionalism, discretion and the ability to handle sensitive information confidentially.

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.  For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.  Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.  This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.  Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate details. Any candidates submitted without request will be considered direct applicants.

job.title: NUW Strength & Conditioning Coach
job.html_description:
Strength and Conditioning Coach

Newcastle United Women

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Closing Date – 24/08/2026

We are the heartbeat of the city. Come and be a part of a long and proud history where we strive to be the best in everything we do, on and off the pitch. Bringing the people and communities together, join the Newcastle United women Family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

About the role

Newcastle United Women are seeking a dedicated and experienced Strength & Conditioning Coach to support the on-pitch physical development and performance of all NUW players. This role is integral to the delivery of the Club’s performance objectives and will work closely with coaches and the wider multidisciplinary team to implement evidence-informed athletic development programmes.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, deliver and review on-pitch athletic development and strength & conditioning programmes aligned with the NUW Performance Plan.

Collaborate with the medical team to support later-stage rehabilitation and return-to-play strategies.

Implement physical profiling systems to inform individual development and rehabilitation plans.

Ensure effective communication of S&C practices across the multidisciplinary team.

Maintain a comprehensive database of physical performance data and ensure all sessions are risk assessed.

Attend all NUW first team matches, including home, away and pre-season fixtures.

Represent the NUW Performance Department at relevant meetings and events.

Support player education and provide regular progression updates.

Engage in continuous professional development and uphold professional standards in line with UKSCA guidelines.

Adhere to all Club policies, including health & safety, safeguarding, welfare, equality, and GDPR compliance.

Your impact

You will have skills and experience in the following areas

Essential:

Proven experience in a high-performance multidisciplinary environment

Strong planning and problem-solving skills with the ability to meet deadlines.

Demonstrated impact in physical development, particularly in speed and change of direction.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and online programme design platforms.

Ability to interpret and apply performance data to practice.

Desirable:

Experience in elite women’s football or working with female athletes.

Experience in injury rehabilitation and return-to-play programmes.

Location

This role is based in Newcastle upon Tyne, the office. Please note, if you are not located in the Northeast and unable to relocate, we regret that we will not be able to progress your application.

Why choose us?

We’ve got a range of great benefits and rewards, from flexible ways of working, participation in our non-contractual employee bonus scheme, NUFC life assurance, free parking, discount at Shearers Bar and the Club Shop, Helping Hand – where you can access free GP appointments, Wellbeing Resources, Legal and Financial Support, pension contribution, free lunch and the best part, free tea and coffee. In addition, we run a salary sacrifice scheme which includes, tech, car, cycle to work and many more.

United As One

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

For further information on this role and about the club and our values please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited / speculative candidate details or applications. Any candidates supplied, unless formally requested, will be taken as a direct / free candidate.

job.html_description:
Sessional Strength & Conditioning Coach - NUW

Location: Newcastle Upon Tyne

Salary: Competitive

Department: Performance

Closing date:- 24/08/2026

Reports to: Head of Performance (NUW)

We are the heartbeat of the city. Come and be a part of a long and proud history where we strive to be the best in everything we do, on and off the pitch. Bringing the people and communities together, join the Newcastle United Women’s Family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

The Role

Newcastle United Women are looking for  ambitious and driven Sessional Strength & Conditioning Coach to join our growing Performance Department. This role will play a key part in developing the physical capabilities of our players, supporting on‑pitch performance, and contributing to our high‑performance environment as the team continues its progression. Working as part of a collaborative multidisciplinary team, you will deliver evidence‑informed S&C programmes, support rehabilitation, and contribute to the ongoing physical development of the squad in line with our key principles and the NUW Performance Plan.

Your Impact

  • Plan, deliver and review evidence-informed strength and conditioning programmes (on and off pitch) that maximise individual and squad physical performance in alignment with the NUW Performance Plan.

  • Collaborate with medical staff to provide S&C support for long-term rehabilitation and return‑to‑play processes.

  • Implement and evaluate physical profiling systems that inform individual development plans and targeted S&C programmes.

  • Contribute to the development and delivery of monitoring systems (external load, internal load, wellness and neuromuscular status) to support MDT decision‑making. * Support the implementation of innovative, evidence-based recovery strategies.

  • Communicate effectively with key staff to ensure S&C practices are integrated, impactful, and fully understood.

  • Develop, deliver and regularly review S&C plans for all NUW players.

  • Support the ongoing refinement and delivery of the NUW Performance Plan. * Assist with player education and provide clear, timely progression updates.

  • Collect, analyse and interpret performance data to inform coaching and medical decisions.

  • Maintain a comprehensive and well‑organised database of all work undertaken.

  • Ensure all S&C sessions are supported by appropriate risk assessments. * Attend First Team matches — home, away and pre‑season — as required.

  • Represent the Performance Department at meetings, conferences, and events.

  • Engage in continuous professional development and contribute to departmental learning.

Qualifications & Experience

  • BSc (or equivalent) in Sports Science or Strength & Conditioning from an accredited institution.

  • S&C Accreditation (e.g., UKSCA, ASCA, NSCA) — or the ability to obtain within an agreed timeframe.

  • Full UK driving licence or the ability to travel to various locations to meet role demands.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Significant experience working effectively within a high‑performance multidisciplinary environment.

  • Strong operational and organisational skills with the ability to meet deadlines and solve problems effectively.

  • Experience designing and delivering physical development programmes that drive measurable performance improvements.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively. * A reflective practitioner with the ability to adapt and improve working methods.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Ability to build positive relationships with players, coaches and wider MDT staff.

  • Strong IT skills, including extensive use of Microsoft Office and programme‑design platforms.

  • Ability to utilise performance data to inform S&C practice.

Desirable

  • Experience working within elite women’s professional football.

  • Experience supporting elite female athletes.

  • Experience contributing to complex rehabilitation and return‑to‑play processes.

United As One

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited / speculative candidate details or applications. Any candidates supplied, unless formally requested, will be taken as a direct / free candidate.

job.title: NUW Scout
job.html_description:
Hybrid Scout 

Newcastle United Women

Remote working- Hybrid working

Closing Date -24/08/2026

Newcastle United Women’s is seeking A Hybrid Scout to support our recruitment strategy by identifying and assessing potential first-team and emerging talent. Operating within a hybrid model, this part-time role is primarily video based, with targeted live match coverage when required.

You’ll play a key role in helping us build a competitive squad capable of excelling in the Women’s Super League, delivering accurate, evidence-based scouting recommendations aligned with our tactical philosophy.

About the role

The roles are to Support the club’s recruitment strategy through talent identification and assessment. You will contribute directly to building a squad aligned with Newcastle United Women's tactical approach. You will operate in a hybrid capacity- video based scouting with live match attendance is needed.

Key Responsibilities:

Player Identification & Scouting-Strong focus on the Scandinavian market (Sweden, Denmark and Norway) from a video and live perspective

Conduct video scouting across assigned markets and competitions.

Attend live matches strategically, based on departmental needs.

Produce clear and structured scouting reports, highlighting strengths, weaknesses, and alignment with positional profiles.

Maintain and update watchlists of 'monitor now' players.

Work closely with the Senior Scout, NUW Lead Recruitment Analyst, and data team.

Participate in player meetings, presenting findings and recommendations.

Contribute to the creation of scouting dossiers and recruitment pitches.

Track developments in assigned leagues and markets.

Build and maintain relationships with clubs, academies, and agents to enhance Newcastle United Women’s recruitment network.

Your impact:

Experience in scouting, recruitment, or talent identification (women’s football experience desirable).

Familiarity with video scouting platforms (e.g., Wyscout, Hudl, Scoutastic).

Excellent reporting and presentation skills.

Organised, detail-focused, and collaborative.

Qualifications (Desirable)

FA Talent ID Level 2

UEFA Coaching Licence or equivalent

Commitment

Part-time role with flexible hours.

Hybrid model: primarily video-based, with targeted live attendance at matches as required.

We are building something special. Be part of a forward-thinking club with a commitment to excellence, inclusivity, and holistic player development. Your expertise could shape the next generation of professional female footballers.

Why choose us?

We’ve got a range of great benefits and rewards, from flexible ways of working, participation in our non-contractual employee bonus scheme, NUFC life assurance, free parking, discount at Shearers Bar and the Club Shop, Helping Hand – where you can access free GP appointments, Wellbeing Resources, Legal and Financial Support, pension contribution and free lunch  In addition, we run a salary sacrifice scheme which includes, tech, car, cycle to work and many more.

United As One

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

Please apply with your CV.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited / speculative candidate details or applications. Any candidates supplied, unless formally requested, will be taken as a direct / free candidate.

job.title: Casual Matchday Supporter Liaison Assistant
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Commercial Job type: Casual Job ref: 010682 Published: 2 days ago Expiry date: 27 Aug 2026 23:59
job.html_description:
Casual Matchday Supporter Liaison Assistant

Newcastle upon Tyne

Casual Position - Work match days and events, including weekends, evenings, and bank holidays.

£13.45 per hour

Be part of something bigger. Champion our supporters - solve problems and make every interaction count.**

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you're driven to raise the bar, take pride in delivering exceptional experiences and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you'll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, striving for Excellence, acting with Integrity, taking Accountability and being Relentless in our ambition to create memorable experiences for everyone who visits St. James' Park.

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of the energy and excitement of matchdays and events. Every interaction helps shape someone's experience of Newcastle United, and we're looking for people who genuinely care about making visitors feel welcome, valued and part of something special.

About the role

As a Matchday Supporter Liaison Assistant, you'll provide on-the-ground support to supporters at selected home and away fixtures. Acting as a friendly and approachable point of contact, you'll help supporters navigate their matchday experience, provide information and guidance, gather feedback, and escalate issues when required.

Working closely with the Supporter Liaison Officer and wider matchday teams, you'll contribute to creating a welcoming, inclusive and positive atmosphere for all supporters while helping the Club meet its fan engagement commitments.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Acting as a visible and approachable point of contact for supporters.
  • Providing information, guidance and signposting throughout the matchday.
  • Supporting the delivery of supporter engagement activities.
  • Gathering supporter feedback and sharing insights to support continuous improvement.
  • Assisting with matchday operations, supporter communications and wayfinding.
  • Liaising with internal teams to help resolve supporter issues efficiently.
  • Supporting selected home and away fixtures, including domestic and European matches as required.

The team

You'll join a diverse and supportive team who come together to deliver exceptional matchday and event experiences. Full training will be provided, and you'll be supported by experienced supervisors and managers throughout.

Together, we create an atmosphere where people feel welcomed from the moment they arrive. We look out for one another, work collaboratively, anticipate the needs of our guests and supporters, and take pride in delivering consistently high standards.

As part of a Club with ambitious goals, you'll be encouraged to bring energy, positivity and initiative to every shift. We value those who take ownership, show genuine care for others, and contribute to creating memorable experiences that reflect the pride of Newcastle United and the city we represent.

United As One.

We’re committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.

We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity, and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Academy Strength & Conditioning
job.html_description:
Company Description

The New York Red Bulls are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS). RBNY, one of the ten charter clubs of MLS, have competed in the league since its founding in 1996. The Red Bulls play home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) in Harrison, New Jersey. The three-time MLS Supporters' Shield Winners are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull for which the team is named. The New York Red Bulls offer one of the nation's premier youth soccer development programs, from local soccer partnerships across New York and New Jersey to Regional Development Schools and the Red Bulls Academy teams.

Purpose of this Internship

New York Red Bulls Academy are looking for an intern to join our excellent Medical and Performance department. This internship provides a professional learning environment for aspiring strength and conditioning coaches, performance scientists or other performance related careers.

Note: applicants must have consistent afternoon and/or evening availability on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. Weekend availability is a plus.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Contribute towards the development of best practices in the Academy
  • Design and administer strength training sessions and pre-training activation protocols that will align with the Red Bulls youth development model
  • Development and implementation of strength and conditioning programs to excel individual player performance and reduce risk of injuries
  • Evaluation of player performance through testing and workload monitoring in conjunction with selected key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Live global positioning system (GPS) monitoring of players during training and games
  • Plan and develop late-stage return to play sessions – working in collaboration with medical staff
  • Provide daily and weekly reports to the coaching staff regarding individual player and team physical performance
  • Testing and analyzing player physical performance and creating reports for coaches and players

Qualifications

Basic knowledge and understanding of soccer


Current undergraduate or graduate student studying sports exercise and science, strength and conditioning, CSCS accreditation, or a related field


Demonstrates effective communication, time management, and organizational skills


Lives within 60-miles of Whippany, New Jersey


Possess a driver’s license and/or reliable transportation


Proficiency in Microsoft Office – Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Academy Administration & Operations
job.html_description:
Company Description

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Academy Scout
job.html_description:
Company Description

The New York Red Bulls are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS). RBNY, one of the ten charter clubs of MLS, have competed in the league since its founding in 1996. The Red Bulls play home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) in Harrison, New Jersey. The three-time MLS Supporters' Shield Winners are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull for which the team is named. The New York Red Bulls offer one of the nation's premier youth soccer development programs, from local soccer partnerships across New York and New Jersey to Regional Development Schools and the Red Bulls Academy teams.

Purpose of this Internship

The Academy Scouting & Video Analysis Intern will gain hands-on experience within a professional youth academy by supporting the player identification and recruitment process through video analysis. Working alongside the Academy Scouting department, the intern will learn how video evaluation, player profiling, and scouting operations contribute to identifying elite youth talent while developing practical skills used throughout professional soccer. 

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

Learn the fundamentals of professional academy scouting, talent identification, and player evaluation.  


Develop technical skills in video analysis, including clipping, organizing, and presenting player footage using industry-standard software.  


Understand how scouting reports, video analysis, and recruitment workflows support player identification and decision-making.  


Gain experience organizing scouting databases, maintaining video libraries, and preparing materials for internal scouting discussions.


Improve analytical thinking, written communication, and attention to detail in a professional sporting environment.  


Work collaboratively with Academy staff while gaining insight into the day-to-day operations of a Major League Soccer academy. 

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and eligible to receive academic credit for the internship.  


Pursuing a degree in Sport Management, Sports Analytics, Performance Analysis, Coaching, Data Analytics, Kinesiology, or a related field.  


Passionate about soccer, player development, scouting, and performance analysis.  


Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and time management skills.  


Comfortable reviewing large amounts of match footage and identifying key player actions.  


Strong written and verbal communication skills.  


 Proficient with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.  


Experience with video analysis software (Hudl Sportscode, Hudl, Spiideo, Wyscout, or similar platforms) is preferred but not required.  


Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a professional environment. 

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - RBII Analysis
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.


RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

Red Bull New York II are looking for an intern to join our high-performance team for the season. A key responsibility of this internship includes providing analysis support to 2nd team staff in order to aid player development and maximize workflow efficiency. This internship will provide a valuable introduction into the world of analytics and the dynamics of a professional football club.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).  

Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • A basic understanding of how analysis is performed at a professional level
  • Introductory tools and skills to be able to analyze matches and trainings
  • The ability to fly a drone
  • Firsthand use of industry specific software programs
  • A beginning understanding of providing analysis within a professional football context

Qualifications

Passion for the game of soccer


A willing learner and can take initiative


The ability to learn on the fly and be adaptable in different situations


The ability to work under pressure

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends). 


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

Sponsorship sales prospecting


Sales proposal creation


Client relationships & account management


Industry research on other league and team partnerships

job.html_description:

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. Red Bull New York are looking for a motivated and organized college student to join the Operations department. This 12-week program is an opportunity to join the club and gain comprehensive understanding of operations at RBNY and Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS). The internship is a great opportunity for those interested in pursuing a career in sports. Experience will include working match days and non-match days at SIS, as well as Montclair State University. In addition to soccer events (MLS, MLSNP, NWSL), chosen applicants will likely be exposed to dark day assignments, special events, stadium projects, and potential requested support at the First team training ground.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship only (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Red Bull New York (MLS) Matches @ SIS, NJ/NY Gotham FC (NWSL) Matches @ SIS, RBNY II (MLSNP) Matches @ Montclair State University.


Support in daily operation of SIS, as well as stadium setup, breakdown, staging and conversion for matches.


Coordinate with other Red Bull New York departments to ensure successful event planning and execution.


Liaise with outside parties (visiting teams, referees, league officials, vendors, partners, etc.) to ensure all needs are met.


Other designated assigned duties.

Qualifications

Student pursuing career in Sports Management and/or Event Operations, with 1-2 years of related experience.


An individual with the ability to lift 50+ pounds and perform moderate labor over the course of a full event (8-12 hrs). Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions (heat, cold, rain, etc.).


Experience showing professionalism around pro athletes/teams, while maintaining composure and effectiveness under pressure and changing conditions in a team environment. 


Ability to meet deadlines; accomplish work in order of priority; effectively multitask and deliver consistently at a high level.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Control Room Operator
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

The Control Room Internship is designed to provide experience to college students pursuing a career in live production within a sports organization. Interns focus on creating an exciting fan experience for all Red Bull New York home matches and other events held at Sports Illustrated Stadium. Interns learn about live production, equipment operation, content creation, and other aspects of match presentation. Interns report directly to the Event Production Coordinator and work collaboratively with stakeholders across the organization. During the internship, students are involved in all stages of production of all events at Sports Illustrated Stadium.             

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Assist full-time control room staff with completing checklist items in preparation for each event.  


Work with Daktronics, Sony, DiGiCo, Chyron, Click Effects, and Evertz equipment in a live control room 


Assist in organizing and creating content for stadium video boards and LED ribbon boards 


Actively participate in the planning stage, preparation, and execution of events 


Learn to troubleshoot video, audio, and other signal flow issues 


Understanding of the process of setup, breakdown, and storage of broadcast equipment after various events 

Qualifications

Experience working with Adobe Suite or other similar editing software 


Pursuing a degree in Production, Digital Media, Sports Management, or other associated fields 


Knowledge of pre-production, production, and post-production processes 


Possess a strong work ethic, take a leadership approach, and strong improvisational skills 


Must be eligible to receive college credit 


This internship is ideally suited for someone with a strong interest in behind-the-camera live event production. While a strong interest in soccer and sports is not required, it is most definitely a plus!

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. Purpose of this Internship

The internship is designed to provide experience working specifically within the Regional Development School (RDS). The RDS Operations Intern is responsible for assisting in the day-to-day summer season operations of the RDS. The role comprises a balance of logistics and operational support for residential and day camps, with some focus on summer showcase league and regional select tournament preparations. The overview of responsibilities provided here is intended as a guideline only and should not be exhaustive.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Red Bull New York elite player identification and development process


Showcase team preparation, and summer league scheduling


Regional Select team tournament preparation and scheduling


Residential and day camp operations and planning


Kit and equipment inventory, delivery, and tracking


Hudl camera equipment operation to record summer showcase and/or Regional Select and/or Academy games/training where possible

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a degree in Sport Management, or a related field of study


A candidate with an interest in gaining experience in sports management operations, and/or elite level youth soccer


A passionate soccer fan with knowledge and interest in Major League Soccer


An organized self-starter with the ability to efficiently multi-task


Proficient in Microsoft Office – Word, PowerPoint, Excel


Preferable driver’s license and means of transportation

job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

The Red Bull New York, Inc. Ticket Operations department is seeking qualified candidates to fill the position of Box Office Intern. Ability to work effectively with others and self-motivation are a few of the key characteristics required.

Note: Consistent availability on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday - as well as game days preferred.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Learn the main functions of SI Tickets ticketing system to complete daily operations at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS). Consists of face-to-face interaction with patrons and Red Members for individual sales, customer service, and all other related ticket issues.


Communication with account representatives for distribution of tickets for the season, which includes printing tickets, and group/individual ticket package mailing.


Learn how to manage the seat inventory for all events. Includes reclassing of seats, delegating holds, and setting tickets for Account Manager, Will Call or regular mail on individuals’ accounts.


Creation and maintenance of promo codes for account representatives using SI Tickets, upon request.


Assisting our sales staff & finance team with support, research, projects, and operation aid during game days.  

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in college; must be able to receive college credit


Knowledge of and/or enthusiasm for soccer, Red Bull New York/MLS, and professional sports a plus.


Attendance at all Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) events is strongly encouraged (events are generally held on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday Evenings. There are some weekday events).

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

In this internship, you will learn how the day to day of communications and community relations fields on match days and non-matchdays operates. In this role, you will assist the communications and community relations teams in day to day operations including but not limited to assisting with stats research for our first and second teams, writing press releases, researching outlets to collaborate with, researching organizations in our community that we can work with, and transcribing quotes from all press conferences.

Write a professional press release for player transactions, schedule changes, international call ups and award recognitions.


Create Game Notes and Post Game Notes/Recaps.


Conduct stats research.


Moderate a press conference/media availability.


Pitching interview opportunities and community collaborations.


Draft match previews.


Organize and execute player appearances and community events.

Qualifications

Pursuing a degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations or any other related field.


Interested in a career in Communications, Public Relations or Marketing.


Outgoing and open to learning opportunities.


Strong communications skills.


Experience using the Microsoft Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel etc).


Experience using the Adobe Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Lightroom).

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Digital Growth & Content
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

The Digital Growth & Content Intern will support Red Bull New York’s digital marketing efforts across paid media, creative strategy, and campaign performance analysis. This internship is designed to provide hands-on experience in performance marketing, digital content execution, and campaign optimization while contributing to real business objectives across ticketing, brand, and fan growth initiatives.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Performance Marketing Fundamentals:


Gain foundational experience in paid media, including campaign setup, optimization, and reporting across platforms such as Meta and Google Ads. 


Creative Strategy & Execution:


Learn how performance data informs ad creative, messaging, and campaign recommendations, while also gaining hands-on exposure to building creative assets and briefs. 


Marketing Analytics & Reporting:


Develop the ability to analyze campaign performance, identify trends, and translate data into actionable recommendations that improve marketing outcomes. 


Cross-Functional Marketing Operations:


Understand how digital growth work connects with broader business needs, including collaboration with internal creative and marketing teams to support campaign execution and organizational priorities. 

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a college or university program and eligible to receive academic credit for the internship  


Strong interest in digital marketing, advertising, social media, and content creation  


Familiarity with major digital platforms such as Meta, Google, Instagram, and/or TikTok  


Comfortable working with spreadsheets, campaign data, and basic reporting  


Strong written communication skills and attention to detail  


Interest in creative development, including copywriting, visual concepts, and digital asset creation  


Familiarity with Canva, Figma, or similar creative tools is a plus  


Self-starter with a willingness to learn, take feedback, and contribute in a fast-paced environment  


Passion for sports, entertainment, or fan engagement marketing is a plus 

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - IT
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

The IT Internship at RBNY aims to provide a practical complement to a formal education in IT.


The program aims to help interns develop specific technical skills as well as soft skills like communication, teamwork, and problem-solving.


In addition, give interns a taste of different career paths within IT and help them determine what they're most interested in, as well as offer an understanding of how IT functions in a real-world business environment and to expose interns to industry standards and practices. In this case, specifically in the world of professional sports.               

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Contribute to ongoing IT projects by performing tasks assigned by project managers or team leads


Conduct research on new technologies, vendors, or IT strategies that could benefit the organization.


Create and update documentation for IT systems, procedures, and training materials.


Participate in training sessions and workshops, and shadow experienced IT professionals to learn from their expertise.

Qualifications

Familiarity with computer hardware, software, and networks. Even at a basic level, understanding how systems interconnect and operate is crucial


Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems logically and systematically.


Document solutions, write reports, and maintain clear documentation for technical procedures.


Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with team members and explain technical issues to non-technical colleagues.


Be able to work well in a team, as IT projects often require collaboration with various stakeholders.


Precision and attention to detail when working with complex systems to avoid errors and identify issue

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: Netball Community Coaches
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Variable hours available

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Netball

About the Role:

To deliver high-quality coaching sessions, planning training programmes, and supporting administrative tasks to ensure the smooth running and development of each squad, working across a range of age groups and performance levels within the Netball Community Programmes.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Plan and deliver high-quality netball coaching sessions to players of all ages and abilities.

  • Foster a positive and inclusive environment that encourages participation and enjoyment of netball.

  • Develop and implement training programs that cater to the individual needs of players.

  • Monitor and evaluate player progress, providing constructive feedback to help them improve.

  • Ensure the safety and well-being of all participants during coaching sessions.

  • Promote Nottingham Forest Netball and its programs within local communities.

  • Assist in organising and running local netball events, tournaments, and competitions.

  • Maintain equipment and ensure it is used safely and effectively.

  • Attend CPD events organised by Nottingham Forest.

  • Committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of young people

What are we looking for:

  • Netball coaching qualification for Head Coach (LEVEL 2 or ABOVE)

  • Netball coaching qualification for Assistant Coach (LEVEL 1 or ABOVE)

  • ·Previous coaching experience, preferably within a community setting.

  • Excellent communication.

  • Ability to inspire and motivate players of all ages and abilities.

  • Strong organisational and time management skills.

  • Commitment to promoting equality, diversity, and inclusion in sports.

  • Valid driver's license and access to a vehicle for travel between locations.

  • First Aid certification

  • Safeguarding certification
