job.title: Academy Goalkeeper Coach (Part-Time)
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE:  Academy Goalkeeper Coach (Part-Time)
DEPARTMENT:  Academy
REPORTING TO: Academy Technical Director
LOCATION:  St. John’s University (Queens, NY) & CFA New York (Orangeburg, NY)
COMPENSATION: $30-35/hour, 15 hours per week

POSITION OVERVIEW:
New York City FC is seeking a dedicated and experienced Goalkeeper Coach to join our Academy staff. Working with our U12-18 age groups, you will be responsible for supporting the development of all of our Academy goalkeepers. This role will demand a high level of off-field expertise as well as a very strong ability to design, plan, and execute on-field sessions and build individual development plans while ensuring alignment with the overarching philosophy and playing style of NYCFC and City Football Group. This role will play a pivotal part in the development of goalkeepers within our academy, fostering their technical, tactical, physical, psychological, and social growth. Finally – you will also be part of the City select and scouting & recruitment of the new Goalkeepers for our incoming U12 team and any other team within the academy. Expect ad hoc requests for travelling days domestic and internationally.

WHO YOU ARE: 
At New York FC, we are committed to upholding our core club values and our values guide how we show up and work together every day.  If you share our values listed below, please consider NYCFC as a great place for you to work (and play):
 Acts Honorably: listens and communicates respectfully, without judgement
Engages Collaboratively: provides and seeks constructive feedback to and from peers, proactively sharing appreciation for quality contributions of others
Champions Inclusion: celebrates the value of differences recognizing the value in the unique backgrounds and lived experiences of every team member
Drives Forward: embraces new opportunities with curiosity and a focus on improvement and innovation
Shows Heart: demonstrates passion for the Club and sport, operating as an NYCFC ambassador in encouraging and inspiring that passion in others

WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Training and Development 
  • Design, plan and deliver daily goalkeeper-specific training sessions according to the clubs Game Model and Methodology.
  • Support the creation of a curriculum for the U12-18 goalkeepers in accordance with the playing style and principles of NYCFC.
  • Supporting the assessment of all U12-U18 GK’s in the Academy and provide detailed feedback to both staff and the players/parents. 
  • Utilize video analysis and modern coaching tools to enhance goalkeeper development and performance
  • Ensure that every Academy goalkeeper has a clear Individual Development Plan (IDP). 
  • Aid in on goalkeeper scouting/ recruitment within the Academy. This will include supporting the planning and delivery of goalkeeper try-outs, clinics and camps as well as attending local and nationwide events.
Matchday Responsibilities
  • Delivering to the U12-U18 Goalkeepers during matches and tournaments, including warm-ups and pre-game strategies for them.
  • Support the head coaches and technical staff in match preparation when requested
  • Provide in-game observations and adjustments to ensure goalkeeper development and performance.
Collaboration and Integration
  • Work closely with the NYCFC Academy Goalkeeper Coach and attend/deliver as per his instruction.
  • If requested, assist the first and second team goalkeeper coaches to ensure continuity and alignment in goalkeeper development.
  • Collaborate with the strength and conditioning team to design fitness programs tailored to goalkeeper needs.
  • Coordinate with performance coaches and medical staff on load management and injury prevention.
Administration and reporting
  • Maintain detailed records of goalkeeper performance, training attendance, and progress.
  • Provide regular progress reports to the Acdaemy Technical Director as requested.
  • Attend staff meetings, logistics meetings and other events as required by the club.
  • Complete all administration associated with the NYCFC Academy platforms (Kitman, Hudl, TAKA etc).
 
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
  • 3-5 years of youth goalkeeper coaching background/experience
  • Strong teaching background
  • Dual language English/Spanish is preferred
  • Knowledge and know-how of Microsoft office
  • Drivers license 
  • Strength in delivering tactically relevant on-field sessions
  • Hold a relevant coaching license (e.g., UEFA B License, USSF B License, or equivalent) or a goalkeeper-specific coaching license is highly preferred
  • Proven experience as a goalkeeper coach at the professional, collegiate, or elite youth level.
  • Experience in combining practical on-field know how with off-field planning and assessment
  • Ability to communicate effectively with players, staff, and other stakeholders.
  • Passionate about player development with a commitment to NYCFC's values and philosophy.
  • Collaboration with fellow coaches with a multidisciplinary approach
  • A motivated growth mindset and life-long learner
  • Strong work ethic
  • Competency in using analysis software particularly Hudl/Sportscode
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS:
Applicant must be able to comply with applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as necessary
Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times   

WHAT WE OFFER:
  • Two complimentary tickets to select New York City FC home match
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment
 
NEW YORK CITY FOOTBALL CLUB OVERVIEW:
At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build this city into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club was announced as Major League Soccer’s 20th franchise and is the first and only MLS team located within the five boroughs of New York City. The Club has qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs nine times over the past 10 seasons, winning MLS Cup in 2021. Games are available to stream via an Apple TV subscription, providing every match of the MLS regular season, the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs, annual Leagues Cup tournament, the MLS All-Star Game, the Campeones Cup, and more all in one place and with no blackouts. New York City FC is building New York City’s first-ever soccer-specific stadium, Etihad Park, which is set to open in 2027. For more information, please visit: www.newyorkcityfc.com.
 
New York City FC is also one of 12 clubs comprising City Football Group and counts Manchester City FC, Melbourne City FC, Yokohama F-Marinos, Girona FC, Montevideo City Torque, Shenzhen Peng City FC, Lommel SK, ESTAC Troyes, Palermo FC, Bahia, and Club Bolívar among its sister clubs.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
As an Academy Coach you will have the responsibility to contribute to the continued development of several Academy age groups. You will be responsible for the delivery of the NYCFC coaching philosophy and supporting Individual Development Plans for the players. You will contribute to the interdisciplinary team achieving individual and team goals. It is important that you are willing and able to work together across departments and other age groups.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
As an Academy coach, you are responsible for creating a learning environment, with the balance of challenges and support to each individual player. You are responsible to maximize the potential of every player through delivery of the NYCFC game model and methodology
- Responsible for the delivery and content of all daily training sessions and match preparation together with support staff. - Collaborate with the other Academy teams/staff and maintain relationships with appropriate stakeholders; both internal and external. - Responsible for planning, delivering, and reviewing coaching practice according to the NYCFC methodology with an action orientated attitude, striving to continually improve. - Work from a periodization model and conduct practice designs to enhance the learning and understanding of NYCF’s game model. - Collaboratively work with the other Academy coaches to deliver 1-to-1 player development support through progressive Individual Development Plans with ongoing specific actionable feedback. - Understand and adhere to all Competition Guidelines in all entered competitions - Representation of NYCFC in a positive manner within all required responsibilities, - Responsible for the continued development and matriculation of Academy players to progress in our system. - Responsible for engaging, and ensuring timely input, into all the Academy platforms and software (SmartaBase, Taka, etc)
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
- 5+ experience coaching youth academy level. - USSF ‘B or A’ license – minimum (required) - Strong communication skills and the ability to work multidisciplinary in the context of Soccer. - Valid driver’s license - Knowledge of Microsoft office; PowerPoint, Word, and Excel - Knowledge of tactical periodization and how to implement it. - A growth mindset and willingness to join the team with enthusiasm and curiosity.
WHO YOU ARE:

- Two complimentary tickets to select New York City FC home match - Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers - A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment

job.title: Senior Director, Maintenance & Safety
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Director, Maintenance & Safety
REPORTING TO: Head of Stadium Facilities Management
DEPARTMENT: Facility Operations
LOCATION: Etihad Stadium, Queens – this role is fully onsite. CFA, Orangeburg when required

POSITION OVERVIEW:
New York City FC is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Director, Maintenance & Safety to lead all aspects of stadium maintenance, asset management, engineering operations, life safety systems, and workplace safety programs.
This role will be responsible for ensuring Etihad Stadium and associated facilities are maintained to the highest standards of safety, reliability, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest experience. The Senior Director will oversee multidisciplinary maintenance and engineering teams, manage third-party service providers, and drive continuous improvement across all facility operations.
A critical component of this role will be supporting the transition from construction to operations by leading maintenance, asset management, and safety readiness activities through project closeout, commissioning, and stadium activation. The successful candidate will ensure building systems, processes, and personnel are fully prepared for long-term operational success.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Stadium Commissioning & Operational Readiness
  • Provide operational and maintenance expertise during the construction closeout and stadium activation phases.
  • Review design documentation and building systems to support maintainability, operational efficiency, and long-term asset performance.
  • Participate in coordination meetings with architects, engineers, contractors, and project teams throughout closeout and turnover activities.
  • Lead operational readiness planning, including participation in system commissioning, integrated testing, acceptance processes, and occupancy preparation.
  • Validate operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, as-built documentation, and turnover requirements.
  • Ensure all building systems meet applicable accessibility, life safety, code, and regulatory requirements prior to opening.
Maintenance & Asset Management
  • Direct all day-to-day maintenance operations across the stadium campus and associated facilities.
  • Develop and oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs that maximize asset reliability while minimizing operational disruption.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise asset management strategies, including lifecycle planning and capital renewal programs.
  • Ensure the effective operation, maintenance, and reliability of all facility systems, including: 
    • HVAC systems
    • Electrical distribution systems
    • Plumbing systems
    • Fire protection and life safety systems
    • Elevators and escalators
    • Building automation systems (BAS/BMS)
    • Roofing and building envelope systems
    • Structural components and mechanical equipment
  • Lead implementation, optimization, and ongoing performance management of the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Coordinate rapid response and recovery efforts for equipment failures, facility issues, and operational interruptions.
Safety, Risk Management & Compliance
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve workplace health, safety, and environmental programs in accordance with OSHA, New York State, New York City, fire code, and industry standards.
  • Maintain and oversee the stadium's Safety Management System (SMS).
  • Foster a culture of safety, accountability, operational discipline, and continuous improvement across all teams and contractors.
  • Lead incident investigations, corrective action programs, safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments.
  • Manage permit-to-work processes and ensure safe execution of all maintenance and contractor activities.
  • Maintain compliance with all regulatory, safety, environmental, inspection, certification, and documentation requirements.
Contractor & Vendor Management
  • Procure, negotiate, and manage maintenance service agreements and vendor contracts.
  • Establish performance standards and accountability measures for contractors and service providers.
  • Monitor contractor performance, quality of service, safety compliance, onboarding requirements, and adherence to applicable warranties and service agreements.
  • Ensure contractor activities are conducted in accordance with all stadium safety, operational, and regulatory requirements.
Event Operations & Facility Support
  • Provide engineering and maintenance leadership during sporting events, concerts, and other venue activities.
  • Ensure facilities and critical systems are operationally ready before, during, and after events.
  • Serve as a key operational leader during emergencies, business continuity incidents, and crowd-safety situations.
Capital Projects & Continuous Improvement
  • Support planning, execution, and delivery of capital improvement projects, renovations, and new installations.
  • Provide technical oversight to ensure new assets are effectively commissioned, documented, and integrated into operational maintenance programs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, asset performance, reliability, and service delivery.
Financial Management & Strategic Planning
  • Develop, manage, and administer departmental operating and capital budgets.
  • Monitor expenditures and identify opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiencies.
  • Prepare business cases and recommendations for asset replacement, capital investment, and long-term facility improvements.
  • Provide executive-level reporting on asset performance, maintenance KPIs, safety performance, operational trends, and capital planning initiatives.
Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead and develop a high-performing Maintenance & Safety organization, including engineers, skilled trades personnel, and third-party contractors.
  • Establish department objectives, KPIs, staffing plans, operational procedures, and workforce development strategies.
  • Develop training programs that support operational performance, safety compliance, and business needs.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, customer service, and continuous improvement throughout the department and across the organization.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in facility maintenance, engineering, or building operations, including significant leadership responsibility within large, complex facilities. 
  • Experience in stadiums, arenas, airports, convention centers, healthcare facilities, large entertainment venues, or similarly complex environments preferred. 
  • Demonstrated success leading maintenance operations, engineering teams, contractors, and capital projects. 
  • Experience implementing and utilizing CMMS and asset management systems. 
  • Experience with Willow technology platforms strongly preferred. 
  • Strong working knowledge of Building Automation Systems (BAS/BMS). 
  • Knowledge of unionized work environments and labor relations preferred. 
  • Proven ability to lead effectively during emergencies, operational disruptions, and time-sensitive situations. 
  • Strong people leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
  • Experience managing operating and capital budgets. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, Occupational Safety, or a related discipline preferred. 
  • Professional certifications such as CFM, FMP, CMRP, CSP, CHFM, NEBOSH, or equivalent are preferred. 
  • Collaborative mindset with the flexibility to support broader organizational and operational objectives as needed.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC
  • Must be able to work at all or most of the major scheduled events which may be at night and on weekends and holidays
  • Must be able to regularly traverse a multi-level industrial stadium campus, including access tunnels, seating bowls, mechanical rooms, and confined utility areas during high-density event windows.
  • Must be able to observe, inspect, and interpret technical building schematics, digital building automation system alarms, machinery gauges, and potential physical hazards.
  • Must be able to withstand regular exposure to outdoor weather elements during stadium walk-throughs and events, heavy mechanical machinery noise, localized dust, electrical currents, and industrial environments.
  • Calm under pressure and able to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders. 

COMPENSATION:
This exempt position has an estimated annual base salary range of $155,000 - $175,000 and is not overtime eligible. Final compensation offer amounts are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and some role-dependent factors such as certifications and software expertise. We welcome direct conversations with each candidate about compensation in all of our initial calls.

WHAT WE OFFER:
  • Excellent health, dental & vision insurance, with options to fit you and your family’s needs
  • Comprehensive and competitive benefit programs, including maternal & paternal leave
  • Ancillary benefits: Commuter, and Citi Bike discounts
  • Your health is important! Our wellness strategy focuses on mental and physical wellbeing through in-office and virtual programs
  • Four complementary tickets to every NYCFC home match
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment

NEW YORK CITY FOOTBALL CLUB OVERVIEW:
At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build this city into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club was announced as Major League Soccer’s 20th franchise and is the first and only MLS team located within the five boroughs of New York City. The Club has qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs nine times over the past 10 seasons, winning MLS Cup in 2021. Games are available to stream via an Apple TV subscription, providing every match of the MLS regular season, the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs, annual Leagues Cup tournament, the MLS All-Star Game, the Campeones Cup, and more all in one place and with no blackouts. New York City FC is building New York City’s first-ever soccer-specific stadium, Etihad Park, which is set to open in 2027. For more information, please visit: www.newyorkcityfc.com.

New York City FC is also one of 12 clubs comprising City Football Group and counts Manchester City FC, Melbourne City FC, Yokohama F-Marinos, Girona FC, Montevideo City Torque, Shenzhen Peng City FC, Lommel SK, ESTAC Troyes, Palermo FC, Bahia, and Club Bolívar among its sister clubs.

DEPARTMENT: Infrastructure                                                               
LOCATION: Orangeburg, NY

POSITION OVERVIEW:
This position will be responsible for supporting the New York City FC Infrastructure & Facilities department in many capacities, ranging from project and office work to consumer facing facility management. Additionally, this position will work closely with both the Facility Manager and Facility Coordinator from the Infrastructure department to plan, develop, and maintain the physical assets of New York City FC. 
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
  • Assist with day-to-day facilities operations of New York City FC Training Facility
  • Work with external contractors to ensure upkeep and safety of facility
  • Assist with setup and breakdown of events held at Training Facility
  • Project Management support & administration 
  • Support club-wide infrastructure development projects
  • Other duties as assigned
 
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
  • A passion for project management, construction and experience of facility management preferred 
  • Interest or experience in facility management and/or project management
  • Experience showing professionalism expected around professional sports teams
  • Ability to meet deadlines; accomplish work in order of priority; professionally maintain composure and effectiveness under pressure and changing conditions
  • High level of organization and attention to detail
  • Highly motivated and ability to work long days and non-traditional hours

  • Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC

job.title: Media Relations Gameday Associate
job.html_description:
TITLE: Media Relations Gameday Associate 
DEPARTMENT: Communications        
LOCATION: New York City, NY 
COMPENSATION: $18.50/ hour (part-time) 
 
POSITION OVERVIEW: 
New York City FC is seeking part-time seasonal Media Relations Gameday Associates who are looking to start their career in Sports Communications. These individuals will assist the Communications Department to execute the media operations at New York City FC (First Team) and New York City FC II (Second Team) home games. The Media Relations Gameday Associate will report to the Director, Media Relations and Manager, Media Relations and assist with gameday responsibilities which include media information distribution, press box operations, media credentialing assistance, stat keeping, photo marshaling, facilitating post-match press conference and player availability, quote transcriptions and compiling post-match notes.  
 
Individuals chosen for this role must be available to work a majority of home games, including nights, weekends and odd hours as assigned, based on the First Team and Second Team regular season and postseason schedule across all of the Club’s home venues. This is an opportunity to gain valuable sports communications experience while working in a dynamic matchday environment. 
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO: 
  • Assist the Communications staff on gamedays in various roles while helping promote the Club’s brand through the media 
  • Assist in press box preparation and management before and after games to ensure a fantastic matchday experience for all attending media and broadcasters 
  • Operate and staff the media check-in, managing credential distribution to media, photographers and guests   
  • Compile key storylines and player milestones throughout the match for the post-match notes, in addition to working with the League to track and keep stats to input into the database 
  • Act as an on-field photo marshal for broadcasters and photographers  
  • Facilitate post-match press conference and player availability, gather audio and transcribe for the inclusion of the post-match notes that are distributed to media  
  • Other duties as assigned by the Director and Manager, Media Relations in preparation for a home match such as publicity recaps, gameday notes, stats, and support at New York City FC Communications activations  
 
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

job.title: Performance Coach - NYCFC II
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE: Performance Coach - NYCFC II
DEPARTMENT: Sporting
REPORTING TO: VP, Performance                                                  
LOCATION: City Football Academy (Orangeburg, NY)

POSITION OVERVIEW 
Athletic development is central to the long-term progress and performance of our players. At New York City Football Club, we believe a consistent, evidence-informed approach to physical development is essential to building robustness, supporting injury resilience, and creating the physical foundation for sustained sporting success. 
The Performance Coach will support the planning, delivery, and evaluation of the NYCFC II physical development program. Working within an interdisciplinary, first-team-aligned performance model, this role will provide high-quality support across strength and conditioning, recovery, nutrition, athlete monitoring, fitness testing, training-load management, and return-to-play processes. 
The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. They will be committed to helping young players develop the habits, knowledge, and resilience required to thrive both as athletes and as people.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 
  • Plan, deliver, and evaluate individual and team-based physical development programs aligned with NYCFC’s first-team performance philosophy. 
  • Deliver strength and conditioning sessions, warm-ups, recovery strategies, athlete monitoring, fitness testing, and training-load management for NYCFC II players. 
  • Develop and implement appropriate return-to-play protocols in collaboration with athletic training, medical, coaching, and performance staff. 
  • Manage the collection, analysis, reporting, and practical application of performance data, including GPS and other athlete-monitoring technologies. 
  • Use data and professional judgment to provide clear, timely, and actionable feedback to players and coaches. 
  • Support NYCFC II coaches with the planning, delivery, and review of training sessions. 
  • Contribute to the continued development and implementation of NYCFC’s Human Performance philosophy across the Club. 
  • Support the physical development assessment and monitoring of players within the Elite Development pathway. 
  • Assist with the practical delivery of appropriate nutrition and hydration strategies for training, matches, travel, and recovery. 
  • Build effective working relationships with NYCFC II coaches, athletic trainers, analysts, Academy staff, first-team performance staff, and other key stakeholders. 
  • Educate players on training, recovery, nutrition, lifestyle habits, and personal responsibility in a way that supports long-term development. 
  • Maintain accurate records, communicate effectively, and uphold the professional standards expected within NYCFC. 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING
Required Competencies and Experience 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Sport and Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or related discipline (Master’s degree preferred) 
  • A recognized strength and conditioning qualification, such as the CSCS 
  • At least two years of paid experience working as a strength and conditioning or performance coach in a team-sport environment 
  • Demonstrated experience supporting the development of young or emerging athletes 
  • Practical experience designing and delivering strength, conditioning, recovery, monitoring, and return-to-play programs 
  • The ability to interpret performance data and translate findings into clear recommendations for players and staff 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and communicate effectively across an interdisciplinary team 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint 
  • A professional, organized, and detail-oriented approach to data management and daily operations 
Preferred Experience 
  • Experience using STATSports GPS or comparable athlete-monitoring systems. 
  • Experience using VALD technologies, including NordBord, ForceFrame, and ForceDecks. 
  • Experience working within a professional soccer or high-performance sporting environment. 
  • Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese. 

HOW YOU’LL WORK 
The ideal candidate will: 
  • Put the player and the player’s long-term development at the center of their work. 
  • Communicate clearly, respectfully, and proactively with players and colleagues. 
  • Collaborate openly and contribute positively to an interdisciplinary team. 
  • Apply evidence-informed practice while remaining adaptable to the individual needs of each player. 
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, accountability, and professionalism in a high-performance environment. 
  • Be curious, reflective, and committed to continuous learning. 
  • Create a demanding yet supportive environment in which players feel challenged, respected, and empowered to improve. 
  • Consistently model the standards, habits, and behaviors expected of NYCFC players.

WHO YOU ARE:  
At New York FC, we are committed to upholding our core club values and our values guide how we show up and work together every day.  If you share our values listed below, please consider NYCFC as a great place for you to work (and play): 
  • Acts Honorably: listens and communicates respectfully, without judgement 
  • Engages Collaboratively: provides and seeks constructive feedback to and from peers, proactively sharing appreciation for quality contributions of others 
  • Champions Inclusion: celebrates the value of differences recognizing the value in the unique backgrounds and lived experiences of every team member 
  • Drives Forward: embraces new opportunities with curiosity and a focus on improvement and innovation 
  • Shows Heart: demonstrates passion for the Club and sport, operating as an NYCFC ambassador in encouraging and inspiring that passion in others 
 
KEY RELATIONSHIPS 
  • Vice President, Performance 
  • Athletic Trainer – NYCFCII 
  • Fitness Coach – 1st Team 
  • Performance Coach – 1st Team 
  • Director of Performance Services – Academy 
  • NYCFC II and Academy Coaches & Administrators 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 
  • Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC. 
  • Must be able to work games scheduled which may be at night and on weekends and holidays. 

COMPENSATION:
This exempt position has an estimated annual base salary of $70,000. Final compensation offer amounts are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and some role-dependent factors such as certifications and software expertise. We welcome direct conversations with each candidate about compensation in all of our initial calls.

WHAT WE OFFER: 
  • Excellent health, dental & vision insurance, with options to fit you and your family’s needs. 
  • Comprehensive and competitive benefit programs, including maternal & paternal leave. 
  • Ancillary benefits: Commuter, gym membership, and Citi Bike discounts. 
  • Your health is important! Our wellness strategy focuses on mental and physical wellbeing through in-office and virtual programs. 
  • Four complementary tickets to every NYCFC home match. 
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers. 
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment. 

NEW YORK CITY FOOTBALL CLUB OVERVIEW:
At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build this city into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club was announced as Major League Soccer’s 20th franchise and is the first and only MLS team located within the five boroughs of New York City. The Club has qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs nine times over the past 10 seasons, winning MLS Cup in 2021. Games are available to stream via an Apple TV subscription, providing every match of the MLS regular season, the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs, annual Leagues Cup tournament, the MLS All-Star Game, the Campeones Cup, and more all in one place and with no blackouts. New York City FC is building New York City’s first-ever soccer-specific stadium, Etihad Park, which is set to open in 2027. For more information, please visit: www.newyorkcityfc.com.
 
New York City FC is also one of 12 clubs comprising City Football Group and counts Manchester City FC, Melbourne City FC, Yokohama F-Marinos, Girona FC, Montevideo City Torque, Shenzhen Peng City FC, Lommel SK, ESTAC Troyes, Palermo FC, Bahia, and Club Bolívar among its sister clubs.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

By clicking "Apply Now", you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.title: Team Operations - Academy Team Administrator
job.html_description:
TITLE: Team Administrator – Academy
DEPARTMENT: Team Operations
REPORTS TO: Head of Academy Operations
FLSA: Full-time; Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

The Team Administrator will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support across the Academy’s Pre-Formation and Formation age groups. This role will work closely with the Head of Academy Operations, Director of Soccer Operations, and Academy Director.  This role will be an integral piece ensuring smooth day-to-day delivery of Academy programming in alignment with MLS standards, Orlando City SC operational expectations, and safeguarding requirements.

 

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, with experience supporting elite youth soccer environments. This individual will serve as a central point of coordination for players, parents, coaches, and external stakeholders while ensuring all operational, registration, scheduling, travel, and compliance processes are delivered to a high professional standard.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Provide full administrative and operational support for all Pre-Formation and Formation age groups across training, fixtures, tournaments, showcases, and special events.
  • Coordinate and maintain all phase-specific schedules, calendars, and communications through Teamworks and other club communication platforms.
  • Serve as a primary administrative contact for players, parents, coaches, and support staff within assigned age groups.
  • Assist with the day-to-day operational delivery of academy programming in accordance with MLS standards and club policies.
  • Maintain accurate academy records, player files, attendance tracking, registration documentation, and operational reports.
  • Support the Head of Academy Operations with academy-wide operational projects and initiatives.
  • Support the organization and execution of MLS events, tournaments, festivals, friendlies, and showcase competitions.
  • Coordinate communication with internal departments, including facilities, groundskeeping, security, and medical staff, to ensure operational readiness.
  • Assist with all player registration processes through MLS, U.S. Soccer, and applicable federation systems.
  • Support compliance with MLS roster regulations, player movement policies, safeguarding standards, and competition requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of MLS rules, academy standards, and youth player compliance procedures.
  • Assist with international clearance and player documentation processes where applicable.
  • Coordinate team travel arrangements for assigned academy teams in collaboration with the Head of Academy Ops and Finance. 
  • Maintain consistent and professional communication with players and families regarding schedules, travel, programming updates, and operational information.
  • Promote a positive and professional experience that reflects the values and standards of Orlando City SC.
  • Coordinate Academy player housing logistics, including host family placements, housing documentation, onboarding, monitoring, and conclusion of host family agreements in accordance with club policies.
  • All other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

 

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sports Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum 2–4 years of experience in team operations, Academy administration, or elite youth sports environments preferred.
  • Previous experience working within MLS academies, professional academies, collegiate athletics, or elite youth soccer environments preferred.
  • Knowledge and understanding of MLS rules, youth player registration processes, and Academy operational standards preferred.
  • Experience coordinating logistics, including fixtures, tournaments, travel, and events.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and athlete management platforms such as Teamworks.
  • Strong organizational, administrative, and multitasking skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with players, parents, coaches, and staff.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexible schedule with availability to work evenings, weekends, and travel domestically as required.
  • Bilingual in Spanish or Portuguese preferred but not required.
  • Ability to pass a background screening.
  • Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.

 



About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

 

Orlando City and Orlando Pride will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application or interview process and perform critical job functions. Please contact the People and Culture department at Peopleandculture@orlandocitysc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

- Bachelor’s degree in Sports Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience. - Minimum 2–4 years of experience in team operations, Academy administration, or elite youth sports environments preferred. - Previous experience working within MLS academies, professional academies, collegiate athletics, or elite youth soccer environments preferred. - Knowledge and understanding of MLS rules, youth player registration processes, and Academy operational standards preferred. - Experience coordinating logistics, including fixtures, tournaments, travel, and events. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and athlete management platforms such as Teamworks. - Strong organizational, administrative, and multitasking skills with exceptional attention to detail. - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with players, parents, coaches, and staff. - Ability to work independently while contributing positively within a collaborative team environment. - Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment. - Flexible schedule with availability to work evenings, weekends, and travel domestically as required. - Bilingual in Spanish or Portuguese preferred but not required. - Ability to pass a background screening. - Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.
About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride:
In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.
The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons.
In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.
The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.
In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.
In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.

REPORTS TO:  Grounds Supervisor

WHAT SETS YOU APART  

Are you a self-motivated individual with physical stamina? Do you love the outdoors and maintaining aesthetically pleasing outdoor space? If so, our Sports Turf Specialist role could be for you. You will be responsible for mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and record keeping for the Inter.co Stadium. You will get a chance to use a variety of practical skills which are valuable and essential to the overall Club.   

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Proactively identify turf grass diseases, weeds, pests, and work with Director of Turf & Grounds and Grounds Supervisor to take corrective action as needed 
  • Assist in equipment and irrigation repair and maintenance 
  • Work MLS games, NWSL games and third party events based on business needs 
  • Create and maintain good working relationships with all MLS and NWSL coaches and soccer operations staff 
  • Participate in procuring equipment and supplies as needed for the facility 
  • Provide coverage at the training facilities as needed 
  • Other duties as assigned

  • Ability to resolve concerns expeditiously and independently.

  • Fluency in Spanish is preferred but not required.

  • Ability to perform physical labor for extended periods of time and in various weather conditions. 
  • Able to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays.

  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification. 
  • The ability to pass a background screening.

job.title: Team Operations - Academy Formation Phase Assistant Coach
job.html_description:
TITLE: Formation Phase Assistant Coach

DEPARTMENT:  Soccer Operations
REPORTS TO:  Academy Director

FLSA: Full-Time; Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

The Formation Phase Assistant Coach is responsible for supporting the academy team in both player and team development and the day-to-day operations of the formation phase. The Assistant Coach will assist with the team, including supporting training practices and games. The successful candidate will report to the Academy Director.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & REPONSIBILITIES

  • Support and assist Head Coaches and all academy staff.
  • Implement the club methodology, effective practice, and game plans through the Academy Curriculum, style of play, and periodization.
  • Support all team practices and training sessions.
  • Use session planning tools and video platforms to ensure that all relevant player data is recorded.
  • Lead and support preparation for all games, including developing game strategies, team meetings, and scouting opposing teams.
  • Support and deliver Individual Development Plans (IDP) and training for Formation Phase Teams.
  • Assists in the scouting and evaluation of potential players for the team.
  • Communicate with Academy Scouts frequently to identify and report talent.
  • Enforces team rules and league rules applicable to players and coaching staff.
  • Assist and support coaches in the general control, management, and conduct of Academy players, ensuring adherence to the Academy Code of Conduct.
  • Assist with other age groups with training and game day when needed.
  • Other duties assigned by Academy Director.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • USSF ‘B’ or ‘C’ License or Equivalent
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience working in elite soccer.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills.
  • Collaborative management style – an advocate of team concepts. 
  • Positive influencer, comfortable with leading dynamic change.
  • Must be able to work long hours, weekends, and some holidays.
  • Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.
  • Ability to pass a background check.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • USSF A License
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) or multi-lingual fluency
  • Experience, familiarity, and network within OCSC Territory is strongly preferred.

The Assistant Coach will assist with the team, including supporting training practices and games. The successful candidate will report to the Academy Director.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & REPONSIBILITIES
- Support and assist Head Coaches and all academy staff.
- Implement the club methodology, effective practice, and game plans through the Academy Curriculum, style of play, and periodization.
- Support all team practices and training sessions.
- Use session planning tools and video platforms to ensure that all relevant player data is recorded.
- Lead and support preparation for all games, including developing game strategies, team meetings, and scouting opposing teams. - Support and deliver Individual Development Plans (IDP) and training for Formation Phase Teams. - Assists in the scouting and evaluation of potential players for the team.
- Communicate with Academy Scouts frequently to identify and report talent.
- Enforces team rules and league rules applicable to players and coaching staff.
- Assist and support coaches in the general control, management, and conduct of Academy players, ensuring adherence to the Academy Code of Conduct.
- Assist with other age groups with training and game day when needed. - Other duties assigned by Academy Director.
QUALIFICATIONS
- USSF ‘B’ or ‘C’ License or Equivalent - Minimum of 5 years of experience working in elite soccer. - Strong communication and interpersonal skills. - Excellent organizational and leadership skills. - Collaborative management style – an advocate of team concepts. - Positive influencer, comfortable with leading dynamic change. - Must be able to work long hours, weekends, and some holidays. - Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification. - Ability to pass a background check.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- USSF A License - Bilingual (Spanish/English) or multi-lingual fluency - Experience, familiarity, and network within OCSC Territory is strongly preferred.
About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride:
In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.
The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons.
In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.
The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.
In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.
In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.
For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

job.title: Brand Alliance - Brand Alliance Assistant
job.html_description:
TITLE: Brand Alliances Assistant

DEPARTMENT: Brand Alliances

REPORTS TO: Senior Manager, Brand Alliance Marketing

FLSA: Part Time, Hourly, Seasonal

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

Brand Alliances at Orlando City SC/Orlando Pride is seeking a hardworking, positive and passionate individual who wants to enhance their knowledge in corporate partnership marketing and corporate partnership development through practical experience in facilitating corporate events, gameday operations, lead generation and prospecting, asset tracking and inventory, contract fulfillment and overall account management. We are seeking someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment with great organizational skills, an unequaled willingness to learn by doing, and the ability to be an innovative problem solver.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Review and comprehend Brand Alliance contracts, analyzing fulfillment needs and strategy.
  • Support the Brand Alliance Marketing team with account management, partner communication, and fulfillment of contractual obligations.
  • Track partner assets and performance.
  • Support Brand Alliances with graphic design needs for existing and prospective partners.
  • Collaborate with internal departments and external vendors to plan and implement in-office/stadium events, gameday promotions, digital/social campaigns, and partner recaps.
  • Assist with prospecting new corporate sponsorship and media partnerships, developing customized proposals and sales presentations, and researching new partnership opportunities.
  • Gain exposure to Brand Alliances business development strategies, including deal structures, premium suite sales, fulfillment, and rate cards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Gameday and On-Site Event Responsibilities:

  • Support the sales staff on gameday with prospect and partner communication as needed.
  • Participate in Fan Zone operations, including pregame meetings and gameday responsibilities.
  • Professionally act as liaison between players and partners during off-site appearances and corporate events.
  • Support youth clinics, camps, and partner events by assisting with registration, guest flow, equipment setup, fulfillment of partner assets, and event breakdown.
  • Prepare and support gameday assets, including run of show, Fan Zone activations, gate giveaways, LED fulfillment, and other partner activations.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications: 

  • Applicants preferably should be working toward or recently graduated with an undergraduate or graduate degree with an emphasis in Sports Marketing/Management or a related field.
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Innovative, team-oriented individual who can identify opportunities and develop creative solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Able to work all Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride home games, as well as other corporate events throughout the year.
  • Preferred 6 months to 1 year of experience with a sports team/organization, athletic department, or similar field.
  • Experience and/or proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong knowledge of social media platforms.
  • A sense of humor is a must—be prepared to share your favorite joke during the interview!
  • Position will work up to 30 hours per week, including gamedays, evenings, weekends, holidays, and select events.
  • Must be comfortable working outdoors and be able to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to pass a background screening.
  • Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.
  • Strong interest in soccer and sports is a plus.

 

Other Details:

Candidate can be working toward an academic credit for this opportunity.

job.title: Team Operations - Equipment Management Associate, Orlando City, 2026 Season
job.html_description:
TITLE: Equipment Management Associate, 2026 Season

DEPARTMENT: Team Operations 

REPORTS TO: MLS Senior Equipment Manager  

FLSA: Non-Exempt, Hourly

 

ASSOCIATE SUMMARY

Associates will have the opportunity to learn about the history, culture, and vision of Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride, understanding the importance of how a professional sports organization works (which could include sales, marketing, public relations, operations, or the internal working of the Club), to further develop general critical thinking, problem-solving, time management, communication, and writing skills. 

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART 

Orlando City SC is looking for an equipment associate that will gain valuable experience in the day-to-day operations/management of the equipment operations department.  As an associate, you will learn all about the operations and logistics that are needed to support players, coaches, and staff for a professional sports organization.   This role will support Orlando City 1st team, Orlando City B Team, Orlando City Academy. 

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Help organize and maintain inventory of apparel, footwear, and equipment.
  • Provide daily team equipment laundry service for players and coaches.
  • Facilitate the timely distribution of team apparel to players and staff during scheduled shifts.
  • Assist and support coaching staff and players during training sessions.
  • Learn and assist with thermal label making and heat press applications.
  • Assist with the intake of incoming shipments, optimize designated storage spaces, and ensure the accurate preparation and distribution of team apparel and gear.
  • Help with building soccer goals, shelving units, replacing nets, and any other tasks that are deemed necessary.
  • Other responsibilities and duties might be assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS 

To perform this role successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The following requirements are representative of eligibility requirements, knowledge, skill, and/or ability necessary: 

  • Applicants could be working towards an undergraduate or graduate degree with an emphasis in sports business, management, or a related field. 
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.
  • Maintaining the highest level of professionalism and confidentiality within a pro-team environment is required. 
  • Must be self-motivated, detail-oriented and have a strong sense of accountability. 
  • Physical Requirements: The ability to lift, carry, and move objects weighing up to 50 pounds oftentimes is required.
  • Possess a positive, engaging, and professional personality
  • Strong understanding and passion for the sport of soccer is preferred
  • This associateship will be around 20-30 hours a week. 
  • The ability to pass a background screening. 
  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification.
  • Ability to work nontraditional hours in nontraditional settings, including holidays, nights and weekends. 
  •  

Other Details:

  • This role is for the rest for the 2026 MLS season. 

  • This role will not have any domestic travel responsibilities.

FLSA: Non-Exempt, Hourly
ASSOCIATE SUMMARY
Associates will have the opportunity to learn about the history, culture, and vision of Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride, understanding the importance of how a professional sports organization works (which could include sales, marketing, public relations, operations, or the internal working of the Club), to further develop general critical thinking, problem-solving, time management, communication, and writing skills.
WHAT SETS YOU APART
Orlando City SC is looking for an equipment associate that will gain valuable experience in the day-to-day operations/management of the equipment operations department. As an associate, you will learn all about the operations and logistics that are needed to support players, coaches, and staff for a professional sports organization. This role will support Orlando City 1st team, Orlando City B Team, Orlando City Academy.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Help organize and maintain inventory of apparel, footwear, and equipment. - Provide daily team equipment laundry service for players and coaches. - Facilitate the timely distribution of team apparel to players and staff during scheduled shifts. - Assist and support coaching staff and players during training sessions. - Learn and assist with thermal label making and heat press applications. - Assist with the intake of incoming shipments, optimize designated storage spaces, and ensure the accurate preparation and distribution of team apparel and gear. - Help with building soccer goals, shelving units, replacing nets, and any other tasks that are deemed necessary. - Other responsibilities and duties might be assigned.
QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this role successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The following requirements are representative of eligibility requirements, knowledge, skill, and/or ability necessary:
- Applicants could be working towards an undergraduate or graduate degree with an emphasis in sports business, management, or a related field. - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. - Proficient with Microsoft Office. - Maintaining the highest level of professionalism and confidentiality within a pro-team environment is required. - Must be self-motivated, detail-oriented and have a strong sense of accountability. - Physical Requirements: The ability to lift, carry, and move objects weighing up to 50 pounds oftentimes is required. - Possess a positive, engaging, and professional personality - Strong understanding and passion for the sport of soccer is preferred - This associateship will be around 20-30 hours a week. - The ability to pass a background screening. - The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification. - Ability to work nontraditional hours in nontraditional settings, including holidays, nights and weekends.
Other Details:
- This role is for the rest for the 2026 MLS season.
- This role will not have any domestic travel responsibilities.
About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride:
In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.
The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons.
In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.
The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.
In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.
In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.
For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

job.html_description:
TITLE: Facilities Operations Assistant

DEPARTMENT: Stadium Operations

REPORTS TO: Sr Manager, Stadium Operations

FLSA: Hourly, Part-Time, Non-Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

Orlando City SC is seeking hardworking, positive, and passionate individuals looking to gain practical experience supporting key operational functions at a professional soccer stadium and special event venue. The Assistant will have a direct role in supporting the delivery of services, protection and monitoring of facilities, and oversight of vendors providing services. The Assistant will work under the close supervision of the Stadium Operations Manager and facility operations team.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the facility operations team while observing the planning and execution of sporting and non-sporting stadium events.
  • Learn about and assist with organizing and inspecting stadium storage areas.
  • Learn about and participate in the Inter&Co Stadium Zero Waste sustainability program.
  • Learn about and collaborate with departments across the organization.
  • Assist with general administrative duties specific to Stadium Operations.
  • Learn and demonstrate excellent customer service when interacting with clients and vendors.
  • Learn how to conduct stadium inspections.
  • Participate in assignments related to inventory tracking, departmental activities, and other Stadium Operations initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

  • An innovative individual who can contribute ideas, work effectively within a team, develop creative solutions, and identify new opportunities in a high-pressure, fast-changing environment.
  • Availability to work approximately 20–30 hours per week.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours and in a variety of settings within a team environment.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.
  • Ability to pass a background check.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interest in soccer and sports is a plus.
  • Applicants are not required to be pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree; however, students pursuing a degree in Sport Management, Facility Management, or a related field may be eligible to receive course credit.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to walk, run, kneel, climb stairs, and react quickly to unpredictable situations.
  • Must be able to work both indoors and outdoors, with some exposure to adverse weather conditions.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods as required.

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.

job.title: Stadium Operations - Part Time, Stadium Security Guard
job.html_description:
TITLE: Part-Time Stadium Security Guard

DEPARTMENT: Stadium Operations 
REPORTS TO: Security Manager 

FLSA: Part Time; Non-Exempt 
 

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

We are looking for an honest, attentive, and perceptive individual to join our Security team. In this role, you will help secure Inter.Co Stadium and protect the Club’s property, guests, teammates, and players. You will help maintain a safe and secure environment while serving as a visible security presence and deterrent to unauthorized or irregular activity.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Patrol Inter.Co Stadium property to monitor and prevent intrusion, damage, hazards, and security breaches.
  • Lock and unlock doors and conduct facility walkthroughs as needed.
  • Provide a visible presence that promotes and enforces safety and security.
  • Monitor activity throughout the facility via closed-circuit television (CCTV).
  • Respond appropriately to emergencies, including but not limited to fire and burglar alarms.
  • Monitor access to the venue on event and non-event days.
  • Assist with event-day security coverage.
  • Identify and address unauthorized persons and violations of security procedures.
  • Contact appropriate authorities regarding unlawful or irregular activity when necessary.
  • Use radios and other communication devices in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Document and report malfunctions, misconduct, incidents, and operational or safety concerns.
  • Interview victims and witnesses and prepare incident reports as necessary.
  • Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Implement prescribed emergency procedures when necessary.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of public safety plans for day-to-day operations and special events.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

 

  • High school diploma, G.E.D., or equivalent required.
  • College coursework in Criminal Justice, Private Investigations, Homeland Security, Emergency Management, Emergency Medical Services, or another security-related field is preferred. Relevant military experience is also preferred.
  • Six (6) months to one (1) year of security experience, preferably in a similar environment.
  • Bilingual in Spanish or Portuguese is preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish rapport and build positive working relationships.
  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to successfully complete required background screening and employment verification.
  • Valid Florida driver’s license required.
  • Valid Florida Class “D” Security Officer License required.
  • Appropriate credentials as mandated by state, county, or local law.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Must be able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to walk, run, kneel, climb stairs, and react quickly to unpredictable situations.
  • Must be able to work both indoors and outdoors, including exposure to varying weather conditions.
  • Must be able to sit or stand for prolonged periods, including while monitoring surveillance equipment.

 

The physical demands described herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the core functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing duties, the employee may be regularly required to stand or sit for extended periods, walk long distances, use hands to handle, hold or feel objects, tools, or controls, reach with arms, and talk or hear. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee is required to hear conversations in noisy environments. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. The information contained in this position description is for compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (A.D.A) and is not an exhaustive list of the duties performed by persons holding this position. Additional duties are performed by the individuals currently in these positions and may change from time to time considering immediate operational requirements.

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament.
